import {
  announceGlobalLiveRegion,
  globalLiveRegionMessage,
} from '@theme/live-region';

const getCartFeedbackMessage = (name) => globalLiveRegionMessage(name);

const announceCartFeedback = async (
  message,
  { toast = false, variant = 'error', duration } = {}
) => {
  if (!message) return;

  if (toast) {
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('s-notification:add', {
      detail: {
        message,
        variant,
        ...(duration == null ? {} : { duration }),
      },
    }));
    return;
  }

  await announceGlobalLiveRegion(message);
};

const getCartSuccessMessage = (lines = []) => {
  let hasAdd = false;
  let hasUpdate = false;
  let hasRemove = false;

  for (const line of lines) {
    if (!line?.id) {
      hasAdd = true;
    } else if (line.quantity === 0) {
      hasRemove = true;
    } else {
      hasUpdate = true;
    }

    if ((hasAdd && hasUpdate) || (hasAdd && hasRemove) || (hasUpdate && hasRemove)) {
      return getCartFeedbackMessage('updatedMessage');
    }
  }

  if (hasAdd) return getCartFeedbackMessage('addedMessage');
  if (hasRemove) return getCartFeedbackMessage('removedMessage');
  return getCartFeedbackMessage('updatedMessage');
};

const getCartErrorMessage = (error) => (typeof error === 'string'
  ? error
  : error?.cause?.userErrors?.[0]?.message || getCartFeedbackMessage('updateError'));

const getCartRefreshErrorMessage = () => (
  getCartFeedbackMessage('refreshError') || getCartFeedbackMessage('updateError')
);

export {
  announceCartFeedback,
  getCartErrorMessage,
  getCartRefreshErrorMessage,
  getCartSuccessMessage,
};

================ FILE: assets/live-region.js ================

const pendingAnnouncements = new WeakMap();

function cancelLiveRegionAnnouncement(region) {
  const cancel = region && pendingAnnouncements.get(region);
  if (cancel) cancel();
}

function announceLiveRegion(region, message, { frames = 1 } = {}) {
  if (!region) return;
  if (message == null || message === '') return;

  cancelLiveRegionAnnouncement(region);
  region.textContent = '';

  const text = String(message);
  let remaining = Math.max(1, Number.parseInt(frames, 10) || 1);

  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    let cancel;
    let rafId = 0;
    const finish = () => {
      if (pendingAnnouncements.get(region) === cancel) pendingAnnouncements.delete(region);
      resolve();
    };
    const schedule = () => {
      rafId = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        rafId = 0;
        if (--remaining > 0) return schedule();
        region.textContent = text;
        finish();
      });
    };

    cancel = () => {
      if (rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
      finish();
    };

    pendingAnnouncements.set(region, cancel);
    schedule();
  });
}

function announceGlobalLiveRegion(message, options) {
  return announceLiveRegion(document.getElementById('sr-announcer'), message, options);
}

function globalLiveRegionMessage(name) {
  return document.getElementById('sr-announcer')?.dataset[name];
}

function createVisuallyHiddenLiveRegion() {
  const region = document.createElement('span');
  region.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
  region.setAttribute('aria-atomic', 'true');
  region.className = 'sr-only';
  return region;
}

export { announceGlobalLiveRegion, announceLiveRegion, cancelLiveRegionAnnouncement, createVisuallyHiddenLiveRegion, globalLiveRegionMessage };

import { dispatchPageView } from '@theme/page-view-event';

// Loaded once per full page load via snippets/theme-scripts.liquid. Module side effects only —
// see page-view-event.js for the pure helper imported by tests. Waits for
// later parser-inserted modules while the document is loading, then fires once.
if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => dispatchPageView(), { once: true }); // spec-audit-disable-line no-domcontentloaded
} else {
  dispatchPageView();
}


================ FILE: assets/page-view-event.js ================

import { PageViewEvent } from '@shopify/standard-events';

// Dispatch a single PageViewEvent on initial load. Each link click is a full-page
// reload (SPA navigation was removed in #702), so the script runs fresh on every
// view and one dispatch per page is sufficient.
//
// `template` is read from <main data-template="..."> (set in layout/theme.liquid
// from {{ request.page_type }}). The event flows through @shopify/standard-events to any
// Standard Events listener (analytics integrations, the events inspector, etc.).
//
// This module exports the helper without side effects. The runtime entrypoint
// (page-view-event-init.js) calls it; tests import this file directly.
export function dispatchPageView(target = document) {
  const main = document.getElementById('main-content');
  const template = main?.dataset.template || '';

  target.dispatchEvent(
    new PageViewEvent({
      page: {
        template,
        title: document.title,
        url: window.location.href,
      },
    })
  );
}


================ FILE: assets/quantity-rules.js ================

/**
 * Shared quantity-rule helpers for product and cart quantity controls.
 * Shopify quantity rules define a minimum, optional maximum, and increment.
 */
export function quantityRulesFromDataset(source) {
  const min = parseInt(source.dataset.qtyMin, 10);
  const max = source.dataset.qtyMax ? parseInt(source.dataset.qtyMax, 10) : Infinity;
  const step = parseInt(source.dataset.qtyStep, 10);

  return {
    min: Number.isFinite(min) ? min : 1,
    max: Number.isFinite(max) ? max : Infinity,
    step: Number.isFinite(step) && step > 0 ? step : 1,
  };
}

export function normalizeQuantity(value, rules, { allowZero = false } = {}) {
  const min = Number.isFinite(rules?.min) ? rules.min : 1;
  const max = Number.isFinite(rules?.max) ? rules.max : Infinity;
  const step = Number.isFinite(rules?.step) && rules.step > 0 ? rules.step : 1;

  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return min;
  if (allowZero && value <= 0) return 0;

  let quantity = Math.max(min, value);
  if (max !== Infinity) quantity = Math.min(max, quantity);

  const stepsFromMin = Math.round((quantity - min) / step);
  quantity = min + (stepsFromMin * step);

  if (max !== Infinity && quantity > max) {
    const maxSteps = Math.max(0, Math.floor((max - min) / step));
    quantity = min + (maxSteps * step);
  }

  return Math.max(min, quantity);
}


================ FILE: assets/s-cart.js ================

/**
 * <s-cart> manages all cart quantity updates and removals via the command pattern.
 * It fetches partials after each mutation so the cart drawer, cart page, and header
 * counters all stay in sync — do not convert to a full page reload or direct DOM manipulation.
 *
 * Commands (dispatched via commandfor/command on descendant buttons):
 *   --update-quantity — Adjusts quantity by [data-delta] for [data-line-key]; debounced 200ms per line.
 *   --remove          — Cancels queued/in-flight work for [data-line-key], then sets quantity to 0.
 *   --apply-discount  — Applies the value of the descendant [data-discount-code] input.
 *
 * Required child markup (queried by selector/attribute):
 *   [data-variant-id]                                — Visual/fallback identifier for a line's row and controls.
 *   [data-line-key]                                  — Primary cart line identity ({{ item.key }}); sent to updateCart as the line id.
 *   [data-delta]                                     — Integer delta (±N) paired with --update-quantity.
 *   [data-qty-min]                                   — Minimum quantity from variant.quantity_rule.min (default 1).
 *   [data-qty-max]                                   — Maximum quantity from variant.quantity_rule.max (when absent, no max).
 *   [data-qty-step]                                  — Increment step from variant.quantity_rule.increment (default 1).
 *   [data-quantity-display][data-line-key]           — Input/element holding the current quantity (value or textContent).
 *   [data-discount-code]                             — Discount-code input read by --apply-discount and Enter.
 *   [style*="view-transition-name"]                  — Row wrapper used for removal focus-restore + view transitions.
 *
 * Element dataset (attributes on <s-cart> itself):
 *   data-partials — Comma-separated partial names to re-fetch (default: "cart-items,cart-count").
 *                   Must match {% partial 'name' %} blocks in cart.liquid / theme.liquid / cart-drawer.liquid.
 *
 * External coupling:
 *   Cart feedback (#sr-announcer + s-notification:add) is owned by the updateCart
 *   handler in standard-actions-override.js — do not duplicate here.
 */
import { partials } from '@shopify/partial-rendering';
import { transition } from '@theme/view-transition';
import { normalizeQuantity, quantityRulesFromDataset } from '@theme/quantity-rules';
import { ViewEventElement } from '@theme/s-view-event';

class CartItems extends ViewEventElement {
  static #pendingFocusStates = new Map();
  static #refreshRevision = 0;

  #lifecycleAc;
  #quantityAcs = new Map();
  #discountAc;
  #noteAc;
  #rafId;
  #debounceTimers = new Map();
  #rollbackValues = new Map();
  #openDetails = new Set();

  static async refreshMountedCarts({ signal } = {}) {
    const revision = ++CartItems.#refreshRevision;
    signal?.throwIfAborted();

    const carts = [...document.querySelectorAll('s-cart')].filter((cart) => cart instanceof CartItems);
    const partialNames = [...new Set(carts.flatMap((cart) => cart.#partialNames))];

    if (!partialNames.length) return;

    // Capture UI state before partial rendering replaces the DOM.
    const focusStates = new Map();
    for (const cart of carts) {
      cart.#saveTransientState();
      focusStates.set(
        cart.id,
        CartItems.#pendingFocusStates.get(cart.id) ?? cart.#refreshFocusState()
      );
    }

    let html;
    try {
      // @partial-fetch-contract attributes=data-partials fallback=cart-items,cart-count
      html = await partials.fetch(...partialNames, { signal });
    } catch (error) {
      signal?.throwIfAborted();
      if (revision !== CartItems.#refreshRevision) return;
      throw error;
    }

    signal?.throwIfAborted();
    if (revision !== CartItems.#refreshRevision) return;

    let applied = false;
    try {
      await transition(() => {
        if (revision !== CartItems.#refreshRevision) return;
        signal?.throwIfAborted();
        partials.apply(html);
        applied = true;
      });
    } catch (error) {
      signal?.throwIfAborted();
      if (revision !== CartItems.#refreshRevision) return;
      throw error;
    }

    signal?.throwIfAborted();
    if (!applied || revision !== CartItems.#refreshRevision) return;

    for (const previousCart of carts) {
      const cart = previousCart.#mountedCart();
      cart.#openDetails = new Set(previousCart.#openDetails);
      cart.#reconcileAfterRefresh();
      const focusState = focusStates.get(previousCart.id);
      cart.#restoreRefreshFocus(focusState);
      if (CartItems.#pendingFocusStates.get(previousCart.id) === focusState) {
        CartItems.#pendingFocusStates.delete(previousCart.id);
      }
    }

    signal?.throwIfAborted();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    super.connectedCallback();

    this.#lifecycleAc = new AbortController();
    const opts = { signal: this.#lifecycleAc.signal };

    this.addEventListener('command', (e) => {
      const variantId = e.source.dataset.variantId;
      const lineKey = e.source.dataset.lineKey;

      if (e.command === '--update-quantity') {
        if (!lineKey) return;
        const display = this.#quantityDisplayForLine(lineKey, variantId);
        if (!display) return;
        const current = parseInt(display.value ?? display.textContent, 10) || 0;
        const delta = parseInt(e.source.dataset.delta, 10) || 0;
        const newQuantity = normalizeQuantity(
          current + delta,
          quantityRulesFromDataset(e.source),
          { allowZero: true }
        );

        display.value = newQuantity;
        const focusTarget = { lineKey, variantId, delta: e.source.dataset.delta };
        if (!this.#debounceTimers.has(lineKey)) this.#rollbackValues.set(lineKey, current);
        clearTimeout(this.#debounceTimers.get(lineKey));
        const rollbackValue = this.#rollbackValues.get(lineKey);
        this.#debounceTimers.set(lineKey, setTimeout(() => {
          this.#debounceTimers.delete(lineKey);
          this.#rollbackValues.delete(lineKey);
          this.#updateCart(lineKey, variantId, newQuantity, focusTarget, () => {
            const el = this.#quantityDisplayForLine(lineKey, variantId);
            if (el) el.value = rollbackValue;
          });
        }, 200));
      }

      if (e.command === '--remove') {
        if (!lineKey) return;
        this.#updateCart(lineKey, variantId, 0);
      }

      if (e.command === '--apply-discount') {
        this.#applyDiscount(this.querySelector('[data-discount-code]')?.value);
      }
    }, opts);

    this.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' && e.target.matches?.('[data-discount-code]')) {
        e.preventDefault();
        this.#applyDiscount(e.target.value);
      }
    }, opts);

    this.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
      const input = e.target;

      if (input.matches('[data-quantity-display]')) {
        const variantId = input.dataset.variantId;
        const lineKey = input.dataset.lineKey;
        if (!lineKey) return;
        const parsed = parseInt(input.value, 10);
        const quantity = normalizeQuantity(
          parsed,
          quantityRulesFromDataset(input),
          { allowZero: true }
        );

        // Capture the pre-edit committed value for rollback on mutation failure.
        // defaultValue reflects the server-committed state maintained by #reconcileAfterRefresh.
        const committedValue = input.defaultValue;
        input.value = quantity;
        this.#updateCart(lineKey, variantId, quantity, { lineKey, variantId, input: true }, () => {
          const el = this.#quantityDisplayForLine(lineKey, variantId);
          if (el) el.value = committedValue;
        });
      } else if (input.id === 'cart-note') {
        this.#updateNote(input.value);
      }
    }, opts);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    super.disconnectedCallback();

    this.#lifecycleAc?.abort();
    for (const controller of this.#quantityAcs.values()) controller.abort();
    this.#quantityAcs.clear();
    this.#discountAc?.abort();
    this.#noteAc?.abort();
    for (const timer of this.#debounceTimers.values()) clearTimeout(timer);
    this.#debounceTimers.clear();
    this.#rollbackValues.clear();
    if (this.#rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(this.#rafId);
  }

  #findLineElement(selector, lineKey, variantId = null) {
    for (const el of this.querySelectorAll(selector)) {
      if (lineKey && el.dataset.lineKey === lineKey) return el;
    }

    if (!variantId) return null;
    for (const el of this.querySelectorAll(selector)) {
      if (el.dataset.variantId === variantId) return el;
    }

    return null;
  }

  #quantityDisplayForLine(lineKey, variantId) {
    return this.#findLineElement('[data-quantity-display]', lineKey, variantId);
  }

  #findCartRow(lineKey, variantId) {
    return this.#findLineElement('[data-line-key], [data-variant-id]', lineKey, variantId)
      ?.closest('[style*="view-transition-name"]');
  }

  #mountedCart() {
    if (this.isConnected) return this;

    const replacement = this.id ? this.ownerDocument.getElementById(this.id) : null;
    return replacement instanceof CartItems ? replacement : this;
  }

  #refreshFocusState() {
    const active = this.ownerDocument.activeElement;
    if (!active?.matches || !this.contains(active)) return null;

    if (active.matches('[data-discount-code], button[command="--apply-discount"]')) {
      return { discountTarget: active.matches('[data-discount-code]') ? 'input' : 'button' };
    }

    const lineKey = active.dataset.lineKey;
    const variantId = active.dataset.variantId;
    if (active.matches('button[command="--remove"]')) {
      const row = this.#findCartRow(lineKey, variantId);
      const sibling = row?.nextElementSibling || row?.previousElementSibling;
      const siblingLine = sibling?.querySelector('[data-line-key], [data-variant-id]');
      return {
        isRemoval: true,
        siblingLineKey: siblingLine?.dataset.lineKey,
        siblingVariantId: siblingLine?.dataset.variantId,
      };
    }

    if (active.matches('button[data-delta], [data-quantity-display]')) {
      return {
        focusTarget: {
          lineKey,
          variantId,
          delta: active.dataset.delta,
          input: active.matches('[data-quantity-display]'),
        },
      };
    }

    return null;
  }

  #restoreRefreshFocus(state) {
    if (!state) return;
    const { isRemoval, siblingLineKey, siblingVariantId, focusTarget, discountTarget } = state;

    if (isRemoval) {
      this.#focusAfterRemoval(siblingLineKey, siblingVariantId);
    } else if (discountTarget) {
      const selector = discountTarget === 'input'
        ? '[data-discount-code]'
        : 'button[command="--apply-discount"]';
      this.querySelector(selector)?.focus();
    } else {
      this.#focusTarget(focusTarget)?.focus();
    }
  }

  #focusTarget({ lineKey, variantId, delta, input } = {}) {
    const selector = input ? '[data-quantity-display]' : 'button[data-delta]';
    let variantFallback = null;

    for (const el of this.querySelectorAll(selector)) {
      const deltaMatches = input || delta == null || el.dataset.delta === delta;
      if (!deltaMatches) continue;
      if (lineKey && el.dataset.lineKey === lineKey) return el;
      if (!variantFallback && variantId && el.dataset.variantId === variantId) {
        variantFallback = el;
      }
    }

    return variantFallback;
  }

  #focusAfterRemoval(siblingLineKey, siblingVariantId) {
    const freshRow = siblingLineKey || siblingVariantId
      ? this.#findCartRow(siblingLineKey, siblingVariantId)
      : null;
    const siblingControl = freshRow?.querySelector('a, button');
    if (siblingControl) {
      siblingControl.focus();
      return;
    }

    const anyControl = this.querySelector('a, button');
    if (anyControl) {
      anyControl.focus();
      return;
    }

    const enclosingDialog = this.closest('dialog[open]');
    const closeButton = enclosingDialog?.querySelector('button[command="close"]');
    if (closeButton) {
      closeButton.focus();
      return;
    }

    const main = document.getElementById('main-content') || this.closest('main');
    main?.focus();
  }

  #restoreFocusAfterMutation(focusState) {
    const { isRemoval, siblingLineKey, siblingVariantId, focusTarget } = focusState;
    if (CartItems.#pendingFocusStates.get(this.id) === focusState) {
      CartItems.#pendingFocusStates.delete(this.id);
    }

    cancelAnimationFrame(this.#rafId);
    this.#rafId = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const cart = this.#mountedCart();

      if (isRemoval) {
        cart.#focusAfterRemoval(siblingLineKey, siblingVariantId);
      } else if (focusTarget) {
        cart.#focusTarget(focusTarget)?.focus();
      }

      this.#rafId = null;
    });
  }

  #abortQuantityMutation(lineKey) {
    // A queued debounce has no AbortSignal yet, so cancel it explicitly before
    // aborting active work. This ensures an immediate remove or input commit wins.
    clearTimeout(this.#debounceTimers.get(lineKey));
    this.#debounceTimers.delete(lineKey);
    this.#rollbackValues.delete(lineKey);

    const controller = this.#quantityAcs.get(lineKey);
    controller?.abort();
    this.#quantityAcs.delete(lineKey);
  }

  #settleQuantityMutation(lineKey, controller) {
    if (this.#quantityAcs.get(lineKey) !== controller) return;

    this.#quantityAcs.delete(lineKey);
    if (this.#quantityAcs.size === 0) this.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
  }

  get #partialNames() {
    // dataset.partials mirrors the Liquid-written data-partials="..." attribute.
    // The fallback names ('cart-items', 'cart-count') must stay in sync with the
    // {% partial %} block names in cart.liquid and theme.liquid (cart-count) — renaming either breaks cart updates.
    const names = this.dataset.partials;
    return names ? names.split(',').map((s) => s.trim()) : ['cart-items', 'cart-count'];
  }

  #saveTransientState() {
    this.#openDetails.clear();
    for (const details of this.querySelectorAll('details[open]')) {
      const id = details.querySelector('summary')?.textContent.trim();
      if (id) this.#openDetails.add(id);
    }
  }

  #reconcileAfterRefresh() {
    for (const input of this.querySelectorAll('[data-quantity-display]')) {
      if ((input instanceof HTMLInputElement)) {
        // partials.apply() preserves form control state, but cart quantities are
        // server-owned after a cart refresh and should reflect the new markup.
        input.value = input.defaultValue;
      }
    }

    // Restore <details> open state lost during partial rendering
    for (const details of this.querySelectorAll('details')) {
      const id = details.querySelector('summary')?.textContent.trim();
      if (id && this.#openDetails.has(id)) details.open = true;
    }
    this.#openDetails.clear();
  }

  async #updateCart(lineKey, variantId, quantity, focusTarget = null, onRollback = null) {
    // Cancel queued and in-flight work for this line so the latest action wins.
    this.#abortQuantityMutation(lineKey);
    const controller = new AbortController();
    this.#quantityAcs.set(lineKey, controller);
    const { signal } = controller;

    this.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');

    const isRemoval = quantity === 0;
    const row = isRemoval ? this.#findCartRow(lineKey, variantId) : null;
    const sibling = row?.nextElementSibling || row?.previousElementSibling;
    const siblingLine = sibling?.querySelector('[data-line-key], [data-variant-id]');
    const siblingLineKey = siblingLine?.dataset.lineKey;
    const siblingVariantId = siblingLine?.dataset.variantId;
    const pendingFocusState = {
      isRemoval,
      siblingLineKey,
      siblingVariantId,
      focusTarget,
    };
    if (this.id) CartItems.#pendingFocusStates.set(this.id, pendingFocusState);

    try {
      // Cart mutation goes through Standard Actions (Storefront API). The shared
      // updateCart override in standard-actions-override.js triggers a partial refresh
      // (cart-items, cart-count, etc.) via CartItems.refreshMountedCarts() after the
      // mutation resolves. The {% partial 'name' %} blocks in cart.liquid, theme.liquid,
      // and snippets/cart-drawer.liquid remain the source of truth for what gets re-rendered.
      const result = await window.Shopify.actions.updateCart(
        { lines: [{ id: lineKey, quantity }] },
        {
          event: { context: 'cart' },
          signal,
        }
      );

      const userError = result?.userErrors?.[0]?.message;
      if (userError) {
        throw new Error(userError, {
          cause: { userErrors: result.userErrors },
        });
      }

      const replacementApplied = signal.aborted && this.#mountedCart() !== this;
      if (signal.aborted && !replacementApplied) return;
      if (!signal.aborted) this.#settleQuantityMutation(lineKey, controller);

      // The Standard Actions override owns feedback: non-toast success uses
      // #sr-announcer, while any toast owns its live role. Avoid a local duplicate.
      this.#restoreFocusAfterMutation(pendingFocusState);
    } catch (error) {
      const replacementApplied = signal.aborted && this.#mountedCart() !== this;
      if (replacementApplied) {
        this.#restoreFocusAfterMutation(pendingFocusState);
        return;
      }
      if (CartItems.#pendingFocusStates.get(this.id) === pendingFocusState) {
        CartItems.#pendingFocusStates.delete(this.id);
      }
      if (signal.aborted) return;
      onRollback?.();
      this.#settleQuantityMutation(lineKey, controller);
      // Cart error toast feedback is owned by the Standard Actions override.
      // Don't duplicate the announcement on [data-cart-status].
    }
  }

  async #applyDiscount(code) {
    code = code?.trim();
    if (!code) return;

    this.#discountAc?.abort();
    this.#discountAc = new AbortController();
    const { signal } = this.#discountAc;

    this.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
    try {
      const result = await window.Shopify.actions.updateCart(
        { discountCodes: [code] },
        { event: { context: 'cart' }, signal }
      );
      const userError = result?.userErrors?.[0]?.message;
      if (userError) throw new Error(userError, { cause: { userErrors: result.userErrors } });
      if (signal.aborted) return;
      this.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
    } catch (error) {
      if (signal.aborted) return;
      this.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
    }
  }

  async #updateNote(note) {
    this.#noteAc?.abort();
    this.#noteAc = new AbortController();
    const { signal } = this.#noteAc;

    this.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
    try {
      await window.Shopify.actions.updateCart(
        { note },
        { event: { context: 'cart' }, signal }
      );
      if (signal.aborted) return;
      this.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
    } catch (error) {
      if (signal.aborted) return;
      this.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
    }
  }

}

if (!customElements.get('s-cart')) {
  customElements.define('s-cart', CartItems);
}


================ FILE: assets/s-dialog.js ================

/**
 * <s-dialog> — Dialog Web Component
 * Handles backdrop-click-to-close for native <dialog> modals.
 * Open/close and password visibility are driven by Invoker Commands.
 *
 * Focus management (WCAG 2.4.3):
 *   Captures the native show-modal command source or the active element for a
 *   programmatic showModal(), then restores the original or same-ID replacement.
 *
 * Attributes:
 *   close-on-navigate — close the dialog when an <a> inside it is clicked
 *                       (useful with client-side navigation)
 *   open-on-connect   — open modally after connection (for server-returned feedback)
 *   reset-on-close    — reset forms, password visibility, and marked error state
 *
 * Commands:
 *   --toggle-password — toggle the password input named by event.source aria-controls
 */
class SDialog extends HTMLElement {
  #dialog;
  #ac;
  #triggerElement = null;
  #triggerElementId = null;
  #originalShowModal = null;

  connectedCallback() {
    this.#dialog = this.querySelector('dialog');
    if (!this.#dialog) return;

    this.#ac = new AbortController();
    const opts = { signal: this.#ac.signal };

    this.#interceptShowModal();

    // CommandEvent does not bubble, so capture its source on the controlled dialog.
    this.#dialog.addEventListener('command', (e) => {
      if (!(e.source instanceof HTMLElement)) return;

      if (e.command === 'show-modal') {
        this.#triggerElement = e.source;
        this.#triggerElementId = e.source.id || null;
        return;
      }

      if (e.command === '--toggle-password') {
        e.preventDefault();
        this.#togglePassword(e.source);
      }
    }, opts);

    this.#dialog.addEventListener('close', () => {
      if (this.hasAttribute('reset-on-close')) this.#resetContent();
      this.#restoreFocus();
    }, opts);

    this.#dialog.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target === this.#dialog) this.#dialog.close();
    }, opts);

    this.#setupBreakpointListener();

    if (this.hasAttribute('close-on-navigate')) {
      this.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target.closest('a')) this.#dialog.close();
      }, opts);
    }

    if (this.hasAttribute('open-on-connect') && !this.#dialog.open) {
      this.#dialog.showModal();
    }
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.#ac?.abort();
    // Restore original showModal to support reconnect (DOM move)
    if (this.#dialog && this.#originalShowModal) {
      this.#dialog.showModal = this.#originalShowModal;
      this.#originalShowModal = null;
    }
  }

  #interceptShowModal() {
    if (this.#originalShowModal) return;
    this.#originalShowModal = this.#dialog.showModal.bind(this.#dialog);
    this.#dialog.showModal = (...args) => {
      const activeElement = document.activeElement;
      if (
        activeElement instanceof HTMLElement
        && activeElement !== document.body
        && activeElement !== document.documentElement
        && !this.#triggerElement
      ) {
        this.#triggerElement = activeElement;
        this.#triggerElementId = activeElement.id || null;
      }
      return this.#originalShowModal(...args);
    };
  }

  #togglePassword(source) {
    const inputId = source.getAttribute('aria-controls');
    const input = inputId ? document.getElementById(inputId) : null;
    if (!(input instanceof HTMLInputElement) || !this.#dialog.contains(input)) return;
    if (input.type !== 'password' && input.type !== 'text') return;

    const reveal = input.type === 'password';
    const label = reveal ? source.dataset.hideLabel : source.dataset.showLabel;
    input.type = reveal ? 'text' : 'password';
    source.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(reveal));

    const labelElement = source.querySelector('[data-password-toggle-label]');
    if (label && labelElement) labelElement.textContent = label;
  }

  #resetContent() {
    const form = this.#dialog.closest('form');
    form?.reset();

    for (const source of this.#dialog.querySelectorAll('button[command="--toggle-password"]')) {
      const inputId = source.getAttribute('aria-controls');
      const input = inputId ? document.getElementById(inputId) : null;
      if (input instanceof HTMLInputElement && this.#dialog.contains(input)) input.type = 'password';
      source.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');

      const label = source.dataset.showLabel;
      const labelElement = source.querySelector('[data-password-toggle-label]');
      if (label && labelElement) labelElement.textContent = label;
    }

    const errors = [...this.#dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-dialog-error]')];
    const errorIds = new Set(errors.map((error) => error.id).filter(Boolean));
    for (const error of errors) error.hidden = true;

    for (const control of this.#dialog.querySelectorAll('[aria-invalid="true"]')) {
      control.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
      const describedBy = (control.getAttribute('aria-describedby') || '')
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter((id) => id && !errorIds.has(id));
      if (describedBy.length > 0) control.setAttribute('aria-describedby', describedBy.join(' '));
      else control.removeAttribute('aria-describedby');
    }
  }

  #restoreFocus() {
    const trigger = this.#triggerElement;
    const triggerId = this.#triggerElementId;
    this.#triggerElement = null;
    this.#triggerElementId = null;

    if (this.#canRestoreFocus(trigger)) {
      trigger.focus();
      return;
    }

    const replacement = triggerId ? document.getElementById(triggerId) : null;
    if (this.#canRestoreFocus(replacement)) replacement.focus();
  }

  #canRestoreFocus(element) {
    return element instanceof HTMLElement
      && element.isConnected
      && element !== document.body
      && element !== document.documentElement
      && !element.hidden;
  }

  #setupBreakpointListener() {
    const breakpoints = { sm: '40rem', md: '48rem', lg: '64rem', xl: '80rem' };

    for (const [bp, width] of Object.entries(breakpoints)) {
      if (this.#dialog.classList.contains(`${bp}:hidden`)) {
        const mq = window.matchMedia(`(min-width: ${width})`);
        const handler = (e) => { if (e.matches && this.#dialog.open) this.#dialog.close(); };
        mq.addEventListener('change', handler);
        this.#ac.signal.addEventListener('abort', () => mq.removeEventListener('change', handler));
        return;
      }
      if (this.#dialog.classList.contains(`max-${bp}:hidden`)) {
        const mq = window.matchMedia(`(width < ${width})`);
        const handler = (e) => { if (e.matches && this.#dialog.open) this.#dialog.close(); };
        mq.addEventListener('change', handler);
        this.#ac.signal.addEventListener('abort', () => mq.removeEventListener('change', handler));
        return;
      }
    }
  }
}

customElements.define('s-dialog', SDialog);


================ FILE: assets/s-gift-card.js ================

class SGiftCard extends HTMLElement {
  #ac;
  #announcementFrame;
  #copyResetTimer;
  #motionFrame;
  #motionSurface;
  #pointerPosition;

  connectedCallback() {
    this.#ac?.abort();
    this.#ac = new AbortController();
    const options = { signal: this.#ac.signal };

    this.addEventListener('command', (event) => {
      if (event.command === '--copy-code') this.#copyCode(event.source);
    }, options);

    this.#motionSurface = this.querySelector('[data-gift-card-motion]');
    const visual = this.querySelector('[data-gift-card-visual]');
    const reducedMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
    const finePointer = window.matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)');

    if (!visual || !this.#motionSurface) return;

    const resetMotion = () => this.#resetMotion();
    const syncMotion = () => {
      if (reducedMotion.matches || !finePointer.matches) resetMotion();
    };

    visual.addEventListener('pointermove', (event) => {
      if (event.pointerType === 'touch' || reducedMotion.matches || !finePointer.matches) return;

      this.#pointerPosition = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY };
      if (this.#motionFrame) return;

      this.#motionFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        this.#motionFrame = undefined;
        const bounds = visual.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (!this.#pointerPosition || bounds.width === 0 || bounds.height === 0) return;

        const x = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, ((this.#pointerPosition.x - bounds.left) / bounds.width - 0.5) * 2));
        const y = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, ((this.#pointerPosition.y - bounds.top) / bounds.height - 0.5) * 2));
        this.#motionSurface?.style.setProperty('--gift-card-rx', `${(10 - y * 4).toFixed(2)}deg`);
        this.#motionSurface?.style.setProperty('--gift-card-ry', `${(-3 + x * 4).toFixed(2)}deg`);
      });
    }, { ...options, passive: true });
    visual.addEventListener('pointerleave', resetMotion, options);
    visual.addEventListener('pointercancel', resetMotion, options);
    reducedMotion.addEventListener('change', syncMotion, options);
    finePointer.addEventListener('change', syncMotion, options);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.#ac?.abort();
    clearTimeout(this.#copyResetTimer);
    cancelAnimationFrame(this.#announcementFrame);
    cancelAnimationFrame(this.#motionFrame);

    const copyButton = this.querySelector('button[command="--copy-code"]');
    copyButton?.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
    if (copyButton && this.dataset.copyLabel) copyButton.textContent = this.dataset.copyLabel;

    this.#resetMotion();
  }

  async #copyCode(source) {
    if (!(source instanceof HTMLButtonElement) || source.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true') return;
    if (source.getAttribute('aria-busy') === 'true') return;

    const code = this.dataset.code?.trim();
    const feedback = this.querySelector('[data-gift-card-feedback]');
    if (!code || !feedback) return;

    source.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
    const signal = this.#ac.signal;
    let copied = false;

    try {
      // Only a real write counts: without this guard `await undefined` would resolve silently
      // where the Clipboard API is absent, and the selection fallback would never run.
      if (typeof navigator.clipboard?.writeText === 'function') {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(code);
        copied = true;
      }
    } catch {
      copied = false;
    }

    if (!copied && !signal.aborted) {
      copied = this.#copyWithSelection(code);
      if (source.isConnected) source.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }
    if (signal.aborted) return;

    source.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
    clearTimeout(this.#copyResetTimer);

    if (copied) {
      source.textContent = this.dataset.copySuccess;
      this.#announce(feedback, this.dataset.copySuccess);
      this.#copyResetTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
        if (!source.isConnected) return;
        source.textContent = this.dataset.copyLabel;
      }, 1600);
    } else {
      this.#selectVisibleCode();
      source.textContent = this.dataset.copyLabel;
      this.#announce(feedback, this.dataset.copyError);
    }
  }

  #copyWithSelection(code) {
    const input = document.createElement('textarea');
    input.value = code;
    input.tabIndex = -1;
    input.className = 'fixed start-[-9999px] opacity-0';
    document.body.append(input);

    try {
      input.select();
      return document.execCommand?.('copy') === true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    } finally {
      input.remove();
    }
  }

  #selectVisibleCode() {
    const code = this.querySelector('code');
    if (!code) return;

    const selection = window.getSelection();
    if (!selection) return;

    const range = document.createRange();
    range.selectNodeContents(code);
    selection.removeAllRanges();
    selection.addRange(range);
  }

  #announce(region, message) {
    cancelAnimationFrame(this.#announcementFrame);
    region.textContent = '';
    this.#announcementFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      if (region.isConnected) region.textContent = message || '';
    });
  }

  #resetMotion() {
    cancelAnimationFrame(this.#motionFrame);
    this.#motionFrame = undefined;
    this.#pointerPosition = undefined;
    this.#motionSurface?.style.removeProperty('--gift-card-rx');
    this.#motionSurface?.style.removeProperty('--gift-card-ry');
  }
}

customElements.define('s-gift-card', SGiftCard);


================ FILE: assets/s-live-form.js ================

import { partials } from '@shopify/partial-rendering';
import { CollectionUpdateEvent, SearchUpdateEvent } from '@shopify/standard-events';
import { transition } from '@theme/view-transition';
import { announceGlobalLiveRegion } from '@theme/live-region';

/**
 * <s-live-form> — Wraps a <form> and re-fetches one or more partials on every input/change
 * event, keeping collection and search results in sync without a full page reload.
 *
 * Attributes (on <s-live-form>):
 *   partial    — Comma-separated list of {% partial 'name' %} region names to fetch/apply.
 *                Must exactly match the partial wrappers in templates/search.liquid or
 *                blocks/predictive-search.liquid — renaming either side silently breaks
 *                live updates.
 *   data-no-url-sync — Uses the form action as the request URL base without changing browser
 *                      history. User-initiated submits continue as native navigation.
 *   native-submit — If present, skips partial rendering and allows explicit submits to
 *                   continue natively. Select/checkbox changes do not auto-submit.
 *   data-canonical-origin — Optional canonical origin (protocol + host) for native-submit forms.
 *                           Resolves the form's existing action against this origin for theme-dev
 *                           workarounds without hardcoding endpoint paths in JS.
 *   debounce   — Debounce delay in ms for text `input` events (default 0 = immediate).
 *   data-updated-message — i18n string announced via #sr-announcer on success.
 *   data-error-message   — i18n string announced via #sr-announcer on fetch failure.
 *
 * Required child markup:
 *   form                      — The form element driving submissions; required.
 *   [name]                    — Any named input/select/checkbox whose values are serialized
 *                               into the request URL. `name` must match the URL param the
 *                               server-side Liquid template accepts (e.g. `q`, `sort_by`, `filter.v.*`)
 *                               — renaming breaks round-trip state rehydration.
 *
 * Update triggers:
 *   input event on text inputs — Debounced by `debounce` ms (0 = immediate). Keeps typing in
 *                                query fields to one fetch/replaceState per pause instead of
 *                                one per keystroke.
 *   change on select/checkbox  — Immediate form.requestSubmit() for partial-rendering forms;
 *                                native-submit forms wait for an explicit submit button.
 *   change on text inputs      — Commit points (focus-out/Enter) flush a pending debounced
 *                                submit immediately; no-op when the debounce already fired.
 *   [data-clear-search] press  — Cancels the pending debounced submit at pointerdown (ahead
 *                                of the focus-out change-commit flush) and again on click, then
 *                                clears input[name="q"] and re-dispatches input. For pointer
 *                                activation and focus-preserving activation (AT/synthetic click
 *                                with no prior focus shift out of an edited q), only the cleared
 *                                state fetches — never the abandoned typed query. Keyboard
 *                                Tab→Enter is a two-step commit: Tabbing off an edited q fires
 *                                the change-commit flush (fetching the typed value) before the
 *                                button can cancel it, then Enter fetches the cleared state.
 *                                Two fetches, correct cleared final state — baseline-equivalent.
 *   form submit                — Cancels any pending debounced submit, then: remote-action
 *                                forms get native navigation on user-initiated submits;
 *                                partial rendering on programmatic submits.
 *
 * Dispatches:
 *   s-live-form:updated — Bubbles after a successful partial apply.
 *
 * External coupling:
 *   aria-busy attribute (on self) — Set to "true" during fetch, removed on completion.
 *   history.replaceState          — URL updated with serialized form params (local forms only).
 *   #sr-announcer (global)        — Live region for success/error announcements.
 */
// The `partial` HTML attribute is a comma-separated list of {% partial 'name' %} region names
// in the server-rendered page. These strings are a naming contract: renaming a partial on
// either the Liquid side (templates/search.liquid, blocks/predictive-search.liquid) or here
// will silently break partial-rendering updates.
class LiveForm extends HTMLElement {
  #timer;
  #programmatic = false;
  #ac;
  #abortController;
  #firstApplyComplete = false;

  connectedCallback() {
    this.#ac = new AbortController();
    const opts = { signal: this.#ac.signal };

    const debounce = parseInt(this.getAttribute('debounce'), 10) || 0;
    const nativeSubmit = this.hasAttribute('native-submit');
    const form = this.querySelector('form');
    if (!(form instanceof HTMLFormElement)) return;

    // Rehydration: restore URL-param-driven form controls from the URL query string.
    // Skip rehydration for native-submit POST forms — their state is server-rendered,
    // not URL state. Limit rehydration to value-bearing controls to avoid overwriting
    // submit button values (e.g. localization form country_code buttons).
    if (!nativeSubmit) {
      const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const valueControls = 'input:not([type=submit]):not([type=button]):not([type=hidden]), select, textarea';
      for (const el of this.querySelectorAll(valueControls)) {
        if (el.type === 'checkbox' || el.type === 'radio') {
          const values = params.getAll(el.name);
          el.checked = values.includes(el.value);
        } else {
          this.#applyRehydratedValue(el, params.get(el.name));
        }
      }
    }

    // Single update path — all events funnel through form submit
    form.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
      // A submit supersedes any pending debounced text edit; without this an
      // Enter-committed value would fetch again when the stale timer fired.
      this.#clearTimer();
      if (nativeSubmit) {
        this.#programmatic = false;
        // Change only the origin so Shopify remains the source of truth for the action path.
        if (this.dataset.canonicalOrigin) {
          const action = new URL(form.action);
          form.action = this.dataset.canonicalOrigin + action.pathname + action.search + action.hash;
        }
        return;
      }

      // For remote forms (action differs from current page), let user-initiated
      // submits (Enter key) navigate natively. Programmatic submits from
      // input/change handlers still do partial rendering.
      if (!this.#programmatic) {
        const actionUrl = new URL(form.action);
        const currentUrl = new URL(window.location.href);
        const isRemote = actionUrl.origin !== currentUrl.origin || actionUrl.pathname !== currentUrl.pathname;
        if (isRemote || this.hasAttribute('data-no-url-sync')) return;
      }
      this.#programmatic = false;
      e.preventDefault();
      this.#update();
    }, opts);

    // Text inputs: debounced
    this.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
      const target = e.target;
      if (!(target instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
      // Selects and checkboxes submit from the change handler below.
      if (target.matches('select, input[type="checkbox"]')) return;
      this.#clearTimer();
      if (debounce) {
        this.#timer = setTimeout(() => {
          this.#timer = null;
          this.#programmatic = true;
          form.requestSubmit();
        }, debounce);
        return;
      }

      this.#programmatic = true;
      form.requestSubmit();
    }, opts);

    // Selects & checkboxes: immediate for partial-rendering forms, explicit submission
    // required for native-submit forms. Text inputs: `change` (focus-out/Enter commit)
    // flushes a pending debounced submit so committed edits apply without waiting.
    this.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
      const target = e.target;
      if (!(target instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
      if (target.matches('select, input[type="checkbox"]')) {
        this.#clearTimer();
        if (nativeSubmit) return;
        this.#programmatic = true;
        form.requestSubmit();
        return;
      }
      // Only flush when a debounce timer is still pending; otherwise the
      // debounced submit already ran and losing focus must not fetch again.
      if (this.#timer != null) {
        this.#clearTimer();
        this.#programmatic = true;
        form.requestSubmit();
      }
    }, opts);

    // Clear button: resets the search input and re-triggers the input handler
    // (preserving the debounce/fetch flow). Scoped via `[data-clear-search]`
    // so consumers opt in declaratively instead of wiring inline onclick.
    // Pressing clear abandons the typed query: cancel the pending debounce at
    // pointerdown, before the focus shift fires the change-commit flush, so
    // the abandoned value never fetches ahead of the cleared submit below.
    this.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
      if (!e.target.closest('[data-clear-search]')) return;
      this.#clearTimer();
    }, opts);

    this.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (!e.target.closest('[data-clear-search]')) return;
      const input = form.querySelector('input[name="q"]');
      if (!input) return;
      // Keyboard/AT activation skips pointerdown: cancel any still-pending
      // debounce before dispatching the cleared input so the abandoned query
      // cannot submit. Note: when keyboard focus departs an edited q (Tab to
      // this button), the change-commit flush has already fetched the typed
      // value before this handler can cancel — the clear then fetches the
      // cleared state as a second, final step.
      this.#clearTimer();
      input.value = '';
      input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
      // Return focus to the input: the natural continuation is typing a new query.
      input.focus();
    }, opts);

  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.#ac?.abort();
    this.#abortController?.abort();
    this.#clearTimer();
  }

  // #timer doubles as pending-debounce state: non-null only while a debounced
  // submit is scheduled, so a change commit can tell "flush now" from "already ran".
  #clearTimer() {
    clearTimeout(this.#timer);
    this.#timer = null;
  }

  // URLSearchParams has already decoded the param, so encoded punctuation such
  // as %26 ("&") is legitimate data — restore it verbatim, never truncate it.
  // For single selects, only apply values that match an option so a malformed URL
  // cannot blank the server-rendered selection.
  #applyRehydratedValue(el, value) {
    if (value == null) return;
    const stringValue = String(value);
    if (!stringValue.trim()) return;
    if (el instanceof HTMLSelectElement && ![...el.options].some((option) => option.value === stringValue)) {
      return;
    }
    el.value = stringValue;
  }

  async #update() {
    // Abort stale response so fast typing can't let an earlier result overwrite a fresher one
    this.#abortController?.abort();
    this.#abortController = new AbortController();
    const { signal } = this.#abortController; // capture before any yield

    const form = this.querySelector('form');
    if (!form) return;

    const actionUrl = new URL(form.action);
    const currentUrl = new URL(window.location.href);
    const isRemote = actionUrl.origin !== currentUrl.origin || actionUrl.pathname !== currentUrl.pathname;
    const syncUrl = !isRemote && !this.hasAttribute('data-no-url-sync');
    const url = syncUrl ? new URL(window.location) : new URL(actionUrl);
    const data = new FormData(form);

    // Clean up any existing form-related parameters first
    for (const el of this.querySelectorAll('[name]')) {
      url.searchParams.delete(el.name);
    }
    // Every live query update starts at page 1. Preserve direct URL parameters not
    // owned by this form so Standard Events still reflect active platform state.
    url.searchParams.delete('page');

    for (const [name, value] of data) {
      const normalizedValue = String(value).trim();
      if (normalizedValue) url.searchParams.append(name, normalizedValue);
    }

    const attr = this.getAttribute('partial');
    if (!attr) return;

    if (syncUrl) {
      // Yield a task so the browser can paint before the URL update — and so a
      // change-flush + implicit-submit pair (Enter commit) intentionally aborts
      // this pass via `signal`, coalescing to one fetch/replaceState.
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 0));
      if (signal.aborted) return;
      history.replaceState(history.state, '', url);
    }

    this.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');

    const pendingEvent = this.#dispatchStandardEvent(url);

    try {
      const names = attr.split(/\s*,\s*/);
      // @partial-fetch-contract attributes=partial
      const html = await partials.fetch(...names, { url: url.toString(), signal });
      // Supersession check: abort landed after fetch resolved but before transition.
      if (signal.aborted) {
        pendingEvent?.reject(new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError'));
        return;
      }

      // Record focused element before partial replacement for potential focus restoration
      const activeBeforeApply = document.activeElement;
      const hadFocusInside = this.contains(activeBeforeApply);
      const focusedId = activeBeforeApply instanceof HTMLElement ? activeBeforeApply.id : '';
      const focusedName = activeBeforeApply instanceof HTMLInputElement ? activeBeforeApply.name : '';
      const focusedValue = activeBeforeApply instanceof HTMLInputElement ? activeBeforeApply.value : '';

      await transition(() => {
        // Supersession check: apply only when this update is still current.
        if (signal.aborted) return;
        partials.apply(html);
      });

      // Supersession check: clear busy state, resolve events, and announce only when current.
      if (!signal.aborted) {
        // Restore focus if it was inside this component and is now lost
        if (hadFocusInside && activeBeforeApply instanceof HTMLElement) {
          const focusNowLost = !activeBeforeApply.isConnected || document.activeElement === document.body;
          if (focusNowLost) {
            // Reconnect focus to the equivalent control when a sort toolbar or an open
            // filter drawer's value list is patched. Never send dialog focus to q.
            const candidate = focusedId ? document.getElementById(focusedId) : null;
            const byId = candidate && this.contains(candidate) ? candidate : null;
            const byValue = focusedName
              ? [...this.querySelectorAll('input[name]')].find((input) => input.name === focusedName && input.value === focusedValue)
              : null;
            const fallback = this.querySelector('dialog[open] button[command="close"]')
              ?? form?.querySelector('input[name="q"]')
              ?? form?.querySelector('button[command="show-modal"]');
            (byId ?? byValue ?? fallback)?.focus();
          }
        }

        this.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
        pendingEvent?.resolve();

        // Schedule dedicated/generic announcement BEFORE dispatching updated event, so
        // synchronous listeners (e.g. s-predictive-search) can supersede through live-region cancellation.
        const liveAnnounce = this.querySelector('[data-live-announce]');
        const message = liveAnnounce ? liveAnnounce.textContent.trim() : this.dataset.updatedMessage;
        announceGlobalLiveRegion(message);

        this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('s-live-form:updated', { bubbles: true }));

        // After the first successful apply, mark settled to skip stagger reveal on subsequent refreshes.
        if (!this.#firstApplyComplete) {
          this.#firstApplyComplete = true;
          this.setAttribute('data-stagger-settled', '');
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      pendingEvent?.reject(error);
      if (error.name === 'AbortError') return;
      this.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
      console.error('[s-live-form] Partial fetch failed:', error);
      announceGlobalLiveRegion(this.dataset.errorMessage);
    }
  }

  #dispatchStandardEvent(url) {
    if (this.dataset.collectionId && this.dataset.collectionHandle) {
      const deferredPromise = CollectionUpdateEvent.createPromise();
      const productFilters = CollectionUpdateEvent.parseProductFilters(url.searchParams);
      this.dispatchEvent(new CollectionUpdateEvent({
        collection: {
          id: this.dataset.collectionId,
          handle: this.dataset.collectionHandle,
          productsCount: this.#getResultsCount(),
        },
        ...(productFilters && { productFilters }),
        sortKey: CollectionUpdateEvent.getSortKey(url.searchParams),
        promise: deferredPromise.promise,
      }));
      return {
        resolve: () => deferredPromise.resolve({ productsCount: this.#getResultsCount() }),
        reject: (error) => deferredPromise.reject(error),
      };
    }

    const isPredictive = !!this.closest('s-predictive-search');
    const query = url.searchParams.get('q')?.trim() || '';
    if (!query) return;

    const deferredPromise = SearchUpdateEvent.createPromise();
    const productFilters = isPredictive
      ? undefined
      : SearchUpdateEvent.parseProductFilters(url.searchParams);

    this.dispatchEvent(
      new SearchUpdateEvent({
        search: {
          query,
          ...(productFilters && { productFilters }),
          sortKey: isPredictive ? undefined : SearchUpdateEvent.getSortKey(url.searchParams),
        },
        promise: deferredPromise.promise,
      })
    );

    return {
      resolve: () => deferredPromise.resolve({ totalCount: this.#getResultsCount() }),
      reject: (error) => deferredPromise.reject(error),
    };
  }

  #getResultsCount() {
    const marker = this.querySelector('[data-results-count]');
    return Number(marker?.textContent || 0);
  }
}
customElements.define('s-live-form', LiveForm);


================ FILE: assets/s-localization-dropdown.js ================

class LocalizationDropdown extends HTMLElement {
  #ac;
  #closingAnimation;
  #outsideAc;

  connectedCallback() {
    this.#ac = new AbortController();
    const opts = { signal: this.#ac.signal };

    this.addEventListener('command', (event) => {
      if (event.command === '--toggle') this.#toggle();
    }, opts);

    this.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
      if (event.key !== 'Escape' || this.#isHidden) return;
      event.stopPropagation();
      void this.#hide();
      this.#button?.focus();
    }, opts);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.#ac?.abort();
    this.#removeOutsideListeners();
    this.#closingAnimation?.cancel();
  }

  get #button() {
    return this.querySelector('[data-localization-trigger]');
  }

  get #panel() {
    return this.querySelector('[data-localization-panel]');
  }

  get #isHidden() {
    return this.#panel?.hasAttribute('hidden') ?? true;
  }

  #toggle() {
    if (this.#isHidden) {
      this.#show();
    } else {
      void this.#hide();
    }
  }

  #show() {
    const panel = this.#panel;
    const button = this.#button;
    if (!panel || !button || !this.#isHidden) return;

    this.#closingAnimation?.cancel();
    this.#closingAnimation = null;
    panel.removeAttribute('hidden');
    button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    this.#addOutsideListeners();

    if (this.#prefersReducedMotion() || typeof panel.animate !== 'function') return;

    try {
      panel.animate(
        [
          { opacity: 0, transform: 'translateY(20px)' },
          { opacity: 1, transform: 'translateY(0)' },
        ],
        { duration: 220, easing: this.#uiEasing() }
      );
    } catch {
      // Keep the panel open if WAAPI rejects an easing value in an older browser.
    }
  }

  async #hide() {
    const panel = this.#panel;
    const button = this.#button;
    if (!panel || !button || this.#isHidden) return;

    this.#removeOutsideListeners();
    button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');

    if (this.#prefersReducedMotion() || typeof panel.animate !== 'function') {
      panel.setAttribute('hidden', '');
      return;
    }

    this.#closingAnimation?.cancel();
    let animation;

    try {
      animation = panel.animate(
        [
          { opacity: 1, transform: 'translateY(0)' },
          { opacity: 0, transform: 'translateY(12px)' },
        ],
        { duration: 150, easing: this.#uiEasing() }
      );
    } catch {
      panel.setAttribute('hidden', '');
      return;
    }

    this.#closingAnimation = animation;

    try {
      await animation.finished;
    } catch {
      return;
    }

    if (this.#closingAnimation !== animation) return;
    this.#closingAnimation = null;
    panel.setAttribute('hidden', '');
  }

  #addOutsideListeners() {
    this.#removeOutsideListeners();
    this.#outsideAc = new AbortController();
    const opts = { capture: true, signal: this.#outsideAc.signal };

    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', this.#onOutsideInteraction, opts);
    document.addEventListener('click', this.#onOutsideInteraction, opts);
  }

  #onOutsideInteraction = (event) => {
    if (event.target instanceof Node && this.contains(event.target)) return;
    void this.#hide();
  };

  #removeOutsideListeners() {
    this.#outsideAc?.abort();
    this.#outsideAc = null;
  }

  #prefersReducedMotion() {
    return window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  }

  #uiEasing() {
    return getComputedStyle(this).getPropertyValue('--ease-ui').trim() || 'cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)';
  }
}

customElements.define('s-localization-dropdown', LocalizationDropdown);


================ FILE: assets/s-mobile-nav.js ================

/**
 * <s-mobile-nav> — Stacked panel navigation inside a modal dialog.
 * Shows one panel at a time, pushes child panels onto a stack, pops back via
 * --pop, and syncs the dialog's contextual title + back button with the active panel.
 *
 * Commands (dispatched via commandfor/command on descendant buttons):
 *   --pop — Pop the current panel off the stack and restore the previous one.
 *
 * Required ancestor markup:
 *   <dialog> — Must be a <dialog> ancestor (closest('dialog')); otherwise the header
 *              title/back button lookups silently no-op. The dialog's 'close' event
 *              triggers a reset to the root panel.
 *
 * Required DOM inside the dialog (queried via dialog.querySelector):
 *   #mobile-nav-title  — Text node hidden at the root and showing a nested panel's title.
 *                       Its initial text labels the dialog through aria-labelledby.
 *   #mobile-nav-back   — Back button; display toggled based on stack depth.
 *
 * Required child markup inside <s-mobile-nav>:
 *   [id$="-root"]                    — The root panel (required for stack init).
 *   [id^="mobile-nav-panel-"]        — Nested panels (targets of push/pop navigation).
 *   [data-mobile-nav-push]           — Button that pushes a panel. Value = target panel id.
 *                                      aria-expanded is toggled here to expose open/closed state.
 *   [data-panel-title]               — Optional title shown in the dialog header while active.
 *   <details> / <summary> / <ul>     — Optional disclosures with animated height transitions.
 *
 * Direction:
 *   Panels park with paired transform utilities that mirror in RTL.
 *   The entrance animation reads the resolved direction once so
 *   a pushed panel always slides in from the reading-forward side.
 *
 * External coupling:
 *   None — panel hidden state is driven by this component only.
 */
class SMobileNav extends HTMLElement {
  #stack = [];
  #titleEl;
  #backBtn;
  #defaultTitle;
  #ac;
  #rafIds = new Set();
  #animatingContent = new Set();
  // 1 in LTR, -1 in RTL; multiplies the inline-axis entrance offset.
  #inlineDirection = 1;

  connectedCallback() {
    this.#ac = new AbortController();
    const opts = { signal: this.#ac.signal };
    this.#inlineDirection = getComputedStyle(this).direction === 'rtl' ? -1 : 1;

    const dialog = this.closest('dialog');
    this.#titleEl = dialog?.querySelector('#mobile-nav-title');
    this.#backBtn = dialog?.querySelector('#mobile-nav-back');
    this.#defaultTitle = this.#titleEl?.textContent ?? '';

    const rootPanel = this.querySelector('[id$="-root"]');
    this.#stack = [{ panelId: rootPanel?.id, title: '' }];

    // Only one panel is rendered at a time so stale off-screen transforms cannot overlap.
    for (const panel of this.#panels()) {
      panel.id === rootPanel?.id ? this.#showPanel(panel) : this.#hidePanel(panel);
    }
    this.#updateHeader();

    this.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const btn = e.target.closest('[data-mobile-nav-push]');
      if (btn) this.#push(btn.dataset.mobileNavPush, btn.dataset.panelTitle || '', btn);
    }, opts);

    this.addEventListener('command', (e) => {
      if (e.command === '--pop') this.#pop();
    }, opts);

    for (const details of this.querySelectorAll('details')) {
      this.#animateDetails(details, opts);
    }

    dialog?.addEventListener('close', () => this.#reset(), opts);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.#ac?.abort();
    for (const id of this.#rafIds) cancelAnimationFrame(id);
    this.#rafIds.clear();
    for (const content of this.#animatingContent) {
      content.style.height = '';
      content.classList.remove('transition-[height]', 'duration-180', 'duration-250', 'ease-ui');
    }
    this.#animatingContent.clear();
  }

  #updateHeader() {
    if (!this.#backBtn || !this.#titleEl) return;
    const atRoot = this.#stack.length <= 1;
    this.#backBtn.classList.toggle('hidden', atRoot);
    this.#backBtn.classList.toggle('flex', !atRoot);
    this.#titleEl.textContent = atRoot ? this.#defaultTitle : this.#stack.at(-1).title;
    this.#titleEl.classList.toggle('hidden', atRoot);
  }

  #focusFirst(panel) {
    panel.querySelector('a[href], button:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), select:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])')?.focus();
  }

  #panels() {
    return this.querySelectorAll('[id$="-root"], [id^="mobile-nav-panel-"]');
  }

  #showPanel(panel) {
    panel.hidden = false;
    panel.classList.remove('transform-[translateX(100%)]', 'rtl:transform-[translateX(-100%)]');
    panel.classList.add('transform-[translateX(0)]');
    panel.inert = false;
  }

  #hidePanel(panel) {
    panel.hidden = true;
    panel.classList.remove('transform-[translateX(0)]');
    panel.classList.add('transform-[translateX(100%)]', 'rtl:transform-[translateX(-100%)]');
    panel.inert = true;
  }

  #showOnly(panel) {
    for (const candidate of this.#panels()) {
      candidate === panel ? this.#showPanel(candidate) : this.#hidePanel(candidate);
    }
  }

  #animatePanelIn(panel, direction) {
    if (this.#prefersReducedMotion()) return;

    for (const animation of panel.getAnimations()) animation.cancel();
    panel.animate([
      { opacity: 0, transform: `translateX(${direction * this.#inlineDirection * 16}px)` },
      { opacity: 1, transform: 'translateX(0)' },
    ], { duration: 220, easing: this.#uiEasing() });
  }

  #push(panelId, title, trigger) {
    const current = this.querySelector(`#${CSS.escape(this.#stack.at(-1).panelId)}`);
    const next = this.querySelector(`#${CSS.escape(panelId)}`);
    if (!current || !next || current === next) return;
    this.#showOnly(next); // must be before #focusFirst — hidden/inert blocks .focus()
    this.#animatePanelIn(next, 1);
    trigger?.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    this.#stack.push({ panelId, title, trigger });
    this.#updateHeader();
    this.#focusFirst(next);
  }

  #pop() {
    if (this.#stack.length <= 1) return;
    const leaving = this.#stack.at(-1);
    leaving.trigger?.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    const current = this.querySelector(`#${CSS.escape(leaving.panelId)}`);
    this.#stack.pop();
    const prev = this.querySelector(`#${CSS.escape(this.#stack.at(-1).panelId)}`);
    if (!current || !prev) return;
    this.#showOnly(prev); // must be before #focusFirst — hidden/inert blocks .focus()
    this.#animatePanelIn(prev, -1);
    this.#updateHeader();
    this.#focusFirst(prev);
  }

  #reset() {
    const rootId = this.#stack[0]?.panelId;
    for (const panel of this.#panels()) {
      panel.id === rootId ? this.#showPanel(panel) : this.#hidePanel(panel);
    }
    for (const btn of this.querySelectorAll('[data-mobile-nav-push]')) {
      btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    }
    this.#stack = [{ panelId: rootId, title: '' }];
    this.#updateHeader();
  }

  #prefersReducedMotion() {
    return window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  }

  #uiEasing() {
    return getComputedStyle(this).getPropertyValue('--ease-ui').trim() || 'cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)';
  }

  #animateDetails(details, { signal }) {
    const summary = details.querySelector('summary');
    const content = details.querySelector('ul');
    if (!summary || !content) return;
    content.classList.add('overflow-hidden');

    summary.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
        details.open ? details.removeAttribute('open') : details.setAttribute('open', '');
        return;
      }

      // One controller per animation: whichever of transitionend/transitioncancel
      // fires first removes both listeners, so stale handlers never target a
      // later animation's transition events.
      const animationAc = new AbortController();
      const cleanUp = () => {
        animationAc.abort();
        content.style.height = '';
        content.classList.remove('transition-[height]', 'duration-180', 'duration-250', 'ease-ui');
        this.#animatingContent.delete(content);
      };

      if (details.open) {
        // Closing: 0.18s
        content.style.height = `${content.scrollHeight}px`;
        this.#animatingContent.add(content);
        const outer = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          this.#rafIds.delete(outer);
          const inner = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            this.#rafIds.delete(inner);
            content.classList.remove('duration-250');
            content.classList.add('transition-[height]', 'duration-180', 'ease-ui');
            content.style.height = '0';
            content.addEventListener('transitionend', () => {
              details.removeAttribute('open');
              cleanUp();
            }, { once: true, signal: animationAc.signal });
            content.addEventListener('transitioncancel', () => {
              // If interrupted mid-close, restore to open state
              if (!details.open) details.setAttribute('open', '');
              cleanUp();
            }, { once: true, signal: animationAc.signal });
          });
          this.#rafIds.add(inner);
        });
        this.#rafIds.add(outer);
      } else {
        // Opening: 0.25s
        details.setAttribute('open', '');
        const h = content.scrollHeight;
        content.style.height = '0';
        this.#animatingContent.add(content);
        const outer = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          this.#rafIds.delete(outer);
          const inner = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            this.#rafIds.delete(inner);
            content.classList.remove('duration-180');
            content.classList.add('transition-[height]', 'duration-250', 'ease-ui');
            content.style.height = `${h}px`;
            content.addEventListener('transitionend', () => {
              cleanUp();
            }, { once: true, signal: animationAc.signal });
            content.addEventListener('transitioncancel', () => {
              // If interrupted mid-open, close the details
              if (details.open) details.removeAttribute('open');
              cleanUp();
            }, { once: true, signal: animationAc.signal });
          });
          this.#rafIds.add(inner);
        });
        this.#rafIds.add(outer);
      }
    }, { signal });
  }
}

customElements.define('s-mobile-nav', SMobileNav);


================ FILE: assets/s-nav-dropdown.js ================

/**
 * <s-nav-dropdown> — header navigation dropdown for a nav item that has a submenu.
 *
 * Each nav item that has children renders a plain link next to a separate toggle
 * button (`[data-nav-disclosure]`). The link goes to the item's page; the button
 * shows/hides the submenu. Keeping them separate means a keyboard or screen-reader
 * user who wants to open the submenu presses the button instead of accidentally
 * following the link.
 *
 * Required child markup:
 *   button[data-nav-disclosure] — the toggle button. Its `aria-controls` holds the
 *                                 `id` of the submenu it shows/hides; this component
 *                                 keeps its `aria-expanded` in sync with open state.
 *   .nav-dropdown               — top-level dropdown panel; `id` matches the top-level
 *                                 button's `aria-controls`.
 *   .nav-dropdown-submenu       — nested submenu panel; `id` matches its group's button
 *                                 `aria-controls`.
 *
 * How a submenu opens:
 *   - Mouse: hovering the item shows the submenu (handled entirely in CSS via `:hover`).
 *     This component only copies that hover state into `aria-expanded`.
 *   - Keyboard / click: pressing the toggle button sets `data-open` on the item's
 *     container, which the stylesheet uses to show the submenu.
 *   Moving keyboard focus onto an item never opens its submenu on its own — the button
 *   must be pressed. Escape closes the innermost open submenu and moves focus back to
 *   its button. Moving focus out of the component closes any submenus opened by button.
 */
class SNavDropdown extends HTMLElement {
  #ac;
  /** @type {Array<{ button: HTMLElement, container: HTMLElement, hovered: boolean, open: boolean }>} */
  #disclosures = [];

  connectedCallback() {
    // Reset instance collections to support reconnect (DOM move)
    this.#disclosures = [];
    this.#ac = new AbortController();
    const opts = { signal: this.#ac.signal };

    for (const button of this.querySelectorAll('[data-nav-disclosure]')) {
      if (!(button instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;
      const panelId = button.getAttribute('aria-controls');
      const panel = panelId ? this.querySelector(`[id="${panelId}"]`) : null;
      if (!panel) continue;

      // Nested disclosures live in a `.nav-dropdown-group`; the level-1 disclosure
      // toggles the whole component, so its container is the element itself.
      const container = button.closest('.nav-dropdown-group') ?? this;
      const disclosure = { button, container, hovered: false, open: false };
      this.#disclosures.push(disclosure);

      button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      button.addEventListener('click', () => this.#toggle(disclosure), opts);
      container.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => this.#setHovered(disclosure, true), opts);
      container.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => this.#setHovered(disclosure, false), opts);
    }

    this.addEventListener('keydown', this.#onKeyDown, opts);
    this.addEventListener('focusout', this.#onFocusOut, opts);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.#ac?.abort();
  }

  #toggle(disclosure) {
    disclosure.open = !disclosure.open;
    this.#sync(disclosure);
  }

  #setHovered(disclosure, hovered) {
    disclosure.hovered = hovered;
    this.#sync(disclosure);
    // Clear hover suppression when the pointer leaves.
    if (!hovered) {
      disclosure.container.removeAttribute('data-suppress-hover');
    }
  }

  /**
   * Reflect the current state onto the DOM. `aria-expanded` tracks whether the panel
   * is visible (hover or explicit open); `data-open` drives the keyboard/click reveal
   * that CSS honors alongside `:hover`.
   */
  #sync(disclosure) {
    disclosure.button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', disclosure.open || disclosure.hovered ? 'true' : 'false');
    disclosure.container.toggleAttribute('data-open', disclosure.open);
  }

  /**
   * Escape closes the innermost open panel and returns focus to its button.
   * If no panels are button-opened but some are hover-revealed, suppress the
   * hovered panel instead so pointer users can dismiss without moving the mouse.
   * @param {KeyboardEvent} event
   */
  #onKeyDown = (event) => {
    if (event.key !== 'Escape') return;

    const open = this.#disclosures.filter((disclosure) => disclosure.open);
    if (open.length > 0) {
      // Prefer the open panel that currently holds focus, then pick the innermost.
      const focused = open.filter((disclosure) => disclosure.container.contains(document.activeElement));
      const candidates = focused.length > 0 ? focused : open;
      const target = candidates.reduce((innermost, disclosure) =>
        innermost.container.contains(disclosure.container) ? disclosure : innermost
      );

      target.open = false;
      this.#sync(target);
      target.button.focus();
      event.stopPropagation();
      return;
    }

    // No button-opened panels; check for hover-revealed panels.
    const hovered = this.#disclosures.filter((disclosure) => disclosure.hovered);
    if (hovered.length === 0) return;

    // Prefer the hovered panel that currently holds focus, then pick the innermost.
    const focused = hovered.filter((disclosure) => disclosure.container.contains(document.activeElement));
    const candidates = focused.length > 0 ? focused : hovered;
    const target = candidates.reduce((innermost, disclosure) =>
      innermost.container.contains(disclosure.container) ? disclosure : innermost
    );

    // Suppress the hover reveal; it will be restored on mouseleave.
    target.container.setAttribute('data-suppress-hover', '');
    target.button.focus();
    event.stopPropagation();
  };

  /**
   * Close any button-opened panels once focus leaves the component entirely.
   * @param {FocusEvent} event
   */
  #onFocusOut = (event) => {
    if (event.relatedTarget instanceof Node && this.contains(event.relatedTarget)) return;
    for (const disclosure of this.#disclosures) {
      if (!disclosure.open) continue;
      disclosure.open = false;
      this.#sync(disclosure);
    }
  };
}

customElements.define('s-nav-dropdown', SNavDropdown);


================ FILE: assets/s-notification.js ================

/**
 * <s-notification> — Notification/Toast Web Component
 * Manages toast creation, stacking, auto-dismiss, and pause-on-hover.
 * Listen for `s-notification:add` events on `document` to create toasts.
 *
 * Accessibility:
 * - Each toast includes a visible close button with aria-label="Dismiss"
 * - Pressing Escape dismisses the most recent toast
 * - Each toast is its sole live-region owner: status for info/success/warning, alert for error
 * - Active-modal toasts use a nested popover portal so their controls are not inert
 * - Focus is not stolen from the user's current action
 */
class SNotification extends HTMLElement {
  #toasts = new Map();
  #modalStack = [];
  #isPaused = false;
  #ac;
  #dialogObserver;
  #portal;

  connectedCallback() {
    const pos = this.getAttribute('position') || 'bottom-right';
    this.dataset.position = pos;
    // The host is only a queue/positioning container; generated toasts own announcements.
    this.removeAttribute('role');
    this.removeAttribute('aria-live');

    this.#ac = new AbortController();
    const opts = { signal: this.#ac.signal };
    this.#portal = document.createElement('div');
    this.#portal.className = 'contents';
    this.#portal.dataset.notificationPortal = '';
    this.appendChild(this.#portal);

    document.addEventListener('s-notification:add', (e) => {
      const { message, variant = 'info', duration } = e.detail || {};
      if (!message) return;
      this.#createToast(message, variant, duration);
    }, opts);

    document.addEventListener('s-cart:opened', (event) => {
      const dialog = event.target instanceof HTMLDialogElement
        ? event.target
        : document.getElementById(event.detail?.dialogId);
      this.#promoteModal(dialog);
      this.#placePortal(dialog);
    }, opts);

    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && this.#toasts.size > 0) {
        const toasts = [...this.#toasts.keys()];
        this.#dismiss(toasts[toasts.length - 1]);
      }
    }, opts);

    for (const surface of [this, this.#portal]) {
      surface.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => this.#pauseAll(), opts);
      surface.addEventListener('mouseleave', (event) => {
        if (!this.#ownsNode(event.relatedTarget)) this.#resumeAll();
      }, opts);
      surface.addEventListener('focusin', () => this.#pauseAll(), opts);
      surface.addEventListener('focusout', (event) => {
        if (!this.#ownsNode(event.relatedTarget)) this.#resumeAll();
      }, opts);
    }

    this.#dialogObserver = new MutationObserver((records) => {
      for (const { target } of records) {
        if (!(target instanceof HTMLDialogElement)) continue;
        if (this.#isActiveModal(target)) {
          this.#promoteModal(target);
        } else {
          this.#modalStack = this.#modalStack.filter((dialog) => dialog !== target);
        }
      }
      this.#placePortal();
    });
    this.#dialogObserver.observe(document.documentElement, {
