      attributes: true,
      attributeFilter: ['open'],
      subtree: true,
    });

    for (const dialog of document.querySelectorAll('dialog[open]')) this.#promoteModal(dialog);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.#ac?.abort();
    this.#dialogObserver?.disconnect();
    this.#dialogObserver = null;
    for (const [toast, state] of this.#toasts) {
      clearTimeout(state.timeoutId);
      toast.remove();
    }
    this.#toasts.clear();
    this.#hidePortal();
    this.#portal?.remove();
    this.#portal = null;
    this.#modalStack = [];
    this.#isPaused = false;
  }

  get #defaultDuration() {
    return parseInt(this.getAttribute('duration'), 10) || 5000;
  }

  #createToast(message, variant, duration) {
    const requestedDuration = Number(duration ?? this.#defaultDuration);
    const dur = Number.isFinite(requestedDuration)
      ? Math.max(0, requestedDuration)
      : this.#defaultDuration;
    const variantClasses = {
      error: 'bg-critical text-interactive-text',
      info: 'bg-info text-interactive-text',
      success: 'bg-success text-interactive-text',
      warning: 'bg-warning text-warning-text',
    };
    const toast = document.createElement('div');
    // Keep transform (not individual translate) aligned with the WAAPI dismiss pose.
    toast.className = `pointer-events-auto flex items-start gap-2 px-4 py-3 rounded text-sm leading-normal shadow-lg opacity-100 [transform:translateY(0)] [transition:opacity_0.2s_var(--ease-ui),transform_0.25s_var(--ease-ui),display_0.25s_allow-discrete] cursor-pointer starting:opacity-0 starting:[transform:translateY(100%)] ${variantClasses[variant] || variantClasses.info}`;
    toast.setAttribute('role', variant === 'error' ? 'alert' : 'status');
    toast.setAttribute('aria-atomic', 'true');

    const text = document.createElement('span');
    text.className = 'flex-auto min-w-0';
    text.textContent = message;

    const closeBtn = document.createElement('button');
    closeBtn.type = 'button';
    closeBtn.className = 'flex-none inline-flex items-center justify-center size-6 min-w-touch-target min-h-touch-target p-0 border-none rounded bg-transparent text-inherit text-sm leading-none cursor-pointer opacity-70 motion-safe:transition-[opacity,transform] motion-safe:duration-150 motion-safe:ease-ui hover:opacity-100 active:transform-[scale(0.90)] focus-visible:opacity-100 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-current focus-visible:outline-offset-2';
    closeBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', this.dataset.dismissLabel || 'Dismiss');
    closeBtn.textContent = '\u2715'; // × (multiplication sign used as close icon)
    closeBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      this.#dismiss(toast);
    }, { signal: this.#ac.signal });

    toast.append(text, closeBtn);
    toast.addEventListener('click', () => this.#dismiss(toast), { signal: this.#ac.signal });
    this.#portal?.appendChild(toast);

    const state = {
      persistent: dur === 0,
      remainingTime: dur,
      timeoutId: null,
      startTime: Date.now(),
    };
    if (!state.persistent && !this.#isPaused) {
      state.timeoutId = setTimeout(() => this.#dismiss(toast), dur);
    }
    this.#toasts.set(toast, state);
    this.#placePortal();
  }

  async #dismiss(toast) {
    const state = this.#toasts.get(toast);
    if (!state) return;
    clearTimeout(state.timeoutId);
    this.#toasts.delete(toast);

    if (!window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
      try {
        await toast.animate(
          [{ opacity: 1, transform: 'translateY(0)' }, { opacity: 0, transform: 'translateY(8px)' }],
          { duration: 150, easing: this.#uiEasing() }
        ).finished;
      } catch (error) {
        if (error.name !== 'AbortError') throw error;
      }
    }
    toast.remove();
    if (this.#toasts.size === 0) this.#placePortal();
  }

  #uiEasing() {
    return getComputedStyle(this).getPropertyValue('--ease-ui').trim() || 'cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)';
  }

  #ownsNode(node) {
    return node instanceof Node && (this.contains(node) || this.#portal?.contains(node));
  }

  #isActiveModal(dialog) {
    if (!(dialog instanceof HTMLDialogElement) || !dialog.open) return false;

    try {
      return dialog.matches(':modal');
    } catch {
      return true;
    }
  }

  #promoteModal(dialog) {
    if (!this.#isActiveModal(dialog)) return;
    this.#modalStack = this.#modalStack.filter((candidate) => candidate !== dialog);
    this.#modalStack.push(dialog);
  }

  #activeModal() {
    const focusedDialog = document.activeElement?.closest?.('dialog[open]');
    if (this.#isActiveModal(focusedDialog)) return focusedDialog;

    this.#modalStack = this.#modalStack.filter((dialog) => this.#isActiveModal(dialog));
    return this.#modalStack.at(-1) || null;
  }

  #hidePortal() {
    try {
      this.#portal?.hidePopover?.();
    } catch {
      // A portal that is not currently shown has nothing to hide.
    }
  }

  #isPortalOpen() {
    try {
      return this.#portal?.matches(':popover-open') || false;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  #placePortal(preferredDialog = null) {
    if (!this.#portal) return;
    const dialog = this.#toasts.size > 0 && this.#isActiveModal(preferredDialog)
      ? preferredDialog
      : this.#toasts.size > 0 ? this.#activeModal() : null;

    if (!dialog && this.#portal.parentElement === this && !this.#portal.hasAttribute('popover')) {
      this.#portal.className = 'contents';
      return;
    }
    if (dialog && this.#portal.parentElement === dialog && this.#isPortalOpen()) {
      return;
    }

    this.#hidePortal();

    if (!dialog) {
      this.#portal.removeAttribute('popover');
      this.#portal.className = 'contents';
      if (this.#portal.parentElement !== this) this.appendChild(this.#portal);
      return;
    }

    this.#portal.setAttribute('popover', 'manual');
    this.#portal.className = this.className;
    if (this.#portal.parentElement !== dialog) dialog.appendChild(this.#portal);

    try {
      this.#portal.showPopover?.();
    } catch {
      // Without an open popover, nesting still keeps the portal operable inside the modal.
      this.#portal.removeAttribute('popover');
    }
  }

  #pauseAll() {
    if (this.#isPaused) return;
    this.#isPaused = true;
    for (const [, state] of this.#toasts) {
      if (state.timeoutId) {
        clearTimeout(state.timeoutId);
        state.timeoutId = null;
        state.remainingTime = Math.max(0, state.remainingTime - (Date.now() - state.startTime));
      }
    }
  }

  #resumeAll() {
    if (!this.#isPaused) return;
    this.#isPaused = false;
    for (const [toast, state] of this.#toasts) {
      if (state.persistent) continue;
      if (state.remainingTime <= 0) {
        this.#dismiss(toast);
      } else if (!state.timeoutId) {
        state.startTime = Date.now();
        state.timeoutId = setTimeout(() => this.#dismiss(toast), state.remainingTime);
      }
    }
  }
}

customElements.define('s-notification', SNotification);

import { announceGlobalLiveRegion } from '@theme/live-region';

/**
 * <s-predictive-search> — Predictive search combobox controller.
 *
 * Implements the WAI-ARIA combobox pattern on top of <s-live-form>:
 * - Manages aria-expanded on the search input when results appear/disappear
 * - Arrow-key navigation through role="option" elements with aria-activedescendant
 * - Announces result count via the global #sr-announcer live region
 * - Enter on an active option navigates to its URL
 * - Escape clears the active option (second press closes the dialog natively)
 *
 * Required child markup (queried by ID / role):
 *   #predictive-search-input    — The text input; receives keydown + aria state.
 *   #predictive-search-listbox  — The results container; must host role="option" descendants.
 *   [role="option"]             — Each result row. Focusable children get tabindex=-1
 *                                  to preserve the combobox focus contract (WCAG 2.1.1).
 *   [role="option"][data-ps-url]        — Destination URL when Enter is pressed.
 *   [data-ps-result-count]              — sr-only element inside the listbox whose
 *                                          textContent is announced after each update.
 *
 * External events consumed:
 *   's-live-form:updated' — Emitted by enclosing <s-live-form>; triggers ARIA resync.
 *
 * External coupling:
 *   #sr-announcer (global) — live region for result-count announcements.
 *   Nesting: must live inside <s-dialog> so Escape bubbles correctly.
 */
class PredictiveSearch extends HTMLElement {
  #ac;
  #input;
  #listbox;
  #activeIndex = -1;

  connectedCallback() {
    this.#ac = new AbortController();
    const opts = { signal: this.#ac.signal };

    this.#refreshElements();

    if (!this.#input || !this.#listbox) return;

    // Listen for live-form updates to sync ARIA state
    this.addEventListener('s-live-form:updated', () => {
      this.#refreshElements();
      this.#syncExpandedState();
      this.#announceResults();
      this.#resetActiveOption();
      this.#removeFocusableDescendants();
    }, opts);

    // Keyboard navigation on the input
    this.#input.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      this.#handleKeydown(e);
    }, opts);

    // Initial state sync (in case results are already rendered server-side)
    this.#syncExpandedState();
    this.#removeFocusableDescendants();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.#ac?.abort();
  }

  get #options() {
    return this.#listbox ? [...this.#listbox.querySelectorAll('[role="option"]')] : [];
  }

  #refreshElements() {
    this.#input = this.querySelector('#predictive-search-input');
    this.#listbox = this.querySelector('#predictive-search-listbox');
  }

  /**
   * Remove focusable descendants inside role="option" elements from the tab
   * order. The combobox pattern requires keyboard focus to stay on the input;
   * inner links/buttons would break that contract (WCAG 2.1.1).
   */
  #removeFocusableDescendants() {
    if (!this.#listbox) return;
    for (const el of this.#listbox.querySelectorAll('[role="option"] a, [role="option"] button')) {
      el.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
    }
  }

  #syncExpandedState() {
    if (!this.#input || !this.#listbox) return;
    const hasOptions = this.#options.length > 0;
    this.#input.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(hasOptions));
    // role="listbox" and aria-label are set statically in markup; only sync expanded state
  }

  #announceResults() {
    const countEl = this.#listbox?.querySelector('[data-ps-result-count]');
    if (!countEl) return;

    // Double-rAF to ensure the live region registers the post-partial change.
    announceGlobalLiveRegion(countEl.textContent.trim(), { frames: 2 });
  }

  #resetActiveOption() {
    this.#activeIndex = -1;
    if (this.#input) {
      this.#input.removeAttribute('aria-activedescendant');
    }
    for (const opt of this.#options) {
      opt.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
    }
  }

  #setActiveOption(index) {
    const options = this.#options;
    if (options.length === 0) return;

    // Clear previous
    for (const opt of options) {
      opt.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
    }

    // Wrap around
    if (index < 0) {
      index = options.length - 1;
    } else if (index >= options.length) {
      index = 0;
    }

    this.#activeIndex = index;
    const active = options[index];
    active.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
    this.#input.setAttribute('aria-activedescendant', active.id);

    // Scroll the active option into view within the listbox
    active.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
  }

  #handleKeydown(e) {
    const options = this.#options;
    if (options.length === 0 && e.key !== 'Escape') return;

    switch (e.key) {
      case 'ArrowDown':
        e.preventDefault();
        this.#setActiveOption(this.#activeIndex + 1);
        break;

      case 'ArrowUp':
        e.preventDefault();
        this.#setActiveOption(this.#activeIndex - 1);
        break;

      case 'Home':
        if (options.length > 0) {
          e.preventDefault();
          this.#setActiveOption(0);
        }
        break;

      case 'End':
        if (options.length > 0) {
          e.preventDefault();
          this.#setActiveOption(options.length - 1);
        }
        break;

      case 'Enter':
        if (this.#activeIndex >= 0 && this.#activeIndex < options.length) {
          e.preventDefault();
          const url = options[this.#activeIndex].dataset.psUrl;
          if (url) window.location.href = url;
        }
        // If no active option, let the form submit natively
        break;

      case 'Escape':
        if (this.#activeIndex >= 0) {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          this.#resetActiveOption();
        }
        // If no active option, let the dialog handle Escape natively
        break;
    }
  }
}

customElements.define('s-predictive-search', PredictiveSearch);

import { getCartErrorMessage } from '@theme/cart-feedback';

class SProductForm extends HTMLElement {
  #ac;
  #abortController;
  #activeSubmitter;
  #activeSubmitterAriaDisabled;
  #activeSubmitterHadOpacityClass;
  #activeSubmitterHadCursorWaitClass;

  connectedCallback() {
    this.#ac = new AbortController();
    const opts = { signal: this.#ac.signal };

    this.addEventListener('submit', (event) => {
      if (!this.#shouldHandleSubmit(event)) return;

      event.preventDefault();
      if (this.getAttribute('aria-busy') === 'true') return;

      this.#submit(event.target, event.submitter);
    }, opts);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.#ac?.abort();
    this.#abortController?.abort();
    this.#setSubmitting(false);
  }

  #shouldHandleSubmit(event) {
    const form = event.target;
    if (!(form instanceof HTMLFormElement)) return false;

    // If Standard Actions are unavailable, leave the Shopify product form native.
    if (!window.Shopify?.actions?.updateCart) return false;

    if (!this.#variantInput(form)) return false;

    const submitter = event.submitter;
    if (submitter instanceof HTMLElement && !submitter.matches('button[name="add"], input[name="add"]')) {
      return false;
    }

    return true;
  }

  async #submit(form, submitter) {
    this.#abortController?.abort();
    this.#abortController = new AbortController();
    const { signal } = this.#abortController;

    const line = this.#lineFromFormData(new FormData(form));
    if (!line) {
      this.#abortController = null;
      return;
    }

    this.#setSubmitting(true, submitter);
    this.#showError('');

    try {
      const result = await window.Shopify.actions.updateCart(
        { lines: [line] },
        {
          event: {
            context: 'product',
            detail: this.#eventDetail(),
          },
          signal,
        }
      );

      this.#throwIfAborted(signal);

      const errorMessage = this.#resultErrorMessage(result);
      if (errorMessage) {
        this.#showError(errorMessage);
      } else {
        await window.Shopify.actions.openCart?.();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (signal.aborted) return;

      this.#showError(getCartErrorMessage(error) || this.dataset.errorMessage || '');
    } finally {
      if (!signal.aborted) {
        this.#setSubmitting(false);
        if (this.#abortController?.signal === signal) this.#abortController = null;
      }
    }
  }

  #variantInput(form) {
    const input = form.elements.namedItem('id');
    return input instanceof HTMLInputElement ? input : null;
  }

  #lineFromFormData(formData) {
    const variantId = String(formData.get('id') || '').trim();
    if (!variantId) return null;

    const quantityValue = Number.parseInt(String(formData.get('quantity') || '1'), 10);
    const quantity = Number.isFinite(quantityValue) && quantityValue > 0 ? quantityValue : 1;
    const line = {
      merchandiseId: variantId,
      quantity,
    };

    const sellingPlanId = String(formData.get('selling_plan') || '').trim();
    if (sellingPlanId) line.sellingPlanId = sellingPlanId;

    const attributes = this.#lineAttributes(formData);
    if (attributes.length) line.attributes = attributes;

    return line;
  }

  #lineAttributes(formData) {
    const attributes = [];

    for (const [name, value] of formData) {
      const match = String(name).match(/^properties\[(.+)]$/);
      if (!match) continue;
      if (typeof File !== 'undefined' && value instanceof File) continue;

      const attributeValue = String(value).trim();
      if (!attributeValue) continue;

      attributes.push({ key: match[1], value: attributeValue });
    }

    return attributes;
  }

  #eventDetail() {
    const detail = { source: 's-product-form' };
    if (this.dataset.productId) detail.productId = this.dataset.productId;
    return detail;
  }

  #resultErrorMessage(result) {
    return result?.userErrors?.[0]?.message || '';
  }

  #showError(message) {
    const error = this.querySelector('[data-add-to-cart-error]');
    if (!error) return;

    error.textContent = message || '';
    error.hidden = !message;
  }

  #setSubmitting(submitting, submitter = this.#activeSubmitter) {
    if (submitting) {
      this.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
      if (submitter instanceof HTMLElement) {
        this.#activeSubmitter = submitter;
        this.#activeSubmitterAriaDisabled = submitter.getAttribute('aria-disabled');
        this.#activeSubmitterHadOpacityClass = submitter.classList.contains('opacity-50');
        this.#activeSubmitterHadCursorWaitClass = submitter.classList.contains('cursor-wait');
        submitter.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
        submitter.classList.add('opacity-50', 'cursor-wait');
      }
      return;
    }

    this.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
    if (this.#activeSubmitter instanceof HTMLElement) {
      if (this.#activeSubmitterAriaDisabled == null) {
        this.#activeSubmitter.removeAttribute('aria-disabled');
      } else {
        this.#activeSubmitter.setAttribute('aria-disabled', this.#activeSubmitterAriaDisabled);
      }
      if (!this.#activeSubmitterHadOpacityClass) this.#activeSubmitter.classList.remove('opacity-50');
      if (!this.#activeSubmitterHadCursorWaitClass) this.#activeSubmitter.classList.remove('cursor-wait');
    }
    this.#activeSubmitter = null;
    this.#activeSubmitterAriaDisabled = null;
    this.#activeSubmitterHadOpacityClass = null;
    this.#activeSubmitterHadCursorWaitClass = null;
  }

  #throwIfAborted(signal) {
    if (!signal.aborted) return;

    if (typeof signal.throwIfAborted === 'function') {
      signal.throwIfAborted();
    }

    throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
  }
}

if (!customElements.get('s-product-form')) {
  customElements.define('s-product-form', SProductForm);
}


================ FILE: assets/s-product-image-zoom.js ================

/**
 * <s-product-image-zoom> — PDP image zoom preloader.
 *
 * Gallery buttons still open native dialogs declaratively via commandfor/show-modal.
 * This component only warms the selected zoom image on hover/focus so the
 * fullscreen dialog has the high-resolution image ready when opened.
 *
 * Required markup:
 *   [data-zoom-preload][commandfor] — gallery trigger button; commandfor points to a dialog id.
 *   dialog img[data-zoom-image]     — high-resolution image inside the target dialog.
 */
class SProductImageZoom extends HTMLElement {
  #ac;
  #preloaded = new Set();
  #preloadLinks = [];

  connectedCallback() {
    this.#ac = new AbortController();
    const opts = { signal: this.#ac.signal };

    this.addEventListener('pointerover', this.#handlePreloadIntent, opts);
    this.addEventListener('focusin', this.#handlePreloadIntent, opts);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.#ac?.abort();

    for (const link of this.#preloadLinks) {
      link.remove();
    }
    this.#preloadLinks = [];
    this.#preloaded.clear();
  }

  #handlePreloadIntent = (event) => {
    if (!(event.target instanceof Element)) return;

    const source = event.target.closest('[data-zoom-preload]');
    if (!source || !this.contains(source)) return;

    this.#preload(source);
  };

  #preload(source) {
    const dialogId = source.getAttribute('commandfor');
    if (!dialogId || this.#preloaded.has(dialogId)) return;

    const dialog = document.getElementById(dialogId);
    const image = dialog?.querySelector('img[data-zoom-image]');
    if (!(image instanceof HTMLImageElement)) return;

    this.#preloaded.add(dialogId);
    image.loading = 'eager';
    image.fetchPriority = 'high';

    const link = document.createElement('link');
    link.rel = 'preload';
    link.as = 'image';
    link.href = image.src;
    if (image.srcset) link.setAttribute('imagesrcset', image.srcset);
    if (image.sizes) link.setAttribute('imagesizes', image.sizes);
    document.head.append(link);
    this.#preloadLinks.push(link);

    if (typeof image.decode === 'function') {
      image.decode().catch(() => {});
    }
  }
}

if (!customElements.get('s-product-image-zoom')) {
  customElements.define('s-product-image-zoom', SProductImageZoom);
}


================ FILE: assets/s-quantity-selector.js ================

/**
 * <s-quantity-selector> — Quantity selector with decrement/increment buttons,
 * clamping to [min, max], and sr-only live-region announcements.
 *
 * Commands (dispatched via commandfor/command on descendant buttons):
 *   --step-up   — Increment by step (clamped to max); announces + dispatches s-quantity:change.
 *   --step-down — Decrement by step (clamped to min); announces + dispatches s-quantity:change.
 *
 * Required child markup:
 *   input[type="number"] (or any input) — The quantity input; its value is the source of truth.
 *   [data-decrement]                    — Decrement button; `disabled` synced when value <= min.
 *   [data-increment]                    — Increment button; `disabled` synced when value >= max.
 *
 * Element attributes/dataset (on <s-quantity-selector>):
 *   min   — Integer minimum (default 1).
 *   max   — Integer maximum (when absent, no upper bound is enforced).
 *   step  — Integer step size (default 1).
 *   value — Optional initial value; falls back to input.value, then min.
 *   data-quantity-label — i18n prefix read out on change (e.g. "Quantity: 3").
 *
 * Events:
 *   s-quantity:change (bubbles) — { value, previousValue }
 */
import { normalizeQuantity } from '@theme/quantity-rules';
import {
  announceLiveRegion,
  cancelLiveRegionAnnouncement,
  createVisuallyHiddenLiveRegion,
} from '@theme/live-region';

class SQuantitySelector extends HTMLElement {
  #input;
  #ac;
  #liveRegion;
  #lastValue;
  #hasConnected = false;

  connectedCallback() {
    this.#input = this.querySelector('input[type="number"]') || this.querySelector('input');
    if (!this.#input) return;

    // Preserve the same announcer across temporary DOM moves.
    if (!this.#liveRegion) {
      this.#liveRegion = createVisuallyHiddenLiveRegion();
      this.appendChild(this.#liveRegion);
    }

    if (!this.#hasConnected) {
      const attrVal = parseInt(this.getAttribute('value'), 10);
      const inputVal = parseInt(this.#input.value, 10);
      const initial = !isNaN(attrVal) ? attrVal : (!isNaN(inputVal) ? inputVal : this.#min);
      this.#input.value = this.#normalize(initial);
      this.#lastValue = this.#value;
      this.#hasConnected = true;
    } else {
      // The child input, not the initial host attribute, owns state after first connection.
      const currentVal = parseInt(this.#input.value, 10);
      this.#input.value = isNaN(currentVal) ? this.#min : this.#normalize(currentVal);
      this.#lastValue = this.#value;
    }
    this.#updateButtons();

    this.#ac = new AbortController();
    const opts = { signal: this.#ac.signal };

    this.addEventListener('command', (e) => {
      if (e.command === '--step-up') this.#step(1);
      else if (e.command === '--step-down') this.#step(-1);
    }, opts);
    this.#input.addEventListener('change', () => {
      const previousValue = this.#lastValue;
      const parsed = parseInt(this.#input.value, 10);
      this.#input.value = isNaN(parsed) ? this.#min : this.#normalize(parsed);
      this.#updateButtons();
      const value = this.#value;
      if (value !== previousValue) {
        this.#announce(value);
        this.#dispatch(previousValue);
      }
      this.#lastValue = value;
    }, opts);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.#ac?.abort();
    cancelLiveRegionAnnouncement(this.#liveRegion);
  }

  get #min() { const v = parseInt(this.getAttribute('min'), 10); return isNaN(v) ? 1 : v; }
  get #max() {
    const attr = this.getAttribute('max');
    if (attr === null || attr === '') return Infinity;
    const v = parseInt(attr, 10);
    return isNaN(v) ? Infinity : v;
  }
  get #stepVal() { const v = parseInt(this.getAttribute('step'), 10); return isNaN(v) || v <= 0 ? 1 : v; }
  get #value() { const v = parseInt(this.#input.value, 10); return isNaN(v) ? this.#min : v; }

  #normalize(value) {
    return normalizeQuantity(value, {
      min: this.#min,
      max: this.#max,
      step: this.#stepVal,
    });
  }

  #step(direction) {
    const previousValue = this.#value;
    this.#input.value = this.#normalize(previousValue + direction * this.#stepVal);
    this.#updateButtons();
    const value = this.#value;
    if (value !== previousValue) {
      this.#announce(value);
      this.#dispatch(previousValue);
    }
    this.#lastValue = value;
  }

  #announce(value) {
    if (!this.#liveRegion) return;

    const label = this.dataset.quantityLabel;
    announceLiveRegion(this.#liveRegion, label ? `${label}: ${value}` : String(value));
  }

  #updateButtons() {
    const v = this.#value;
    const max = this.#max;
    const decrement = this.querySelector('[data-decrement]');
    const increment = this.querySelector('[data-increment]');
    if (decrement) decrement.disabled = v <= this.#min;
    if (increment) {
      const next = this.#normalize(v + this.#stepVal);
      increment.disabled = max !== Infinity && next === v;
    }
  }

  #dispatch(previousValue) {
    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('s-quantity:change', {
      bubbles: true,
      detail: { value: this.#value, previousValue },
    }));
  }
}

customElements.define('s-quantity-selector', SQuantitySelector);


================ FILE: assets/s-variant-picker.js ================

/**
 * <s-variant-picker> — Listens for option `change` events and swaps the product form
 * and title via partial rendering, keeping price and add-to-cart state in
 * sync with the selected variant without a full page reload.
 *
 * Required child markup:
 *   [data-variant-id]           — On each swatch/radio/select option input; value used to
 *                                 build the ?variant= URL param and trigger the partial fetch.
 *   select > option[data-variant-id] — Alternative: variant id carried on <option> elements
 *                                       inside a <select> (read via selectedOptions[0].dataset).
 *   input[name="id"]            — Hidden product-form input kept in sync for add-to-cart.
 *   input[name="quantity"]      — Quantity input preserved across product-form swaps.
 *
 * Element dataset (on <s-variant-picker>):
 *   data-updated-message   — i18n string announced via #sr-announcer after the variant updates.
 *   data-error-message     — i18n string shown locally and announced after a current update fails.
 *
 * Optional child markup:
 *   [data-variant-picker-error] — Visible error owned by the picker; add-to-cart errors remain
 *                                 owned by [data-add-to-cart-error].
 *
 * Partial contract:
 *   "product-form"   — must match {% partial "product-form" %} in templates/product.liquid.
 *   "product-title"  — must match {% partial "product-title" %} in templates/product.liquid.
 *                      Renaming either side silently breaks variant switching.
 *
 * External coupling:
 *   history.replaceState                  — ?variant= URL param updated on every selection.
 *   #sr-announcer (global)                — Live region announced with success/error feedback.
 *   aria-busy (on self)                   — Set while the current variant update is pending.
 */
// <s-variant-picker> listens for option changes and swaps the product form +
// title via partial rendering. This keeps price and the add-to-cart
// button in sync with the selected variant without a full page reload.
import { partials } from '@shopify/partial-rendering';
import { ProductSelectEvent } from '@shopify/standard-events';
import { transition } from '@theme/view-transition';
import { announceGlobalLiveRegion } from '@theme/live-region';

const PRODUCT_VIEW_PAYLOAD_SELECTOR = 'script[type="application/json"][data-product-view-payload]';
const ACTIVE_UPDATE = Symbol('s-variant-picker-active-update');

class VariantPicker extends HTMLElement {
  #ac;
  #abortController;
  #committedHistoryState;
  #committedSelection;
  #committedUrl;
  #committedVariantId;

  connectedCallback() {
    this.#ac = new AbortController();
    const opts = { signal: this.#ac.signal };
    const productForm = this.closest('[data-product-form]');

    // The server-rendered form is the committed state to restore if its replacement fails.
    this.#committedVariantId = this.#getSelectedVariantId(productForm);
    this.#committedUrl = location.href;
    this.#committedHistoryState = history.state;
    this.#committedSelection = this.#captureSelection();

    this.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
      const input = e.target;
      const variantId = input.dataset.variantId
        || input.selectedOptions?.[0]?.dataset?.variantId;
      if (variantId) {
        this.#update(variantId);
      }
    }, opts);
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.#ac?.abort();
    this.#abortController?.abort();
  }

  async #update(variantId) {
    const productForm = this.closest('[data-product-form]');
    const updateHost = productForm || this;

    // The stable product-form host coordinates picker instances replaced by their own partial.
    // Refresh URL/history only when no optimistic update is active, never from a stale candidate.
    if (!updateHost[ACTIVE_UPDATE]) {
      this.#committedUrl = location.href;
      this.#committedHistoryState = history.state;
    }
    updateHost[ACTIVE_UPDATE]?.abort();
    this.#abortController?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    this.#abortController = controller;
    updateHost[ACTIVE_UPDATE] = controller;

    const quantityValue = this.#getQuantityValue(productForm);
    let focusCapture = null;
    this.#syncSelectedVariantId(variantId, productForm);
    this.#showError('');
    this.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');

    const deferredEvent = ProductSelectEvent.createPromise();
    this.dispatchEvent(
      new ProductSelectEvent({
        product: {
          id: this.dataset.productId || '',
          title: this.dataset.productTitle || '',
          handle: this.dataset.productHandle || '',
        },
        selectedOptions: this.#getSelectedOptions(),
        promise: deferredEvent.promise,
      })
    );

    const url = new URL(location.href);
    // ?variant is a Shopify platform contract — the server reads it to pre-select and render the
    // matching variant on page load / deep-link. Renaming this param breaks variant URL sharing.
    url.searchParams.set('variant', variantId);

    try {
      // Let the browser paint before URL update.
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 0));
      this.#throwIfSuperseded(controller, updateHost);
      history.replaceState(history.state, '', url);

      // 'product-form' and 'product-title' must match the {% partial %} names in
      // templates/product.liquid — changing either name here or there breaks variant switching.
      const html = await partials.fetch('product-form', 'product-title', { url: url.toString(), signal: controller.signal });
      this.#throwIfSuperseded(controller, updateHost);
      await transition(() => {
        this.#throwIfSuperseded(controller, updateHost);
        // Capture at replacement time so focus moved during the fetch is never stolen back.
        focusCapture = this.#captureFocus();
        partials.apply(html);
      });

      // Applying product-form disconnects this picker. Ownership, rather than its now-aborted
      // signal, distinguishes that expected replacement from a newer picker selection.
      if (updateHost[ACTIVE_UPDATE] !== controller) throw this.#abortError(controller);

      this.#syncSelectedVariantId(variantId, productForm);
      this.#syncQuantityValue(quantityValue, productForm);
      this.#restoreFocus(focusCapture, productForm);

      deferredEvent.resolve({ variant: this.#getSelectedVariantPayload(productForm) });

      if (this.isConnected) this.#commitState(variantId, url);
      announceGlobalLiveRegion(this.dataset.updatedMessage);
    } catch (error) {
      deferredEvent.reject(error);

      const superseded = updateHost[ACTIVE_UPDATE] !== controller;
      if (superseded || !this.isConnected) return;

      this.#restoreCommittedState(productForm);
      if (error?.name === 'AbortError') return;

      this.#showError(this.dataset.errorMessage);
      announceGlobalLiveRegion(this.dataset.errorMessage);
      console.error('[s-variant-picker] Partial fetch failed:', error);
    } finally {
      if (updateHost[ACTIVE_UPDATE] === controller) delete updateHost[ACTIVE_UPDATE];
      if (this.#abortController === controller) {
        this.#abortController = null;
        this.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
      }
    }
  }

  #getSelectedOptions() {
    return Array.from(
      this.querySelectorAll('select[name], input[type="radio"][name]:checked')
    ).map((control) => ({
      name: control.name,
      value: String(control.value ?? ''),
    }));
  }

  #captureSelection() {
    return Array.from(
      this.querySelectorAll('select[name], input[type="radio"][name]')
    ).map((control) => {
      if (control instanceof HTMLSelectElement) {
        return {
          control,
          selected: Array.from(control.options, (option) => option.selected),
        };
      }

      return { control, checked: control.checked };
    });
  }

  #restoreCommittedState(productForm) {
    for (const state of this.#committedSelection || []) {
      if (!this.contains(state.control)) continue;

      if (state.control instanceof HTMLSelectElement) {
        Array.from(state.control.options).forEach((option, index) => {
          option.selected = state.selected[index] || false;
        });
      } else {
        state.control.checked = state.checked;
      }
    }

    this.#syncSelectedVariantId(this.#committedVariantId, productForm);
    history.replaceState(this.#committedHistoryState, '', this.#committedUrl);
  }

  #commitState(variantId, url) {
    this.#committedVariantId = variantId;
    this.#committedUrl = url.toString();
    this.#committedHistoryState = history.state;
    this.#committedSelection = this.#captureSelection();
  }

  #captureFocus() {
    const activeElement = document.activeElement;
    if (!this.contains(activeElement)) return null;

    if (activeElement instanceof HTMLInputElement && activeElement.type === 'radio') {
      return {
        type: 'radio',
        name: activeElement.name,
        value: activeElement.value,
        control: activeElement,
      };
    }

    // Capture stable identity for select elements.
    if (activeElement instanceof HTMLSelectElement) {
      return {
        type: 'select',
        name: activeElement.name,
        control: activeElement,
      };
    }

    return null;
  }

  #restoreFocus(focusCapture, productForm = this.closest('[data-product-form]')) {
    if (!focusCapture || focusCapture.control.isConnected) return;
    if (document.activeElement !== document.body && document.activeElement !== document.documentElement) return;

    const newPicker = productForm?.querySelector('s-variant-picker');
    if (!newPicker) return;

    let candidates;
    if (focusCapture.type === 'radio') {
      candidates = newPicker.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"][name]');
      candidates = [...candidates].filter((control) => (
        control.name === focusCapture.name && control.value === focusCapture.value
      ));
    } else {
      candidates = [...newPicker.querySelectorAll('select[name]')]
        .filter((control) => control.name === focusCapture.name);
    }

    candidates[0]?.focus();
  }

  #getSelectedVariantId(productForm = this.closest('[data-product-form]')) {
    const variantInput = productForm?.querySelector('input[name="id"]');
    return variantInput instanceof HTMLInputElement ? variantInput.value : '';
  }

  #syncSelectedVariantId(variantId, productForm = this.closest('[data-product-form]')) {
    const variantInput = productForm?.querySelector('input[name="id"]');
    if (variantInput instanceof HTMLInputElement) {
      variantInput.value = variantId;
    }
  }

  #showError(message) {
    const error = this.querySelector('[data-variant-picker-error]');
    if (!error) return;

    if (message) error.textContent = message;
    error.hidden = !message;
  }

  #throwIfSuperseded(controller, updateHost) {
    if (!controller.signal.aborted && updateHost[ACTIVE_UPDATE] === controller) return;
    throw this.#abortError(controller);
  }

  #abortError(controller) {
    const reason = controller.signal.reason;
    if (reason instanceof Error && reason.name === 'AbortError') return reason;
    return new DOMException('Variant update superseded', 'AbortError');
  }

  #getQuantityValue(productForm = this.closest('[data-product-form]')) {
    const quantityInput = productForm?.querySelector('input[name="quantity"]');
    return quantityInput instanceof HTMLInputElement ? quantityInput.value : null;
  }

  #syncQuantityValue(quantityValue, productForm = this.closest('[data-product-form]')) {
    if (!quantityValue) return;

    const quantityInput = productForm?.querySelector('input[name="quantity"]');
    if (quantityInput instanceof HTMLInputElement) {
      quantityInput.value = this.#clampQuantityValue(quantityValue, quantityInput);
      quantityInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
    }
  }

  #clampQuantityValue(quantityValue, quantityInput) {
    const parsedValue = Number(quantityValue);
    if (!Number.isFinite(parsedValue)) return quantityValue;

    let clampedValue = parsedValue;
    const min = Number(quantityInput.min);
    const max = Number(quantityInput.max);

    if (quantityInput.min && Number.isFinite(min)) {
      clampedValue = Math.max(min, clampedValue);
    }
    if (quantityInput.max && Number.isFinite(max)) {
      clampedValue = Math.min(max, clampedValue);
    }

    return String(clampedValue);
  }

  #getSelectedVariantPayload(productForm = this.closest('[data-product-form]')) {
    const marker = productForm?.querySelector(PRODUCT_VIEW_PAYLOAD_SELECTOR);
    const payload = marker?.textContent?.trim();
    if (!payload) return null;

    let parsedPayload;
    try {
      parsedPayload = JSON.parse(payload);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[variant-picker] Failed to parse product view payload:', error);
      return null;
    }

    return parsedPayload?.product?.selectedVariant || null;
  }
}
customElements.define('s-variant-picker', VariantPicker);


================ FILE: assets/s-video.js ================

/**
 * <s-video> — Click-to-load video player web component.
 *
 * Clicking [data-play] replaces the poster with the iframe/video from
 * <template data-video>. Injects preconnect hints on hover/focus to reduce
 * time-to-play for third-party embeds. Shopify-hosted <video> plays natively
 * and gets a caption track injected if data-caption-url is provided.
 *
 * Commands (dispatched via commandfor/command on descendant buttons):
 *   --play — Replace the poster with the embed inside <template data-video>.
 *
 * Required child markup:
 *   [data-play]              — The poster/play button (receives click + preconnect hooks).
 *                               [data-preconnect] attribute is the origin to preconnect to.
 *   template[data-video]     — <template> whose content is cloned into place on --play.
 *                               Expected to contain a single <iframe> or <video> element.
 *   video (optional)         — When present, a native caption <track> is injected on mount.
 *
 * Element dataset (on <s-video> itself):
 *   data-caption-url      — If set + a native <video> is present, injects <track kind="captions">.
 *   data-caption-srclang  — srclang for the caption track (defaults to <html lang> or "en").
 *   data-caption-label    — human-readable caption track label.
 *   data-video-title      — Fallback title attribute injected onto <iframe> for a11y.
 *
 * Events:
 *   s-video:play (bubbles) — Dispatched after the embed is swapped in.
 */
class SVideo extends HTMLElement {
  #playBtn;
  #template;
  #ac;
  #inFlightAc;
  #autoplayRaf;
  #preconnected = false;
  #preconnectLink;

  connectedCallback() {
    this.#playBtn = this.querySelector('[data-play]');
    this.#template = this.querySelector('template[data-video]');
    this.#ac = new AbortController();
    const opts = { signal: this.#ac.signal };

    // For native Shopify-hosted video: inject caption track, apply playsinline, and wire pause-on-hover
    const nativeVideo = this.querySelector('video');
    if (nativeVideo) {
      if (this.dataset.captionUrl) {
        let track = nativeVideo.querySelector('track[data-s-video-caption]');
        if (!track) {
          track = document.createElement('track');
          track.dataset.sVideoCaption = '';
          track.kind = 'captions';
          track.default = true;
          nativeVideo.appendChild(track);
        }
        track.src = this.dataset.captionUrl;
        track.srclang = this.dataset.captionSrclang || document.documentElement.lang || 'en';
        track.label = this.dataset.captionLabel;
      }

      // plays-inline: add playsinline for inline playback on iOS (video_tag doesn't expose this attr)
      if (this.classList.contains('plays-inline')) {
        nativeVideo.setAttribute('playsinline', '');
      }

      if (this.classList.contains('pause-on-hover')) {
        this.#bindPauseOnHover(nativeVideo, opts);
      }
    }

    if (!this.#playBtn || !this.#template) return;

    this.addEventListener('command', (e) => {
      if (e.command === '--play') this.#load();
    }, opts);
    this.#playBtn.addEventListener('pointerenter', () => this.#preconnect(), { ...opts, once: true });
    this.#playBtn.addEventListener('focusin', () => this.#preconnect(), { ...opts, once: true });

    if (this.classList.contains('autoplay')) {
      this.#autoplayRaf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        this.#autoplayRaf = null;
        this.#load({ animate: false, focus: false });
      });
    }
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.#ac?.abort();
    this.#inFlightAc?.abort();
    if (this.#autoplayRaf !== null && this.#autoplayRaf !== undefined) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(this.#autoplayRaf);
      this.#autoplayRaf = null;
    }
    this.#preconnectLink?.remove();
    this.#preconnectLink = null;
    this.#preconnected = false;
  }

  async #load({ animate = true, focus = true } = {}) {
    if (!this.isConnected || !this.#playBtn || !this.#template) return;

    this.#inFlightAc?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    this.#inFlightAc = controller;
    const signal = controller.signal;

    const content = this.#template.content.cloneNode(true);
    const media = content.querySelector('iframe, video');

    // Ensure iframes always have a title for screen reader accessibility
    if (media && media.tagName === 'IFRAME' && !media.getAttribute('title')) {
      if (this.dataset.videoTitle) media.title = this.dataset.videoTitle;
    }

    const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    if (animate && !reduceMotion) {
      try {
        await this.#playBtn.animate(
          [{ opacity: 1 }, { opacity: 0 }],
          { duration: 200, easing: 'cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)' }
        ).finished;
      } catch (e) {
        if (e.name !== 'AbortError') throw e;
        return;
      }
      // Supersession and disconnect both funnel through abort, so one signal check carries the contract.
      if (signal.aborted) return;
    }

    this.#playBtn.replaceWith(content);
    this.#template.remove();
    this.#playBtn = null;
    this.#template = null;
    this.#inFlightAc = null;

    if (media && this.classList.contains('pause-on-hover')) {
      this.#bindPauseOnHover(media, { signal: this.#ac.signal });
    }

    if (media && animate && !reduceMotion) {
      media.animate([{ opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1 }], { duration: 200, easing: 'cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)' });
    }

    if (media && focus) media.focus();

    this.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('s-video:play', { bubbles: true }));
  }

  #bindPauseOnHover(media, opts) {
    if (!media) return;

    if (media.tagName === 'VIDEO') {
      let wasPlaying = false;
      this.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
        wasPlaying = !media.paused;
        media.pause();
      }, opts);
      this.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
        if (wasPlaying) media.play().catch(() => {});
      }, opts);
      return;
    }

    if (media.tagName !== 'IFRAME') return;

    const src = media.getAttribute('src');
    if (!src) return;

    const targetOrigin = new URL(src).origin;
    let pauseMessage;

    if (targetOrigin.includes('youtube')) {
      pauseMessage = JSON.stringify({ event: 'command', func: 'pauseVideo', args: [] });
    } else if (targetOrigin.includes('vimeo')) {
      pauseMessage = JSON.stringify({ method: 'pause' });
    }

    if (!pauseMessage) return;

    this.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
      media.contentWindow?.postMessage(pauseMessage, targetOrigin);
    }, opts);
  }

  #preconnect() {
    if (this.#preconnected) return;
    this.#preconnected = true;

    const origin = this.#playBtn.dataset.preconnect;
    if (!origin) return;

    this.#preconnectLink = document.createElement('link');
    this.#preconnectLink.rel = 'preconnect';
    this.#preconnectLink.href = origin;
    this.#preconnectLink.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
    document.head.appendChild(this.#preconnectLink);
  }
}

if (!customElements.get('s-video')) {
  customElements.define('s-video', SVideo);
}

import {
  announceCartFeedback,
  getCartErrorMessage,
  getCartRefreshErrorMessage,
  getCartSuccessMessage,
} from '@theme/cart-feedback';


const cartElement = 's-cart';
// Theme product-context mutations originate in s-product-form, whose inline alert owns errors.
const hasInlineMutationErrorOwner = (options) => options?.event?.context === 'product';
const isRecoveredCartError = (error) => (
  error?.code === 'INVALID'
  && Array.isArray(error.field)
  && error.field.length === 1
  && error.field[0] === 'cartId'
);

function normalizeRecoveredCartResult(result) {
  if (!result?.cart?.id || !Array.isArray(result.userErrors)) return result;

  // Storefront can replace an invalid or consumed cart, commit the mutation, and
  // return the new cart alongside this non-actionable cartId error.
  const userErrors = result.userErrors.filter((error) => !isRecoveredCartError(error));
  if (userErrors.length === result.userErrors.length) return result;

  const normalizedResult = { ...result };
  if (userErrors.length) {
    normalizedResult.userErrors = userErrors;
  } else {
    delete normalizedResult.userErrors;
  }
  return normalizedResult;
}

export async function handleOpenCart() {
  /** @type {HTMLDialogElement | null} */
  const dialog = document.getElementById('cart-drawer');
  if (!(dialog instanceof HTMLDialogElement)) return;

  if (!dialog.open) dialog.showModal();
  if (!dialog.open) return;

  dialog.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('s-cart:opened', {
    bubbles: true,
    detail: { dialogId: dialog.id },
  }));
}

export async function handleUpdateCart(defaultHandler, payload, options) {
  let result;

  try {
    result = normalizeRecoveredCartResult(await defaultHandler());
  } catch (error) {
    if (!options?.signal?.aborted && !hasInlineMutationErrorOwner(options)) {
      await announceCartFeedback(getCartErrorMessage(error), { toast: true });
    }

    throw error;
  }

  const userErrorMessage = result?.userErrors?.[0]?.message;
  if (userErrorMessage) {
    if (!hasInlineMutationErrorOwner(options)) {
      await announceCartFeedback(userErrorMessage, { toast: true });
    }
    return result;
  }

  try {
    await customElements.whenDefined(cartElement);
    await customElements.get(cartElement)?.refreshMountedCarts?.({ signal: options?.signal });
  } catch (error) {
    // The mutation has already committed. Keep that successful result outside caller
    // rollback boundaries and classify only the display refresh as stale.
    if (!options?.signal?.aborted) {
      await announceCartFeedback(getCartRefreshErrorMessage(), {
        toast: true,
        variant: 'warning',
        duration: 0,
      });
    }

    return result;
  }

  const message = result?.warnings?.[0]?.message || getCartSuccessMessage(payload?.lines);
  await announceCartFeedback(message);

  return result;
}

================ FILE: assets/view-transition.js ================

/**
 * Runs a callback inside a view transition when supported and the user
 * hasn't opted into "prefers-reduced-motion". Falls back to calling the
 * callback directly.
 *
 * Returns a promise that resolves once the callback has finished updating
 * the DOM, so callers can safely read the post-update DOM.
 */
export async function transition(callback) {
  if (document.startViewTransition && !matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
    const vt = document.startViewTransition(callback);
    await vt.updateCallbackDone;
  } else {
    await callback();
  }
}


================ FILE: blocks/basic-menu.liquid ================

{% doc %}
  Renders a straightforward link list without primary-navigation dropdown or
  mobile-drawer behavior. Links stack vertically below `md` and become a
  horizontal wrapping row at larger widths. The first 5 links are shown. When
  no menu is selected, the standard `footer` link list is used automatically.
  Optional body content renders above the link list.

  @param {string} [aria_label] - Accessible navigation label. Defaults to the translated quick-links label.
  @param {string} [class] - Additional CSS classes applied to the root `<nav>` element.
  @param {string} [attributes] - Additional HTML attributes passed through to the root `<nav>` element.

  @category navigation
  @renders nav

  @example
  {% block 'basic-menu' %}{% endblock %}
{% enddoc %}

{%- liquid
  assign menu = menu | default: linklists.footer
  if aria_label == blank
    assign aria_label = 'footer.quick_links' | t
  endif
-%}

{% if menu.links.size > 0 %}
  <nav aria-label="{{ aria_label | escape }}"{% if class != blank %} class="{{ class }}"{% endif %}{% if attributes != blank %} {{ attributes }}{% endif %}>
    {{ content }}
    {%- comment -%} Stack links for an easy mobile scan; md switches to a horizontal row that wraps without shrinking touch targets. {%- endcomment -%}
    <ul role="list" class="flex flex-col items-start gap-y-1 md:flex-row md:flex-wrap md:items-center md:gap-x-6">
      {% for link in menu.links limit: 5 %}
        <li class="m-0">
          <a
            href="{{ link.url }}"
            class="inline-flex items-center min-h-touch-target font-normal no-underline text-on-surface-secondary hover:text-on-surface focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-accent motion-safe:transition-colors"
            {%- if link.current %} aria-current="page"{% endif %}
          >
            {{ link.title | escape }}
          </a>
        </li>
      {% endfor %}
    </ul>
  </nav>
{% endif %}

{% schema %}
  {
    "name": "t:blocks.basic_menu",
    "settings": [
      {
        "type": "link_list",
        "id": "menu",
        "label": "t:blocks.menu_settings.menu",
        "info": "t:blocks.menu_settings.menu_info",
        "default": "footer"
      }
    ]
  }
{% endschema %}


================ FILE: blocks/button.liquid ================

{% doc %}
  Renders a standalone button or link element. Renders an `<a>` tag when the
  `url` setting is set, otherwise a `<button>` element. Body content is composed
  via `{{ content }}`.

  `variant` and `url` are schema settings. Call sites override them using bare
  kwargs (`variant:`, `url:`); the dotted `block.settings.*` form fails
  `validate:block-settings`. `variant` controls
  color/treatment only and takes 'button-primary', 'button-secondary',
  'button-outline', 'button-ghost', 'button-surface', or 'custom', defaulting to
  'button-primary'. `class` controls size and shape. A `url` set on a command
  or form button (submit, reset, or named) is ignored, so those call sites always
  render `<button>`.

  The Link control is also hidden in the editor on those call sites.

  @param {string} [class] - Additional classes (sizing, shape, positioning, width, etc.). Default: 'rounded-button'. Pass e.g. 'px-4 h-11 text-sm' here to override sizing.
  @param {string} [attributes] - Additional HTML attributes passed through to the root element
  @param {string} [type] - HTML button type attribute (button/submit/reset). Default: 'button'.
  @param {boolean} [disabled] - Disabled state. Renders aria-disabled="true" (not native disabled) so the button remains focusable and selectable in the theme editor. Use type="button" on submit buttons when disabled to prevent keyboard form submission. Default: false.
  @param {string} [commandfor] - Invoker Commands target element id
  @param {string} [command] - Invoker Commands command name
  @param {string} [name] - Form button name attribute
  @param {string} [value] - Form button value attribute
  @param {boolean} [autofocus] - When true, adds the autofocus attribute to the button. Default: false.
  @param {boolean} [inert] - Ignore and hide the Link setting on a call site that carries none of the command or form signals. Does not emit the HTML inert attribute. Default: false.

  @category interactive
  @renders button|a

  @example
  {% block 'button', type: 'submit' %}Add to cart{% endblock %}

  {% block 'button', type: 'submit', class: 'rounded-button w-full' %}Add to cart{% endblock %}

  {% block 'button', url: routes.all_products_collection_url, variant: 'button-surface' %}Browse products{% endblock %}

  {%- capture search_attrs -%}aria-label="{{ 'general.search' | t }}"{%- endcapture -%}
  {% block 'button', variant: 'button-ghost', class: 'size-touch-target rounded hover:bg-transparent hover:opacity-70', attributes: search_attrs %}
    <span class="inline-flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 size-5" aria-hidden="true">{{- 'icon-search.svg' | inline_asset_content -}}</span>
  {% endblock %}
{% enddoc %}

{%- liquid
  assign type     = type     | default: 'button'
  assign disabled = disabled | default: false
  assign variant  = variant | default: 'button-primary'
  assign url      = url

  # A command or form button has to stay a <button>: an <a> drops command/commandfor and cannot submit or reset.
  # Ignoring the Link setting here keeps a merchant value from breaking checkout, drawers, or line removal.
  # `visible_if` only resolves names this file binds, so `inert` is bound on every path.
  # The capture runs first because the rebind would otherwise clobber the call-site value.
  assign inert_kwarg = inert
  assign inert = false
  if command != blank or commandfor != blank or type == 'submit' or type == 'reset' or name != blank or inert_kwarg
    assign inert = true
    assign url = ''
  endif

  assign class = class | default: 'rounded-button'

  # Opacity is transitioned so caller-composed hover fades and the disabled state animate instead of snapping.
  assign base_class = 'inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 font-medium motion-safe:transition-[color,background-color,border-color,opacity,transform] motion-safe:active:scale-[0.97] cursor-pointer focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-accent'

  if disabled
    assign disabled_class = 'opacity-50'
    # In design mode, disabled controls still need pointer events so the editor can select and style them.
    unless request.design_mode
      assign disabled_class = disabled_class | append: ' pointer-events-none'
    endunless
  else
    assign disabled_class = ''
  endif

  assign custom_style = ''
  if variant == 'custom'
    assign bg_color = background_color
    if bg_color != blank
      assign custom_style = 'background-color: ' | append: bg_color | append: ';'
      assign bg_brightness = bg_color | color_brightness
      if bg_brightness > 128
        assign custom_style = custom_style | append: 'color: #000;'
      else
        assign custom_style = custom_style | append: 'color: #fff;'
      endif
    endif
  endif

  if variant == 'custom'
    assign full_class = base_class | append: ' button-primary ' | append: class
  else
    assign full_class = base_class | append: ' ' | append: variant | append: ' ' | append: class
  endif
  if disabled_class != ''
    assign full_class = full_class | append: ' ' | append: disabled_class
  endif
-%}

{%- if url != blank -%}
  <a href="{{ url | escape }}"
    class="{{ full_class }} no-underline"
    {%- if custom_style != blank %} style="{{ custom_style }}"{% endif %}
    {%- if disabled %} aria-disabled="true" tabindex="-1"{% endif %}
    {%- if attributes != blank %} {{ attributes }}{% endif %}>
    {{- content -}}
  </a>
{%- else -%}
  <button type="{{ type }}"
    class="{{ full_class }}"
    {%- if custom_style != blank %} style="{{ custom_style }}"{% endif %}
    {%- if name != blank %} name="{{ name }}"{% endif %}
    {%- if value != blank %} value="{{ value | escape }}"{% endif %}
    {%- if commandfor != blank %} commandfor="{{ commandfor }}"{% endif %}
    {%- if command != blank %} command="{{ command }}"{% endif %}
    {%- comment -%} aria-disabled preserves the tab stop; the disabled class only blocks pointer activation outside design mode. {%- endcomment -%}
    {%- if disabled %} aria-disabled="true"{% endif %}
    {%- if autofocus %} autofocus{% endif %}
    {%- if attributes != blank %} {{ attributes }}{% endif %}>
    {{- content -}}
  </button>
{%- endif -%}

{% doc %}
  Resource-agnostic card shell. The caller owns media, text, price, placeholders,
  overlay layout and analytics; this block never selects or derives a resource.
  The body renders in caller scope before the shell's settings are available.

  @param {string} [url] - Whole-card destination. Omit for a non-linked card; no root-route fallback is added.
  @param {string} [aria_label] - Raw accessible article/link label, escaped here. Required when url is supplied.
  @param {string} [link_mode] - 'content' (default): the body supplies one named keyboard-accessible link to url and the shell adds a pointer-only link. 'card': the shell supplies the named keyboard-accessible link; do not add a duplicate body link.
  @param {string} [class] - Additional classes on the article; overlay callers add overflow-hidden.
  @param {string} [attributes] - Additional HTML attributes on the article.

  @category content

================ FILE: blocks/container.liquid ================

{% doc %}
  Wraps page-region content in a configurable HTML element. The storefront
  shell uses dedicated `header` and `footer` blocks instead. Pass layout
  constraints and spacing via class. Fill defaults to Automatic: it infers
  Image when the resolved image source exists and Color otherwise. Color
  suppresses the background image. Switching Fill
  never clears retained color or image settings; Image keeps the color underlay.
  Callers can pass the image through `background_image:`.
  Content between {% block 'container' %}...{% endblock %} tags is rendered via
  `content`.

  @param {string} [class] - Tailwind utilities other than vertical padding; the padding setting owns `py-*`, `pt-*`, and `pb-*`.
  @param {string} [tag] - HTML element for the wrapper. Default: 'section'.
  @param {string} [background_image_loading] - Loading behavior for the background image. Default: 'lazy'.
  @param {string} [background_image_fetchpriority] - Optional fetchpriority for the background image. Use 'high' with eager LCP images.
  @param {string} [background_image_sizes] - Responsive sizes attribute for the background image. Default: 'auto' for lazy images, '100vw' for eager images.
  @param {string} [background_image_widths] - Comma-separated pixel widths for the background image srcset. Default: '375,550,750,1100,1500'.
  @param {string} [attributes] - Arbitrary HTML attributes on the wrapper (e.g. role, aria-*, id, data-*).

  @category layout
  @renders section

  @example Constrained page content
  {% block 'container', class: 'w-full max-w-page mx-auto px-margin' %}
    <h1>Page title</h1>
    <p>Body copy goes here.</p>
  {% endblock %}

  @example Color Fill suppressing an existing hero image
  {% block 'container', fill: 'color', background_image: hero_image %}
    <h1>Welcome</h1>
  {% endblock %}

  @example Image Fill with an eager full-bleed hero
  {% block 'container', fill: 'image', class: 'min-h-hero overflow-hidden', background_image: hero_image, background_image_loading: 'eager', background_image_fetchpriority: 'high', background_image_sizes: '100vw', attributes: 'aria-labelledby="hero-heading"' %}
    <h1 id="hero-heading">Welcome</h1>
  {% endblock %}

  @example Semantic tag override for a page region
  {% block 'container', tag: 'aside', class: 'px-margin max-w-page mx-auto w-full' %}
    <p>Related information</p>
  {% endblock %}
{% enddoc %}

{%- liquid
  assign tag = tag | default: 'section'
  assign bg_color = background
  assign background_image = background_image
  assign fill = fill | default: 'auto'
  unless fill == 'color' or fill == 'image'
    assign fill = 'auto'
  endunless
  assign effective_fill = fill
  if fill == 'auto'
    assign effective_fill = 'color'
    if background_image != blank
      assign effective_fill = 'image'
    endif
  endif
  assign render_background_image = false
  if effective_fill == 'image' and background_image != blank
    assign render_background_image = true
  endif
  assign background_image_loading = background_image_loading | default: 'lazy'
  assign background_image_widths = background_image_widths | default: '375,550,750,1100,1500'
  assign background_image_widths_array = background_image_widths | split: ','
  if background_image_sizes == blank
    if background_image_loading == 'lazy'
      assign background_image_sizes = 'auto'
    else
      assign background_image_sizes = '100vw'
    endif
  endif
  assign composed_class = padding
  if class != blank
    assign composed_class = composed_class | append: ' ' | append: class | strip
  endif
  if render_background_image
    if composed_class == blank
      assign composed_class = 'relative isolate'
    else
      unless composed_class contains 'relative'
        assign composed_class = 'relative ' | append: composed_class
      endunless
      unless composed_class contains 'isolate'
        assign composed_class = 'isolate ' | append: composed_class
      endunless
    endif
  endif
-%}

<{{ tag }} {% if composed_class != blank %}class="{{ composed_class }}"{% endif %}{% if attributes %} {{ attributes }}{% endif %}{% if bg_color %} style="background-color: {{ bg_color }}"{% endif %}>
  {%- if render_background_image -%}
    {%- capture background_srcset -%}
      {%- for width in background_image_widths_array -%}
        {%- assign w = width | strip | plus: 0 -%}
        {{ background_image | image_url: width: w }} {{ w }}w{%- unless forloop.last -%},{%- endunless -%}
      {%- endfor -%}
    {%- endcapture -%}

    {%- comment -%} Backgrounds use a real img so the browser can choose from srcset and honor LCP loading hints. {%- endcomment -%}
    <img
      src="{{ background_image | image_url: width: 1500 }}"
      srcset="{{ background_srcset | strip }}"
      sizes="{{ background_image_sizes | escape }}"
      loading="{{ background_image_loading | escape }}"
      {% if background_image_fetchpriority != blank %}fetchpriority="{{ background_image_fetchpriority | escape }}"{% endif %}
      alt=""
      width="{{ background_image.width }}"
      height="{{ background_image.height }}"
      class="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 -z-10 size-full object-cover"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
  {%- endif -%}

  {{ content }}
</{{ tag }}>

================ FILE: blocks/gift-card.liquid ================

{% doc %}
  Renders the complete gift-card redemption experience from the active
  `gift_card` and `shop` drops: heading and available balance, the dimensional
  Plain card carrying the merchant identity and value, the merchant logo or
  store-name fallback, redemption instructions, the copyable code, and the
  caller-composed actions. Its body renders in the action slot after the code
  and before copy feedback / Wallet. The caller must derive its copy target and
  code description ID from the same `id` it passes here; body content cannot
  read this block's locals. The card material is code-owned; no design selector
  is rendered or exposed as a block setting. Render at most once per page
  because its artwork style tag is emitted per instance.

  @param {string} [id] - Stable component/command target ID. Defaults to `gift-card-<block.id>`; callers composing copy actions must supply a known unique ID and use `<id>-code` for aria-describedby.
  @param {string} [class] - Additional Tailwind utilities for the top-level element.
  @param {string} [attributes] - Additional attributes passed through to the top-level element.

  @category commerce
  @renders s-gift-card

  @example
  {% assign gift_card_id = 'gift-card-redemption' %}
  {% assign gift_card_code_id = gift_card_id | append: '-code' %}
  {% assign gift_card_unusable = false %}
  {% if gift_card.enabled == false or gift_card.expired %}{% assign gift_card_unusable = true %}{% endif %}
  {% block 'gift-card', id: gift_card_id %}
    {% capture copy_attributes %}aria-describedby="{{ gift_card_code_id | escape }}"{% endcapture %}
    {% block 'button', commandfor: gift_card_id, command: '--copy-code', disabled: gift_card_unusable, attributes: copy_attributes %}{{ 'gift_card.copy_code' | t }}{% endblock %}
  {% endblock %}
{% enddoc %}

{%- liquid
  assign root_class = 'block w-full overflow-x-clip text-center'
  if class != blank
    assign root_class = root_class | append: ' ' | append: class
  endif

  assign default_id = 'gift-card-' | append: block.id
  assign root_id = id | default: default_id
  assign code_id = root_id | append: '-code'
  assign shop_initial = shop.name | slice: 0, 1 | upcase

  assign balance_with_currency = gift_card.balance | money_with_currency
  assign available_text = 'gift_card.available' | t: amount: balance_with_currency
  assign card_value = gift_card.initial_value | default: gift_card.balance
  assign card_value_money = card_value | money
  assign card_label = 'gift_card.card_label' | t: shop: shop.name

  assign logo = shop.brand.logo
  if logo
    assign logo_width = 380
    assign original_logo_width = logo.width | default: 0
    assign original_logo_height = logo.height | default: 0
    if original_logo_width > 0 and original_logo_height > 0
      assign logo_height = original_logo_height | times: logo_width | divided_by: original_logo_width | round
    else
      assign logo_height = 120
    endif
    assign logo_alt = logo.alt | default: shop.name
  endif
-%}

================ FILE: blocks/image.liquid ================

{% doc %}
  Renders a responsive image using Shopify's image_url and image_tag filters with
  srcset generation. Base classes are `w-full h-full object-cover` — callers should
  provide a parent element with a defined height (via aspect ratio or fixed dimensions)
  for object-cover to take effect.

  Output contract: image, texture-placeholder and opt-in surface-placeholder roots emit data-aspect-ratio
  from the escaped aspect_ratio value (schema default: 'aspect-auto';
  missing or empty values emit data-aspect-ratio=""). Parent :has() selectors can use
  the selected ratio even when an Auto placeholder renders with square geometry.

  @param {image} [fallback_image] - Shopify image fallback used when image is empty.
  @param {string} [sizes] - Responsive sizes attribute. Default: 'auto'; normalized to '100vw' when loading is eager.
  @param {string} [loading] - Optional image loading strategy. When omitted, the existing attributes passthrough controls loading.
  @param {string} [widths] - Comma-separated pixel widths for srcset. Default: '375,550,750,1100,1500'.
  @param {string} [alt] - Fallback alt text when image.alt is blank
  @param {number} [seed] - Stable seed for the placeholder texture when image is blank. Default: 1.
  @param {string} [placeholder_kind] - Placeholder context used to vary the gradient composition. 'surface' opts into the plain video-poster fallback. Default: 'image'.
  @param {string} [class] - CSS classes applied to the img element (rounding, sizing overrides, etc.)
  @param {string} [attributes] - Additional HTML attributes passed through to the root element (e.g. 'loading="eager" fetchpriority="high"'). Must be developer-supplied literals — never connected to merchant settings or user input.

  @category content
  @renders img|div|span

  @example
  {% block 'image', image: product.featured_image %}{% endblock %}
  {% block 'image', fallback_image: collections.all.products.first.featured_image, class: 'rounded', sizes: '(min-width: 768px) 50vw, 100vw' %}{% endblock %}
{% enddoc %}

{%- liquid
  assign image     = image | default: fallback_image
  assign sizes     = sizes     | default: 'auto'
  # sizes="auto" requires lazy loading; eager posters need a concrete viewport size.
  if loading == 'eager' and sizes == 'auto'
    assign sizes = '100vw'
  endif
  # Default widths are mirrored by the LCP preload imagesrcset in layout/theme.liquid —
  # keep both lists identical so preloaded candidates match rendered srcset URLs.
  assign widths    = widths    | default: '375,550,750,1100,1500'

  assign widths_array = widths | split: ','

  assign aspect_ratio = aspect_ratio

  assign class_append = ''
  if aspect_ratio != blank
    assign class_append = ' ' | append: aspect_ratio
  endif
  if class != blank
    assign class_append = class_append | append: ' ' | append: class
  endif
  assign placeholder_class = 'size-full' | append: class_append
  # Placeholder divs have no intrinsic dimensions for aspect-auto to preserve.
  if aspect_ratio == 'aspect-auto'
    assign placeholder_class = 'size-full aspect-square ' | append: class | strip
  endif
  assign placeholder_seed = seed | default: 1
-%}

{%- capture aspect_ratio_attributes -%}data-aspect-ratio="{{ aspect_ratio | escape }}"{%- endcapture -%}

{%- unless image -%}
  {%- if placeholder_kind == 'surface' -%}
    <span class="block size-full bg-surface-secondary{% if class != blank %} {{ class }}{% endif %}" {{ aspect_ratio_attributes }}></span>
  {%- else -%}
    {% render 'placeholder-texture', kind: placeholder_kind, seed: placeholder_seed, class: placeholder_class, attributes: aspect_ratio_attributes, aria_label: alt %}
  {%- endif -%}
{%- endunless -%}

{%- if image -%}
{%- capture srcset -%}
  {%- for width in widths_array -%}
    {%- assign w = width | strip | plus: 0 -%}
    {{ image | image_url: width: w }} {{ w }}w{%- unless forloop.last -%},{%- endunless -%}
  {%- endfor -%}
{%- endcapture -%}

  {%- comment -%} The `attributes` param carries loading="eager" and fetchpriority="high" for LCP images.
    Callers (e.g. product.liquid) pass these explicitly — do not add default loading/fetchpriority
    here or it will override the caller's intent and hurt Core Web Vitals. {%- endcomment -%}
  <img
    src="{{ image | image_url: width: 750 }}"
    srcset="{{ srcset | strip }}"
    sizes="{{ sizes | escape }}"
    {% if loading != blank %} loading="{{ loading | escape }}"{% endif %}
    {% if attributes != blank %} {{ attributes }}{% endif %}
    alt="{{ image.alt | default: alt | escape }}"
    width="{{ image.width }}"
    height="{{ image.height }}"
    class="size-full object-cover{{ class_append }}"
    {{ aspect_ratio_attributes }}
  >
{%- endif -%}

{% schema %}
  {
    "name": "t:blocks.image",
    "settings": [
      {
        "type": "image_picker",
        "id": "image",
        "label": "t:blocks.image_settings.image"
      },
      {
        "type": "select",
        "id": "aspect_ratio",
        "label": "t:blocks.image_settings.aspect_ratio",
        "default": "aspect-auto",
        "options": [
          { "value": "aspect-auto",    "label": "t:blocks.image_settings.auto" },
          { "value": "aspect-square",  "label": "t:blocks.image_settings.square" },
          { "value": "aspect-video",   "label": "t:general.video" },
          { "value": "aspect-[3/4]",   "label": "t:blocks.image_settings.portrait" }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
{% endschema %}


================ FILE: blocks/link.liquid ================

{% doc %}
  Renders an ordinary text link as an `<a>`. Use this block for standalone
  navigation links, not commands, form submitters, card overlays, or

  so the rendered anchor always has a valid destination.

  @param {string} [attributes] - Additional HTML attributes passed through to the anchor.

  @category interactive
  @renders a

  @example

{% enddoc %}

{%- liquid
  assign url = url | default: routes.root_url

  assign base_class = 'inline-flex min-h-touch-target items-center type-body text-on-surface underline underline-offset-2 rounded-sm hover:text-on-surface-secondary focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-accent motion-safe:transition-[color,transform] motion-safe:active:scale-[0.97]'
  assign full_class = base_class
  if class != blank
    assign full_class = full_class | append: ' ' | append: class
  endif

<a href="{{ url | escape }}" class="{{ full_class }}"{% if attributes != blank %} {{ attributes }}{% endif %}>{{ content }}</a>

================ FILE: blocks/logo.liquid ================

{% doc %}
  Renders the shop's brand mark as a link to the storefront homepage. Falls
  back to the shop name in text when no logo image is set. Used in the header
  of `layout/theme.liquid`.

  The image resolves from `image`, then `shop.brand.logo`,
  then text fallback. Callers can set `image:`. Logo size and
  custom height also come from the block's editor settings.

  @param {string} [class] - Additional CSS classes on the root `<a>` element.
  @param {string} [attributes] - Additional HTML attributes passed through to the root `<a>` element.

  @category content
  @renders a

  @example
  {% block 'logo' %}{% endblock %}

  {% block 'logo', class: 'mx-auto' %}{% endblock %}
{% enddoc %}

{%- liquid
  assign image          = image | default: shop.brand.logo
  assign has_logo_image = false
  if image != blank
    assign has_logo_image = true
  endif

  assign size       = size | default: 'logo-size-custom'
  assign height     = height | default: 32
  assign size_class = size
  if size == 'logo-size-custom'
    assign size_class = 'w-auto'
  endif

  assign base_class = 'inline-flex items-center text-lg font-medium no-underline text-on-surface focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-accent rounded-sm'
  assign full_class = base_class
  if class != blank
    assign full_class = full_class | append: ' ' | append: class
  endif
-%}

<a href="{{ routes.root_url }}" class="{{ full_class }}"{% if attributes != blank %} {{ attributes }}{% endif %}>
  {%- if image -%}
    {%- liquid
      assign render_width = image.width | times: height | divided_by: image.height
      assign logo_alt = image.alt | default: shop.name
    -%}
    <img src="{{ image | image_url: width: 400 }}" alt="{{ logo_alt | escape }}" width="{{ render_width }}" height="{{ height }}"{% if size == 'logo-size-custom' %} style="height:{{ height }}px"{% endif %} loading="eager" class="{{ size_class }}" />
  {%- else -%}
    {{ shop.name | escape }}
  {%- endif -%}
</a>

{% comment %} Image-only controls follow the resolved caller, editor, or Brand image rather than only the picker. {% endcomment %}
