================ FILE: blocks/main-menu.liquid ================

{% doc %}
  Renders the primary navigation. The desktop `<nav>` uses multi-level
  `s-nav-dropdown` behavior; the specialized mobile drawer is composed from
  this block so both presentations use the same selected menu. When no menu is
  selected, the standard `main-menu` link list is used automatically. If that
  fallback has no links, the desktop nav is omitted while the mobile drawer
  remains available for its localization controls. Optional body content
  renders before the desktop link list.

  @param {string} [class] - Additional CSS classes on the desktop `<nav>` element. Overrides the default desktop layout classes when set.
  @param {string} [attributes] - Additional HTML attributes passed through to the root `<nav>` element.
  @param {string} mobile_nav_close_button - Captured layout-owned close button for mobile-nav-drawer. @required
  @param {string} mobile_nav_localization_submit - Captured layout-owned submit button for the mobile language selector. @required

  @category navigation
  @renders nav

  @example
  {%- capture close_attributes -%}aria-label="{{ 'general.close' | t | escape }}"{%- endcapture -%}
  {%- capture mobile_close -%}
    {% block 'button', commandfor: 'mobile-nav-drawer', command: 'close', variant: 'button-ghost', class: 'ms-auto size-touch-target rounded hover:bg-transparent hover:opacity-70', attributes: close_attributes %}<span class="inline-flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 size-5" aria-hidden="true">{{- 'icon-x.svg' | inline_asset_content -}}</span>{% endblock %}
  {%- endcapture -%}
  {% capture update_button %}
    {% block 'button', type: 'submit', variant: 'button-secondary' %}{{ 'localization.update_language' | t }}{% endblock %}
  {% endcapture %}
  {% block 'main-menu', mobile_nav_close_button: mobile_close, mobile_nav_localization_submit: update_button %}{% endblock %}
{% enddoc %}

{%- liquid
  assign menu = menu | default: linklists.main-menu

  assign variant = variant | default: 'type-body'
  assign text_color = color
  assign dropdown_color = dropdown_color

  assign nav_class = class | default: 'hidden md:flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-wrap items-center gap-x-8 gap-y-2 mx-8'
-%}

{% if menu.links.size > 0 %}
<nav aria-label="{{ 'header.navigation' | t }}" class="{{ nav_class }}" data-desktop-nav {% if attributes != blank %}{{ attributes }}{% endif %}>
  {{ content }}
  {%- comment -%} role="list" keeps the list structure exposed to assistive tech (it communicates the navigation hierarchy, and VoiceOver drops list semantics when there is no list-style); display:contents keeps the items as direct flex children of the <nav> so the existing flex-wrap layout is unchanged. {%- endcomment -%}
  <ul role="list" class="contents">
  {% for link in menu.links %}
    {% if link.links.size > 0 %}
      {%- assign panel_id = 'nav-panel-' | append: forloop.index -%}
      {%- assign disclosure_title = link.title | escape -%}
      {%- capture disclosure_label -%}{{ 'header.show_submenu' | t: title: disclosure_title }}{%- endcapture -%}
      <s-nav-dropdown class="nav-has-dropdown" role="listitem">
        {%- comment -%} The link goes to the item's page; the separate button shows/hides the submenu (its aria-expanded is kept in sync by s-nav-dropdown.js). The button is only visible on keyboard focus, so mouse users still open the submenu by hovering. {%- endcomment -%}
        <a href="{{ link.url }}"
          class="{{ variant }} shrink-0 no-underline{% if text_color == blank %} text-on-surface{% endif %} hover:opacity-70 motion-safe:transition-opacity focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-accent rounded-sm whitespace-nowrap"
          {%- if text_color != blank %} style="color: {{ text_color }}"{% endif %}
          {%- if link.current %} aria-current="page"{% endif %}>
          {{ link.title | escape }}
        </a>
        <button type="button" class="nav-disclosure" data-nav-disclosure aria-controls="{{ panel_id }}" aria-expanded="false">
          <span class="sr-only">{{ disclosure_label }}</span>
          <span class="nav-disclosure-icon" aria-hidden="true">{{- 'icon-chevron-down.svg' | inline_asset_content -}}</span>
        </button>
        <div class="nav-dropdown" id="{{ panel_id }}">
          {%- comment -%} role="list"/role="listitem" convey the submenu hierarchy to assistive tech; the display:contents groups and leaf <li>s keep the existing grid layout. {%- endcomment -%}

================ FILE: blocks/pagination.liquid ================

{% doc %}
  Renders accessible pagination controls using Shopify's paginate object.

  One numbered treatment is shared by every paginated template so storefront and
  Canvas presentation stay consistent. The active page uses the theme's
  interactive tokens; there is no per-block style or color override.

  @param {object} paginate - Shopify paginate object; provided by a `paginate` tag in the calling template. @required
  @param {string} [class] - Additional classes to apply to the nav element.
  @param {string} [attributes] - Additional HTML attributes passed through to the root element.
  @param {string} [prev] - HTML content to replace the default left-arrow icon inside the previous button wrapper.
  @param {string} [next] - HTML content to replace the default right-arrow icon inside the next button wrapper.
  @param {string} [summary] - HTML content rendered before the `<nav>` element (e.g. "Showing 1–24 of 96 results").

  @category layout
  @renders nav[aria-label=Pagination]
  @context paginate

  @example
  {% paginate collection.products by 24 %}
    {% for product in collection.products %}
      ...
    {% endfor %}
    {% block 'pagination', paginate: paginate %}{% endblock %}
  {% endpaginate %}
{% enddoc %}

{%- liquid
  assign class_append = ''
  if class != blank
    assign class_append = ' ' | append: class
  endif
-%}

{%- if paginate != blank and paginate.pages > 1 -%}
  {%- if summary != blank -%}
    {{ summary }}
  {%- endif -%}

  <nav aria-label="{{ 'general.pagination.label' | t }}" class="flex items-center justify-center gap-1{{ class_append }}"{% if attributes != blank %} {{ attributes }}{% endif %}>
    {%- if paginate.previous -%}
      <a
        href="{{ paginate.previous.url }}"
        class="inline-flex items-center justify-center min-w-touch-target min-h-touch-target rounded text-sm hover:bg-surface-secondary motion-safe:transition-[color,background-color,transform] motion-safe:duration-150 motion-safe:active:scale-[0.95]"
        aria-label="{{ 'general.pagination.previous_page' | t }}"
      >
        {%- if prev != blank -%}
          {{ prev }}
        {%- else -%}
          <span class="inline-flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 size-3.5 rtl:-scale-x-100" aria-hidden="true">{{- 'icon-chevron-left.svg' | inline_asset_content -}}</span>
        {%- endif -%}
      </a>
    {%- else -%}
      <span class="inline-flex items-center justify-center min-w-touch-target min-h-touch-target rounded text-sm text-on-surface-secondary opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed" role="link" aria-disabled="true" aria-label="{{ 'general.pagination.previous_page' | t }}">
        {%- if prev != blank -%}
          {{ prev }}
        {%- else -%}
          <span class="inline-flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 size-3.5 rtl:-scale-x-100" aria-hidden="true">{{- 'icon-chevron-left.svg' | inline_asset_content -}}</span>
        {%- endif -%}
      </span>
    {%- endif -%}

    {%- for part in paginate.parts -%}
      {%- if part.is_link -%}
        <a
          href="{{ part.url }}"
          class="inline-flex items-center justify-center min-w-touch-target min-h-touch-target rounded text-sm hover:bg-surface-secondary motion-safe:transition-[color,background-color,transform] motion-safe:duration-150 motion-safe:active:scale-[0.95]"
          aria-label="{{ 'general.pagination.page' | t: number: part.title }}"
        >
          {{- part.title -}}
        </a>
      {%- elsif part.title == '&hellip;' or part.title == '…' -%}
        <span class="min-w-touch-target min-h-touch-target inline-flex items-center justify-center text-on-surface-secondary" aria-hidden="true">
          &hellip;
        </span>
      {%- else -%}
        <span
          aria-current="page"
          class="inline-flex items-center justify-center min-w-touch-target min-h-touch-target rounded text-sm bg-interactive text-interactive-text font-medium"
        >
          <span class="sr-only">{{ 'general.pagination.current_page' | t: number: part.title }}</span>
          <span aria-hidden="true">{{- part.title -}}</span>
        </span>
      {%- endif -%}
    {%- endfor -%}

    {%- if paginate.next -%}
      <a
        href="{{ paginate.next.url }}"
        class="inline-flex items-center justify-center min-w-touch-target min-h-touch-target rounded text-sm hover:bg-surface-secondary motion-safe:transition-[color,background-color,transform] motion-safe:duration-150 motion-safe:active:scale-[0.95]"
        aria-label="{{ 'general.pagination.next_page' | t }}"
      >
        {%- if next != blank -%}
          {{ next }}
        {%- else -%}
          <span class="inline-flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 size-3.5 rtl:-scale-x-100" aria-hidden="true">{{- 'icon-chevron-right.svg' | inline_asset_content -}}</span>
        {%- endif -%}
      </a>
    {%- else -%}
      <span class="inline-flex items-center justify-center min-w-touch-target min-h-touch-target rounded text-sm text-on-surface-secondary opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed" role="link" aria-disabled="true" aria-label="{{ 'general.pagination.next_page' | t }}">
        {%- if next != blank -%}
          {{ next }}
        {%- else -%}
          <span class="inline-flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 size-3.5 rtl:-scale-x-100" aria-hidden="true">{{- 'icon-chevron-right.svg' | inline_asset_content -}}</span>
        {%- endif -%}
      </span>
    {%- endif -%}
  </nav>

================ FILE: blocks/price.liquid ================

{% doc %}
  Renders a product price block, handling sale prices, compare-at prices,
  savings percentages, and price ranges. Uses semantic color tokens so sale
  prices are visually distinct from regular prices.

  @param {number} price - Current price in cents (e.g. variant.price). @required
  @param {number} [compare_at_price] - Original/compare-at price in cents. When greater than price, the item is considered on sale.
  @param {number} [price_min] - Minimum price for product ranges (e.g. product.price_min).
  @param {number} [price_max] - Maximum price for product ranges (e.g. product.price_max).
  @param {boolean} [show_currency] - When true, uses the money_with_currency filter. Default: false.
  @param {string} [class] - Additional CSS classes to append to the root element. Weight follows the variant, so pass `font-medium` here when the composition wants an emphasized price.
  @param {string} [attributes] - Additional HTML attributes passed through to the root element.

  @category commerce
  @renders div

  @example
  {% block 'price', price: variant.price %}{% endblock %}
  {% block 'price', price: variant.price, compare_at_price: variant.compare_at_price %}{% endblock %}
  {% block 'price', price: variant.price, price_min: product.price_min, price_max: product.price_max %}{% endblock %}
  {% block 'price', price: variant.price, compare_at_price: variant.compare_at_price, show_currency: true %}{% endblock %}
  {% block 'price', price: variant.price, variant: 'type-heading-sm', class: 'font-medium' %}{% endblock %}
{% enddoc %}

{%- liquid
  assign show_currency = show_currency | default: false
  assign variant       = variant | default: 'type-body'
  assign color         = color

  assign price_style = ''
  if color != blank
    assign price_style = 'color: ' | append: color
  endif

  assign is_range = false
  if price_min != blank and price_max != blank and price_min != price_max
    assign is_range = true
  endif

  assign on_sale = false
  if compare_at_price != blank and compare_at_price > price
    assign on_sale = true
  endif

  if is_range
    if show_currency
      assign min_formatted = price_min | money_with_currency
      assign max_formatted = price_max | money_with_currency
    else
      assign min_formatted = price_min | money
      assign max_formatted = price_max | money
    endif
  elsif on_sale
    if show_currency
      assign price_formatted          = price | money_with_currency
      assign compare_at_price_formatted = compare_at_price | money_with_currency
    else
      assign price_formatted          = price | money
      assign compare_at_price_formatted = compare_at_price | money
    endif
    assign savings         = compare_at_price | minus: price
    assign savings_percent = savings | times: 100.0 | divided_by: compare_at_price | round
  else
    if show_currency
      assign price_formatted = price | money_with_currency
    else
      assign price_formatted = price | money
    endif
  endif
-%}

{%- comment -%} No hardcoded weight inside: the variant (or a caller `font-medium`) owns font-weight so a given text style matches the text block.
  Each formatted amount sits in <bdi> so the bidi algorithm cannot reorder currency symbols, minus signs or range separators inside RTL text; a no-op in LTR. {%- endcomment -%}
<div class="{{ variant }} inline-flex items-baseline gap-2 flex-wrap{% if class %} {{ class }}{% endif %}"{% if attributes != blank %} {{ attributes }}{% endif %}>
  {%- if is_range -%}
    <span class="text-on-surface"{% if price_style != blank %} style="{{ price_style }}"{% endif %}>
      <span class="sr-only">{{ 'products.price.price_range_label' | t }}: </span>
      {%- capture range_text -%}{{ 'products.price.price_range_html' | t: min: min_formatted, max: max_formatted }}{%- endcapture -%}
      <bdi>{{ range_text }}</bdi>
    </span>
  {%- elsif on_sale -%}
    <span class="text-sale"{% if price_style != blank %} style="{{ price_style }}"{% endif %}>
      <span class="sr-only">{{ 'products.price.sale_price' | t }}: </span>
      <bdi>{{ price_formatted }}</bdi>
    </span>
    {%- comment -%} <s> (strikethrough) is the correct semantic element for the original price; the color setting intentionally overrides compare-at color with the rest of the price. {%- endcomment -%}
    <s class="text-compare text-sm"{% if price_style != blank %} style="{{ price_style }}"{% endif %}>
      <span class="sr-only">{{ 'products.price.regular_price' | t }}: </span>
      <bdi>{{ compare_at_price_formatted }}</bdi>
    </s>
    {%- capture savings_percent_label %}{{ savings_percent }}%{%- endcapture -%}
    <span class="text-sale text-sm"{% if price_style != blank %} style="{{ price_style }}"{% endif %}>
      <span class="sr-only">{{ 'products.price.savings' | t: amount: savings_percent_label }}</span>
      <bdi aria-hidden="true">(-{{ savings_percent }}%)</bdi>
    </span>
  {%- else -%}
    <span class="text-on-surface"{% if price_style != blank %} style="{{ price_style }}"{% endif %}>
      <span class="sr-only">{{ 'products.price.price' | t }}: </span>
      <bdi>{{ price_formatted }}</bdi>
    </span>
  {%- endif -%}
</div>

================ FILE: blocks/quantity-selector.liquid ================

{% doc %}
  Renders a numeric quantity selector using the `<s-quantity-selector>` Web
  Component. Decrement and increment buttons flank a number input. The Web
  Component handles clamping, step arithmetic, and button disabled states.

  @param {string} [name] - Input name attribute.
  @param {string} [id] - Input id attribute.
  @param {number} [value] - Initial quantity. Default: 1.
  @param {number} [min] - Minimum allowed value. Default: 1.
  @param {number} [max] - Maximum allowed value. When blank/nil, no maximum is enforced.
  @param {number} [step] - Step increment. Default: 1.
  @param {boolean} [disabled] - Disables all interactive elements. Default: false.
  @param {string} [class] - Additional CSS classes to append to the component element.
  @param {string} [attributes] - Additional HTML attributes passed through to the root element.

  @category forms
  @renders s-quantity-selector

  @example
  {% block 'quantity-selector' %}{% endblock %}
  {% block 'quantity-selector', name: 'quantity', value: 2, min: 1, max: 10 %}{% endblock %}
  {% block 'quantity-selector', name: 'qty', id: 'product-qty', disabled: true %}{% endblock %}

{% enddoc %}

{%- liquid
  assign name     = name
  assign value    = value | default: 1
  assign min      = min | default: 1
  assign step     = step | default: 1
  assign disabled = disabled | default: false
  assign style    = style
  assign button_style = ''
  # Lock icon color to an auto-derived contrast value when merchants set a custom button background.
  if button_color != blank
    assign button_style = 'background-color: ' | append: button_color | append: ';'
    assign button_brightness = button_color | color_brightness
    if button_brightness > 128
      assign button_style = button_style | append: 'color: #000;'
    else
      assign button_style = button_style | append: 'color: #fff;'
    endif
  endif
-%}

{%- comment -%} Instance scope prevents repeated public blocks from sharing a command target. {%- endcomment -%}
{%- liquid
  # Fall back to form attributes only in static/test contexts where block.id is blank.
  if block.id != blank
    assign _qs_id = 'qs-' | append: block.id | handleize
  else
    assign _qs_id = 'qs-' | append: name | append: '-' | append: id | handleize
  endif
-%}

{%- comment -%} <s-quantity-selector> reads [data-decrement], [data-increment], the nested <input>, and data-quantity-label. Commands: --step-up, --step-down (custom, not native step). See assets/s-quantity-selector.js class JSDoc. {%- endcomment -%}

  class="inline-flex items-center {{ style }} rounded-input{% if class != blank %} {{ class }}{% endif %}"{% if attributes != blank %} {{ attributes }}{% endif %}>
  <button type="button" data-decrement commandfor="{{ _qs_id }}" command="--step-down"

    aria-label="{{ 'products.quantity.decrease' | t }}"
    {% if button_style != blank %}style="{{ button_style }}" {% endif %}{% if disabled %}disabled{% endif %}>
    <span class="inline-flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 size-4" aria-hidden="true">{{- 'icon-minus.svg' | inline_asset_content -}}</span>
  </button>
  {%- comment -%} This number input (name="{{ name }}") is authoritative for quantity in the form POST.
    Display-only mirror inputs (e.g. in cart-line-item.liquid) must stay in sync but are not submitted. {%- endcomment -%}
  <input type="number" name="{{ name }}"{% if id != blank %} id="{{ id }}"{% endif %}
    value="{{ value }}"
    min="{{ min }}"{% if max != blank %} max="{{ max }}"{% endif %} step="{{ step }}"
    class="w-12 h-11 text-center border-0 rounded-none p-0 bg-transparent text-on-surface text-sm [appearance:textfield] [&::-webkit-outer-spin-button]:appearance-none [&::-webkit-inner-spin-button]:appearance-none"
    {% if disabled %}disabled{% endif %}
    aria-label="{{ 'products.quantity.input_label' | t }}">
  <button type="button" data-increment commandfor="{{ _qs_id }}" command="--step-up"
    class="inline-flex items-center justify-center size-11 text-on-surface-secondary{% if button_style == blank %} hover:text-on-surface{% endif %} cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed motion-safe:transition-[color,transform] motion-safe:active:scale-[0.90]"

================ FILE: blocks/text.liquid ================

{% doc %}
  Renders a typography element with a variant-driven utility class. The
  rendered tag and typographic style are both configurable. Body content
  is composed via `{{ content }}`.

  Variant is a component class defined in `@layer components` in
  `config/styles.css`. Pass the full class name directly (e.g.
  `type-heading-xl`), the same pattern used by button blocks.
  Because variants live in the components layer, utility classes passed
  via `class` will reliably override variant properties.

  The `variant` setting is the shared typography contract: `price` and
  `main-menu` expose the same id, label, `type-*` options, ordering, and default,
  so one choice renders identically across all three blocks.

  @param {string} [tag] - HTML element. Default: 'p'. One of: h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, p, span
  @param {string} [class] - Color, spacing, additional Tailwind classes appended after variant class.
  @param {string} [attributes] - Additional HTML attributes passed through to the root element.

  @category typography
  @renders h1|h2|h3|h4|h5|h6|p|span

  @example
  {% block 'text', variant: 'type-display' %}Welcome to our store{% endblock %}

  {% block 'text', variant: 'type-heading-xl', tag: 'h1' %}Featured Collection{% endblock %}

  {% block 'text', variant: 'type-heading-md', tag: 'h2', class: 'text-on-surface-secondary' %}Spring 2024{% endblock %}

  {% block 'text', variant: 'type-body-lg' %}
    Discover our curated selection of premium products.
  {% endblock %}

  {% block 'text', variant: 'type-overline', class: 'text-accent' %}New Arrivals{% endblock %}

  {% block 'text', variant: 'type-body-sm', tag: 'span', class: 'text-on-surface-secondary' %}Ships in 2-5 days{% endblock %}
{% enddoc %}

{%- liquid
  assign variant = variant | default: 'type-body'
  assign tag     = tag     | default: 'p'
  assign color   = color

  if class != blank
    assign full_class = variant | append: ' ' | append: class
  else
    assign full_class = variant
  endif
-%}

<{{ tag }} class="{{ full_class }}"{% if color != blank %} style="color: {{ color }}"{% endif %}{% if attributes != blank %} {{ attributes }}{% endif %}>{{ content }}</{{ tag }}>

================ FILE: blocks/variant-picker.liquid ================

{% doc %}
  Renders one product option as a fieldset. Swatch controls are generated from
  option values via the internal swatch snippet only when every value has swatch
  data and the effective style is swatch. Otherwise it renders a native dropdown
  or pill controls. Size and shape belong to this picker usage, not individual
  generated swatches. This block is self-contained: callers must leave the
  required block/endblock body empty; it has no content outlet. The product
  form owns the sole selected-variant hidden input outside this block. See
  docs/variant-picker-source-migration.md.

  @param {product} product - Shopify product object used for the default form ID. @required
  @param {object} option - One entry from product.options_with_values. @required
  @param {string} [form_id] - HTML id of the parent `<form>` element. Defaults to the product id.
  @param {string} [option_type] - Selector style. Overrides style when provided. Default: 'swatch'. One of: 'buttons'|'dropdown'|'swatch'. Swatch mode falls back to buttons for options without swatch data.
  @param {boolean} [show_selected_value] - When true, append `: <selected value>` after the option name in the legend. Default: false.
  @param {string} [class] - Additional CSS classes to append to the root element.
  @param {string} [attributes] - Additional HTML attributes passed through to the root element.

  @category commerce
  @renders div
  @context product

  @example
  {% for option in product.options_with_values %}
    {% block 'variant-picker', product: product, option: option, show_selected_value: true, radius: 'rounded-full', size: 'swatch-lg', shape: 'rounded-md' %}{% endblock %}
  {% endfor %}
{% enddoc %}

{%- liquid
  assign form_id             = form_id | default: product.id
  assign show_selected_value = show_selected_value | default: false

  assign style_setting = style | default: 'swatch'
  if option_type == blank
    if style_setting == 'dropdown'
      assign option_type = 'dropdown'
    elsif style_setting == 'buttons'
      assign option_type = 'buttons'
    else
      assign option_type = 'swatch'
    endif
  endif

  assign radius = radius | default: 'rounded-md'
  assign size = size | default: 'swatch-md'
  assign shape = shape | default: 'rounded-full'
  assign has_swatches = false
  if option_type == 'swatch' and option.values.size > 0
    assign has_swatches = true
    for value in option.values
      if value.swatch == blank
        assign has_swatches = false
        break
      endif
    endfor
  endif
-%}

<div class="{% if class != blank %}{{ class }}{% endif %}"{% if attributes != blank %} {{ attributes }}{% endif %}>
  <fieldset class="space-y-2">
    <legend class="text-sm font-medium text-on-surface">
      {{- option.name | escape -}}
      {%- if show_selected_value %}: {{ option.selected_value | escape }}{% endif -%}
    </legend>

    {%- if option_type == 'swatch' and has_swatches -%}
      <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {%- for value in option.values -%}
          {%- assign variant_unavailable = false -%}
          {%- if value.variant.available == false -%}
            {%- assign variant_unavailable = true -%}
          {%- endif -%}
          {%- render 'swatch', name: option.name, value: value, swatch: value.swatch,
            selected: value.selected, unavailable: variant_unavailable,
            disabled: variant_unavailable, data_variant_id: value.variant.id,
            size: size, shape: shape -%}
        {%- endfor -%}
      </div>

    {%- elsif option_type == 'dropdown' -%}
      <select
        name="{{ option.name | escape }}"
        id="{{ form_id | escape }}-option-{{ option.position }}-{{ option.name | handleize }}"
        class="cursor-pointer hover:border-interactive {{ radius }}"
        aria-label="{{ option.name | escape }}">
        {%- for value in option.values -%}
          <option value="{{ value | escape }}" data-variant-id="{{ value.variant.id }}"{% if value.selected %} selected{% endif %}>
            {{- value | escape -}}
          </option>
        {%- endfor -%}
      </select>

    {%- else -%}
      <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {%- for value in option.values -%}
          {%- assign input_id = form_id | append: '-' | append: option.name | handleize | append: '-' | append: value | handleize -%}
          {%- assign variant_available = value.variant.available -%}
          <label class="relative motion-safe:transition-transform motion-safe:active:scale-[0.97]{% if variant_available %} cursor-pointer{% else %} opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed pointer-events-none{% endif %}" for="{{ input_id }}">
            <input
              type="radio"
              name="{{ option.name | escape }}"
              value="{{ value | escape }}"
              id="{{ input_id }}"
              class="peer sr-only"
              data-variant-id="{{ value.variant.id }}"
              {% if value.selected %}checked{% endif %}
              {% unless variant_available %}disabled{% endunless %}>
            <span class="inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1.5 text-sm border {{ radius }} cursor-pointer
              {% if variant_available == false %}border-on-surface{% else %}border-border{% endif %} text-on-surface
              peer-not-checked:hover:bg-surface-secondary
              peer-checked:bg-interactive peer-checked:text-interactive-text peer-checked:border-interactive
              peer-focus-visible:ring-2 peer-focus-visible:ring-accent peer-focus-visible:ring-offset-2
              {% if variant_available == false %}relative overflow-hidden{% endif %}">
              {{- value | escape -}}
              {%- if variant_available == false -%}
                <span class="sr-only">({{ 'product.sold_out' | t }})</span>
                {%- comment -%} Linear-gradient strikethrough (not `<s>`) because these pills are an inline-flex container with no text baseline for native strikethrough to draw against — the gradient spans the full pill corner-to-corner regardless of label length. The sr-only "(sold out)" above carries the semantics. {%- endcomment -%}
                <span class="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none rounded-input [background:linear-gradient(to_top_right,transparent_calc(50%_-_0.5px),var(--color-on-surface)_50%,transparent_calc(50%_+_0.5px))]" aria-hidden="true"></span>
              {%- endif -%}
            </span>
          </label>
        {%- endfor -%}
      </div>
    {%- endif -%}
  </fieldset>
</div>

================ FILE: blocks/video.liquid ================

{% doc %}
  Renders video content: Shopify-hosted video via video_tag, or external
  YouTube/Vimeo via deferred iframe loading. Shows a poster image with play
  button; the `<s-video>` Web Component handles click-to-load for external videos.
  The caller owns an image block in the external poster body. Hosted video ignores the body.
  @param {string} [caption_url] - URL of a WebVTT captions file. When provided, adds a <track> element inside the Shopify-hosted video.
  @param {string} [class] - Additional CSS classes applied to the top-level element.
  @param {string} [attributes] - Additional HTML attributes passed through to the root element.

  @category content
  @renders s-video

  @example
  {% block 'video', video: product.media[0] %}{% endblock %}
  {% block 'video', youtube_id: 'dQw4w9WgXcQ' %}
    {% block 'image', image: product.featured_image, loading: 'lazy', placeholder_kind: 'surface' %}{% endblock %}
  {% endblock %}
  {% block 'video', vimeo_id: '123456789', class: 'aspect-4/3' %}
    {% block 'image', loading: 'lazy', placeholder_kind: 'surface' %}{% endblock %}
  {% endblock %}
  {% block 'video', youtube_id: 'abc123' %}
    {% block 'image', image: image, loading: 'eager', sizes: 'auto', placeholder_kind: 'surface' %}{% endblock %}
  {% endblock %}
{% enddoc %}

{%- liquid
  assign video = video
  assign youtube_id = youtube_id
  assign vimeo_id = vimeo_id
  assign ratio = ratio

  assign autoplay = autoplay | default: false
  assign loop = loop | default: false
  assign muted = muted | default: false
  assign plays_inline = plays_inline | default: false
  assign pause_on_hover = pause_on_hover | default: false

  assign _s_video_class = 'relative block overflow-hidden'
  if ratio != blank
    assign _s_video_class = _s_video_class | append: ' ' | append: ratio
  endif
  if autoplay
    assign _s_video_class = _s_video_class | append: ' autoplay'
  endif
  if plays_inline
    assign _s_video_class = _s_video_class | append: ' plays-inline'
  endif
  if pause_on_hover
    assign _s_video_class = _s_video_class | append: ' pause-on-hover'
  endif
  if class != blank
    assign _s_video_class = _s_video_class | append: ' ' | append: class
  endif

  assign _video_id = 'video-' | append: block.id
  if video == blank
    if youtube_id != blank
      # YouTube — deferred iframe. Keep autoplay=1 so click-to-load starts playback; the autoplay setting controls whether the iframe is loaded immediately.
      assign _iframe_src = 'https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/' | append: youtube_id | append: '?autoplay=1&rel=0'
      if loop
        assign _iframe_src = _iframe_src | append: '&loop=1&playlist=' | append: youtube_id
      endif
      if muted
        assign _iframe_src = _iframe_src | append: '&mute=1'
      endif
      if plays_inline
        assign _iframe_src = _iframe_src | append: '&playsinline=1'
      endif
      if pause_on_hover
        assign _iframe_src = _iframe_src | append: '&enablejsapi=1'
      endif
      assign _preconnect_origin = 'https://www.youtube-nocookie.com'
      assign _iframe_allow = 'autoplay; encrypted-media'
    elsif vimeo_id != blank
      # Vimeo — deferred iframe. Keep autoplay=1 so click-to-load starts playback; the autoplay setting controls whether the iframe is loaded immediately.
      assign _iframe_src = 'https://player.vimeo.com/video/' | append: vimeo_id | append: '?autoplay=1'
      if loop
        assign _iframe_src = _iframe_src | append: '&loop=1'
      endif
      if muted
        assign _iframe_src = _iframe_src | append: '&muted=1'
      endif
      if plays_inline
        assign _iframe_src = _iframe_src | append: '&playsinline=1'
      endif
      if pause_on_hover
        assign _iframe_src = _iframe_src | append: '&api=1'
      endif
      assign _preconnect_origin = 'https://player.vimeo.com'
      assign _iframe_allow = 'autoplay; fullscreen'
    endif
  endif
-%}

{%- comment -%} <s-video> implements click-to-load + preconnect-on-hover for embedded video. It reads [data-play][data-preconnect], template[data-video], and data-caption-url / data-video-title. Command: --play (custom, not native). See assets/s-video.js class JSDoc. {%- endcomment -%}
{%- comment -%} `overflow-hidden` clips the JS-injected iframe (which has no border-radius of its own) to whatever rounded corners the caller passes via `class`. Removing this leaves squared iframe corners poking out of rounded containers. {%- endcomment -%}
<s-video id="{{ _video_id }}" class="{{ _s_video_class }}" data-video-title="{{ 'general.video_player' | t | escape }}"{% if caption_url != blank %} data-caption-url="{{ caption_url | escape }}" data-caption-srclang="{{ request.locale.iso_code | escape }}" data-caption-label="{{ 'general.captions' | t | escape }}"{% endif %}{% if attributes != blank %} {{ attributes }}{% endif %}>

  {%- elsif _iframe_src -%}
    {%- comment -%} `<button>` used (not `<div>`) so keyboard/screen-reader users get native play semantics; `border-0 bg-transparent p-0` strip default UA button chrome so the poster image fills the element edge-to-edge. {%- endcomment -%}
    <button
      type="button"
      data-play
      commandfor="{{ _video_id }}"
      command="--play"
      data-preconnect="{{ _preconnect_origin | escape }}"

      aria-label="{{ 'general.play_video' | t }}"
    >
      {{ content }}

        </span>

    </button>

  {%- endif -%}
</s-video>

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   OVERLAY PANELS (drawers + modal dialogs)
   `overlay-panel` (components layer) owns the chrome every native-dialog
   surface shares: element reset, surface background, shadow, fade/slide
   transition, backdrop fade, @starting-style entry, and reduced-motion
   zeroing. Position treatments use utilities (defined below or composed at
   their owner) so placement, radius, max-height, and zoom override the base.
   Motion is parameterized: variants set --panel-closed-transform (closed and
   @starting-style pose) and --panel-backdrop (open backdrop color).
   Call sites pair overlay-panel with their position treatment.
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

@layer base {
  /* showModal() makes the page inert but still lets wheel/touch scroll reach the document
     behind the backdrop. Lock the root while any modal dialog is open; overflow keeps the
     scroll offset, so closing lands on the exact prior position. Deliberately no
     scrollbar-gutter here: a modal-only gutter shifts fixed UI on pages that had no scrollbar. */
  html:has(dialog:modal) {
    overflow: hidden;
  }
}

@layer components {
  .overlay-panel {
    border: none;
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
    max-width: none;
    max-height: none;
    overflow: hidden;
    /* Scroll inside a panel body must never chain into the locked document. */
    overscroll-behavior: contain;
    background: var(--color-surface);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
    opacity: 0;
    transform: var(--panel-closed-transform, none);
    transition: opacity 0.2s var(--ease-drawer), transform 0.2s var(--ease-drawer), display 0.2s allow-discrete, overlay 0.2s allow-discrete;

    &[open] {
      opacity: 1;
      /* `none` (not an identity transform) so the open panel is not a containing
         block for fixed descendants — keeps the toast portal and skip targets
         viewport-anchored. Do not change to translate(0). */
      transform: none;
      transition: opacity 0.3s var(--ease-drawer), transform 0.3s var(--ease-drawer), display 0.3s allow-discrete, overlay 0.3s allow-discrete;
    }

    &::backdrop {
      background: rgb(0 0 0 / 0);
      transition: background 0.2s var(--ease-drawer), display 0.2s allow-discrete, overlay 0.2s allow-discrete;
    }

    &[open]::backdrop {
      background: var(--panel-backdrop, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5));
      transition: background 0.3s var(--ease-drawer), display 0.3s allow-discrete, overlay 0.3s allow-discrete;
    }

    @starting-style {
      &[open] {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: var(--panel-closed-transform, none);
      }
      &[open]::backdrop {
        background: rgb(0 0 0 / 0);
      }
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      transition-duration: 0s;
      &[open] { transition-duration: 0s; }
      &::backdrop { transition-duration: 0s; }
      &[open]::backdrop { transition-duration: 0s; }
    }
  }
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   GRID STAGGER REVEAL
   Shared components-layer choreography for listing grids, not a generic utility.
   One-shot batch reveal for collection, search, blog, and homepage items.
   The first responsive row stays visible immediately so above-the-fold LCP
   candidates are not delayed by the reveal animation. Protected by the REDUCED
   MOTION block at the end of this file which zeroes animation duration and
   delay for all elements. No motion-safe: prefix needed.
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

@layer components {
  .stagger-fade-in {
    & > * { animation: none; }
    & > *:nth-child(n+2):nth-child(-n+9) { animation: stagger-item 0.4s var(--ease-ui) both; }
    & > *:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0ms; }
    & > *:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 50ms; }
    & > *:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 100ms; }
    & > *:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 150ms; }
    & > *:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: 200ms; }
    & > *:nth-child(7) { animation-delay: 250ms; }
    & > *:nth-child(8) { animation-delay: 300ms; }
    & > *:nth-child(9) { animation-delay: 350ms; }

    @media (min-width: 48rem) {
      & > *:nth-child(n+1):nth-child(-n+2) { animation: none; }
      & > *:nth-child(n+3):nth-child(-n+10) { animation: stagger-item 0.4s var(--ease-ui) both; }
      & > *:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0ms; }
      & > *:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 50ms; }
      & > *:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 100ms; }
      & > *:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: 150ms; }
      & > *:nth-child(7) { animation-delay: 200ms; }
      & > *:nth-child(8) { animation-delay: 250ms; }
      & > *:nth-child(9) { animation-delay: 300ms; }
      & > *:nth-child(10) { animation-delay: 350ms; }
    }

    @media (min-width: 64rem) {
      &.lg\:grid-cols-3 > *:nth-child(n+1):nth-child(-n+3) { animation: none; }
      &.lg\:grid-cols-3 > *:nth-child(n+4):nth-child(-n+11) { animation: stagger-item 0.4s var(--ease-ui) both; }
      &.lg\:grid-cols-3 > *:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0ms; }
      &.lg\:grid-cols-3 > *:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 50ms; }
      &.lg\:grid-cols-3 > *:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: 100ms; }
      &.lg\:grid-cols-3 > *:nth-child(7) { animation-delay: 150ms; }
      &.lg\:grid-cols-3 > *:nth-child(8) { animation-delay: 200ms; }
      &.lg\:grid-cols-3 > *:nth-child(9) { animation-delay: 250ms; }
      &.lg\:grid-cols-3 > *:nth-child(10) { animation-delay: 300ms; }
      &.lg\:grid-cols-3 > *:nth-child(11) { animation-delay: 350ms; }

      &.lg\:grid-cols-4 > *:nth-child(n+1):nth-child(-n+4) { animation: none; }
      &.lg\:grid-cols-4 > *:nth-child(n+5):nth-child(-n+12) { animation: stagger-item 0.4s var(--ease-ui) both; }
      &.lg\:grid-cols-4 > *:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 0ms; }
      &.lg\:grid-cols-4 > *:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: 50ms; }
      &.lg\:grid-cols-4 > *:nth-child(7) { animation-delay: 100ms; }
      &.lg\:grid-cols-4 > *:nth-child(8) { animation-delay: 150ms; }
      &.lg\:grid-cols-4 > *:nth-child(9) { animation-delay: 200ms; }
      &.lg\:grid-cols-4 > *:nth-child(10) { animation-delay: 250ms; }
      &.lg\:grid-cols-4 > *:nth-child(11) { animation-delay: 300ms; }
      &.lg\:grid-cols-4 > *:nth-child(12) { animation-delay: 350ms; }
    }

    /* Reveal runs once per page load: after the first successful partial apply,
       s-live-form.js sets data-stagger-settled on the wrapper so refreshed grids
       render immediately. !important is required because the per-child nth-child
       rules above carry higher specificity than any ancestor-scoped override. */
    [data-stagger-settled] & > * {
      animation: none !important;
    }
  }
}

/* =============================================================================
   REDUCED MOTION
   Disables all animations and transitions for users who prefer reduced motion.
   ============================================================================= */

@layer base {
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    *, *::before, *::after {
      animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
      animation-delay: 0s !important;
      animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
      transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
      scroll-behavior: auto !important;
    }
  }

/* =============================================================================
   DESKTOP NAV DROPDOWN — Version 2
   Multi-column inline dropdown: sub-items appear as additional grid columns
   with a vertical divider, triggered on hover.
   ============================================================================= */

@layer components {

.nav-has-dropdown {
  position: relative;
}

.nav-dropdown {
  position: absolute;
  top: 100%;
  inset-inline-start: -13px;
  padding-block-start: 10px;
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  transition: opacity 0.15s var(--ease-ui), transform 0.15s var(--ease-ui), visibility 0.15s;
  z-index: 50;
  pointer-events: none;
}

@media (hover: hover) {
  .nav-has-dropdown:hover .nav-dropdown {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transform: translateY(0);
    pointer-events: auto;
  }

  /* Suppresses the hover reveal when Escape is pressed while a panel is hovered.
     Restored on mouseleave (s-nav-dropdown.js clears data-suppress-hover). */
  .nav-has-dropdown[data-suppress-hover]:hover .nav-dropdown {
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transform: translateY(-4px);
    pointer-events: none;
  }
}

/* Shows the submenu when the toggle button is pressed: s-nav-dropdown.js sets
   data-open on press. Only hover (above) and this attribute open the submenu; there
   is deliberately no :focus-within rule, so tabbing onto the item does not open it. */
.nav-has-dropdown[data-open] .nav-dropdown {
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
  transform: translateY(0);
  pointer-events: auto;
}

/* Top-level chevron toggle button. Only visible when focused by keyboard on
   pointer devices, so mouse users keep a clean top bar and open submenus by hovering;
   positioned absolutely just after the link so showing/hiding it never shifts the
   top-bar layout. On touch devices, the button is always visible and interactive
   so tap can open the panel. */
.nav-disclosure {
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline-start: 100%;
  inset-block-start: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  margin-inline-start: 2px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 4px;
  border: 0;
  background: none;
  color: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity 0.15s var(--ease-ui), transform 0.15s var(--ease-ui);
}

.nav-disclosure:active {
  transform: translateY(-50%) scale(0.90);
}

.nav-disclosure:focus-visible {
  opacity: 1;
  pointer-events: auto;
  outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* On touch devices, make disclosure buttons visible and interactive so users
   can tap to open submenus (hover reveal is unavailable). */
@media (hover: none) {
  .nav-disclosure {
    opacity: 1;
    pointer-events: auto;
  }
}

.nav-disclosure-icon {
  display: block;
  width: 0.75rem;
  height: 0.75rem;
  transition: transform 0.15s var(--ease-ui);
}

.nav-disclosure[aria-expanded='true'] .nav-disclosure-icon {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
}

.nav-dropdown-inner {
  background: var(--color-surface);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  padding: 16px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(120px, max-content);
  grid-auto-flow: column;
  gap: 0 16px;
  min-width: 120px;
  max-width: calc(100vw - 2rem);
}

.nav-dropdown-inner:has(.nav-dropdown-group) {
  padding-inline-end: 14px;
}

/* Dim the NON-hovered items when anything in the panel is hovered.
   Targeting :not(:hover) siblings reproduces the original "dim all but the
   hovered one" effect without the restore rule's !important — which, from
   @layer components, would override (defeat) any opacity-* utility on these
   elements due to cascade-layer !important precedence. */
@media (hover: hover) {
  .nav-dropdown-inner:hover > li > .nav-dropdown-item:not(:hover),
  .nav-dropdown-inner:hover > .nav-dropdown-group:not(:hover) > .nav-dropdown-row {
    opacity: 0.6;
  }
}

.nav-dropdown-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.35;
  color: var(--color-on-surface);
  text-decoration: none;
  padding: 3px 0;
  grid-column: 1;
  min-width: 120px;
  max-width: 16rem;
  white-space: normal;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  transition: opacity 0.15s var(--ease-ui);
}

/* Row holding a parent item's link + its chevron toggle button, so the visible title
   is a real link and the chevron is a separate button you can tab to. Occupies the
   left grid column; the submenu stays in column 2. */
.nav-dropdown-row {
  grid-column: 1;
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
}

.nav-dropdown-row > .nav-dropdown-item {
  min-width: 0;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
}

/* Nested submenu disclosure button. Padding is sized for a ≥24×24px hit area
   (WCAG 2.5.5 Target Size, Level AAA; 2.5.8 minimum in WCAG 2.2). Icon stays small. */
.nav-dropdown-disclosure {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 9px;
  border: 0;
  background: none;
  color: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  transition: transform 0.15s var(--ease-ui);
}

.nav-dropdown-disclosure:active {
  transform: scale(0.90);
}

.nav-dropdown-disclosure:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.nav-dropdown-disclosure svg {
  width: 6px;
  height: 9px;
}

/* On touch devices, make nested disclosure buttons visible and interactive. */
@media (hover: none) {
  .nav-dropdown-disclosure {
    opacity: 1;
    pointer-events: auto;
  }
}

@media (hover: hover) {

  }

}

/* Second column: hidden by default, shown on group hover */
.nav-dropdown-submenu {
  grid-column: 2;
  grid-row: 1 / span 10;
  display: none;
  padding: 16px;

  align-self: stretch;
  flex-direction: row;

}

.nav-dropdown-group[data-open] > .nav-dropdown-submenu {
  display: flex;
  animation: navDropdownFadeIn 0.15s var(--ease-ui);
}

} /* end @layer components (nav dropdown part 1) */

{% doc %}
  Renders a native discount-code disclosure for an owning `<s-cart>` element.
  The input stays outside cart form submission; `s-cart.js` applies it through
  Shopify Standard Actions when the button is pressed or Enter is used.

  @param {string} cart_id - The id of the owning `<s-cart>` element for command targeting. @required
  @param {string} input_id - A unique id for the discount-code input and label. @required
  @param {string} [class] - Additional CSS classes for the disclosure.

  @category commerce
  @renders details

  @example
  {% render 'cart-discount-code', cart_id: 'cart', input_id: 'cart-discount-input' %}
{% enddoc %}

<details class="group border-t border-border {{ class }}">
  <summary class="list-none [&::-webkit-details-marker]:hidden flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-between py-3 text-sm font-medium text-on-surface">
    {{ 'cart.discount_code' | t }}
    <span class="ms-4 size-4 shrink-0 group-open:rotate-180" aria-hidden="true">{{- 'icon-chevron-down.svg' | inline_asset_content -}}</span>
  </summary>
  <div class="flex gap-2 pb-4">
    {%- comment -%} The summary is not programmatically associated with this input, so retain a real label. {%- endcomment -%}
    <label for="{{ input_id | escape }}" class="sr-only">{{ 'cart.discount_code' | t }}</label>
    {%- comment -%} form="" prevents Enter from submitting a parent cart form; the owning s-cart handles Enter and the command. {%- endcomment -%}
    <input type="text" id="{{ input_id | escape }}" form="" data-discount-code placeholder="{{ 'cart.discount_placeholder' | t }}" class="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-input border border-border bg-surface px-3 py-2 text-sm focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-accent">
    <button type="button" commandfor="{{ cart_id | escape }}" command="--apply-discount" class="rounded-button border border-border px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium hover:bg-surface-secondary motion-safe:active:scale-[0.97]">{{ 'cart.discount_apply' | t }}</button>
  </div>
</details>

{% doc %}
  Renders a single cart line item with quantity controls and remove button.
  Supports full (cart page) and compact (cart drawer) layouts. The caller owns
  independently editable image, unit-price and remove-button blocks and passes
  their rendered captures; this utility owns native row/quantity/discount markup.

  @param {line_item} item - Shopify cart line item object. @required
  @param {string} cart_id - The id of the parent `<s-cart>` element for commandfor targeting. @required
  @param {boolean} [compact] - When true, renders the compact two-row stacked layout for drawers. Default: false.
  @param {string} [media] - Caller-rendered image block, placed in the existing media frame when item.image exists.
  @param {string} unit_price - Caller-rendered price block for item.original_price. @required
  @param {string} remove_button - Caller-rendered remove button targeting cart_id and the item's line key. @required
  @param {string} [class] - Additional CSS classes to append to the root element.
  @param {string} [attributes] - Additional HTML attributes passed through to the root element.

  @category commerce
  @renders div

================ FILE: snippets/command-polyfill.liquid ================

{% doc %}
  Inline Invoker Commands API fallback for browsers without
  `HTMLButtonElement.prototype.commandForElement`. Native-supporting browsers
  no-op; otherwise a single delegated click listener resolves `commandfor` to an
  element and applies the `command` (`show-modal`, `close`, `show-popover`,
  `hide-popover`, or a `--custom` CommandEvent dispatch).

  It stays an inline classic script — not a module asset — so every `commandfor`
  button works as soon as the document parses, with no extra request and no window
  where clicking a trigger does nothing.

  @example
  {% render 'command-polyfill' %}
{% enddoc %}

<script>
  if (!HTMLButtonElement.prototype.hasOwnProperty('commandForElement')) {
    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const btn = e.target.closest('[commandfor]');
      if (!btn) return;
      const target = document.getElementById(btn.getAttribute('commandfor'));
      if (!target) return;
      const command = btn.getAttribute('command') || '';
      if (command.startsWith('--')) {
        target.dispatchEvent(
          Object.assign(new Event('command', { bubbles: false, cancelable: true }), {
            command,
            source: btn,
          })
        );
        return;
      }
      switch (command) {
        case 'show-modal': target.showModal?.(); break;
        case 'close': target.close?.(); break;
        case 'show-popover':
          target.showPopover?.();
          btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
          break;
        case 'hide-popover':
          target.hidePopover?.();
          btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          break;
      }
      // Sync aria-expanded when popover is toggled by other means (e.g. light-dismiss)
      if (command === 'show-popover' && typeof target.addEventListener === 'function') {
        target.addEventListener('toggle', (evt) => {
          btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', evt.newState === 'open' ? 'true' : 'false');
        }, { once: true });
      }
    });
  }
</script>


================ FILE: snippets/drawer.liquid ================

{% doc %}
  Renders a drawer panel using a native `<dialog>` element. Opens via
  Invoker Commands (`commandfor`/`command="show-modal"` on trigger buttons),
  closes via `command="close"`, Escape key, or backdrop click. CSS handles
  slide animations via `@starting-style` and `transition-behavior: allow-discrete`.
  The `<s-dialog>` Web Component handles backdrop-click-to-close and
  responsive breakpoint auto-close.

  The drawer uses a flex-col layout: the header and footer are pinned (`shrink-0`),
  and the body scrolls independently (`flex-1 overflow-y-auto`). The footer region
  is only rendered when a `footer` capture is provided. Pass a `header` capture to
  completely replace the built-in title/close-button header with custom HTML.

  @param {string} id - Unique HTML id applied to the `<dialog>` element. @required
  @param {string} content - HTML or text rendered in the scrollable body of the drawer. @required
  @param {string} [position] - Edge from which the drawer slides in. Default: 'right'. One of: 'left'|'right'|'bottom'.
  @param {string} [title] - Optional heading rendered in the drawer header alongside the close button
  @param {string} [close_button] - Captured button block rendered as the drawer close control. Required when not using a custom `header`. Must be authored at the template/layout with `commandfor` matching this drawer's `id` and `command="close"`.
  @param {string} [header] - Custom HTML to replace the built-in header (title + close button) entirely. When provided, the caller owns the close button within the custom header.
  @param {string} [footer] - HTML content pinned to the bottom of the drawer
  @param {string} [class] - Additional CSS classes to append to the `<dialog>` element
  @param {string} [attributes] - Additional HTML attributes passed through to the `<dialog>` element. When a custom `header` is provided, include `aria-labelledby` pointing to a heading ID in the custom header to provide an accessible name.
  @param {boolean} [close_on_navigate] - Close the drawer when an `<a>` inside it is clicked (for client-side navigation)

  @category interactive
  @renders s-dialog

  @example Default header with title and close button
  {% capture drawer_content %}
    <p class="text-sm">Cart items go here.</p>
  {% endcapture %}
  {%- assign close_label = 'general.close' | t -%}
  {%- capture drawer_close_attrs -%}aria-label="{{ close_label | escape }}"{%- endcapture -%}
  {% capture drawer_close_button %}
    {% block 'button', commandfor: 'example-drawer', command: 'close', variant: 'button-ghost', class: 'size-touch-target rounded hover:bg-transparent hover:opacity-70', autofocus: true, attributes: drawer_close_attrs %}<span class="inline-flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 size-5" aria-hidden="true">{{- 'icon-x.svg' | inline_asset_content -}}</span>{% endblock %}
  {% endcapture %}
  {% render 'drawer', id: 'example-drawer', title: 'Your cart', content: drawer_content, close_button: drawer_close_button %}

  @example No-title header with close button only
  {% capture simple_content %}
    <p class="text-sm">Drawer body content.</p>
  {% endcapture %}
  {%- assign close_text = 'general.close' | t -%}
  {%- capture simple_close_attrs -%}aria-label="{{ close_text | escape }}"{%- endcapture -%}
  {% capture simple_close_button %}
    {% block 'button', commandfor: 'simple-drawer', command: 'close', variant: 'button-ghost', class: 'size-touch-target rounded hover:bg-transparent hover:opacity-70', autofocus: true, attributes: simple_close_attrs %}<span class="inline-flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 size-5" aria-hidden="true">{{- 'icon-x.svg' | inline_asset_content -}}</span>{% endblock %}
  {% endcapture %}
  {% render 'drawer', id: 'simple-drawer', content: simple_content, close_button: simple_close_button %}

  @example Custom header (caller owns close button)
  {% capture custom_header %}
    <div class="flex items-center justify-between p-4 border-b border-border shrink-0">
      <h2 id="cart-drawer-composed-title" class="text-lg font-medium text-on-surface">Your cart</h2>
      {% capture custom_close_attrs %}aria-label="{{ 'general.close' | t | escape }}"{% endcapture %}
      {% block 'button', commandfor: 'cart-drawer-composed', command: 'close', variant: 'button-ghost', class: 'size-touch-target rounded hover:bg-transparent hover:opacity-70', attributes: custom_close_attrs %}<span class="inline-flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 size-5" aria-hidden="true">{{- 'icon-x.svg' | inline_asset_content -}}</span>{% endblock %}
    </div>
  {% endcapture %}
  {% capture custom_footer %}
    <button type="button" class="w-full px-4 py-2 text-sm bg-interactive text-interactive-text rounded">
      Checkout &mdash; $49.99
    </button>
  {% endcapture %}
  {% capture drawer_content %}
    <ul class="divide-y divide-border">
      <li class="py-3">Cart item 1</li>
      <li class="py-3">Cart item 2</li>
    </ul>
  {% endcapture %}
  {% render 'drawer', id: 'cart-drawer-composed', position: 'right', content: drawer_content, header: custom_header, footer: custom_footer, attributes: 'aria-labelledby="cart-drawer-composed-title"' %}
{% enddoc %}

{%- liquid
  assign position = position

  case position
    when 'left'
      # Zero-specificity layout defaults keep caller utilities authoritative, even across the 480px breakpoint.
      assign dialog_class = 'overlay-panel [--panel-closed-transform:translateX(-100%)] rtl:[--panel-closed-transform:translateX(100%)] [:where(&)]:fixed [:where(&)]:inset-y-0 [:where(&)]:inset-s-0 [:where(&)]:inset-e-auto [:where(&)]:w-screen [:where(&)]:h-full [:where(&)]:pt-(--safe-area-inset-top) [:where(&)]:pb-(--safe-area-inset-bottom) [:where(&)]:ps-(--safe-area-inset-inline-start) [:where(&)]:pe-0 min-[480px]:[:where(&)]:w-drawer-width text-on-surface'
    when 'bottom'
      # Zero-specificity defaults preserve caller overrides while content stays clear of the home indicator and side notches.
      assign dialog_class = 'overlay-panel [--panel-closed-transform:translateY(100%)] [:where(&)]:fixed [:where(&)]:inset-bs-auto [:where(&)]:inset-be-0 [:where(&)]:inset-x-0 [:where(&)]:w-full [:where(&)]:max-h-dialog-max-height [:where(&)]:rounded-t-lg [:where(&)]:rounded-b-none [:where(&)]:pb-(--safe-area-inset-bottom) [:where(&)]:ps-(--safe-area-inset-inline-start) [:where(&)]:pe-(--safe-area-inset-inline-end) text-on-surface'
    else
      # Zero-specificity layout defaults keep caller utilities authoritative, even across the 480px breakpoint.
      assign dialog_class = 'overlay-panel [--panel-closed-transform:translateX(100%)] rtl:[--panel-closed-transform:translateX(-100%)] [:where(&)]:fixed [:where(&)]:inset-y-0 [:where(&)]:inset-s-auto [:where(&)]:inset-e-0 [:where(&)]:w-screen [:where(&)]:h-full [:where(&)]:pt-(--safe-area-inset-top) [:where(&)]:pb-(--safe-area-inset-bottom) [:where(&)]:ps-0 [:where(&)]:pe-(--safe-area-inset-inline-end) min-[480px]:[:where(&)]:w-drawer-width text-on-surface'
  endcase

  if class != blank
    assign dialog_class = dialog_class | append: ' ' | append: class
  endif
-%}

{%- comment -%} `<s-dialog>` wraps native `<dialog>` to add close-on-backdrop-click and responsive auto-close (e.g. on viewport resize past a breakpoint); the native element provides focus-trap and `::backdrop`. Do not unwrap to a bare `<dialog>`. {%- endcomment -%}
<s-dialog {% if close_on_navigate %} close-on-navigate{% endif %}>
<dialog id="{{ id }}" class="{{ dialog_class }}"{% if title != blank %} aria-labelledby="{{ id }}-title"{% elsif header == blank %} aria-label="{{ 'general.drawer' | t }}"{% endif %}{% if attributes != blank %} {{ attributes }}{% endif %}>
  <div class="flex flex-col h-full">
    {%- if header != blank -%}
      {{ header }}
    {%- elsif title != blank -%}
      <div class="flex items-center shrink-0 ps-4 py-2">
        <h2 id="{{ id }}-title" class="text-lg font-medium text-on-surface flex-1">{{ title | escape }}</h2>
        {{ close_button }}
      </div>
    {%- else -%}
      <div class="flex justify-end p-2 shrink-0">
        {{ close_button }}
      </div>
    {%- endif -%}
    <div class="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4">
      {{ content }}
    </div>
    {%- if footer != blank -%}
      <div class="shrink-0 border-t border-border p-4">
        {{ footer }}
      </div>
    {%- endif -%}
  </div>
</dialog>
</s-dialog>

<script type="module" src="{{ 's-dialog.js' | asset_url }}"></script>


================ FILE: snippets/filter-group.liquid ================

{% doc %}
  Renders one platform-generated collection/search facet, including price ranges
  and text, color, or image values. These data-driven controls are internal to
  the filter drawer, not independently authored merchant blocks. Native details
  keep the group usable without JavaScript.

  @param {object} filter - A member of collection.filters or search.filters. @required

  @example
  {% for filter in collection.filters %}
    {% render 'filter-group', filter: filter %}
  {% endfor %}
{% enddoc %}

{%- liquid
  assign active_count = 0
  for value in filter.values
    if value.active
      assign active_count = active_count | plus: 1
    endif
  endfor
  if filter.type == 'price_range'
    if filter.min_value.value != blank or filter.max_value.value != blank
      assign active_count = 1
    endif
  endif
  assign show_more_limit = 8
  if filter.presentation == 'swatch'
    assign show_more_limit = 20
  elsif filter.presentation == 'image'
    assign show_more_limit = 6
  endif
  assign filter_id = filter.param_name | handleize
-%}
<details open class="group border-b border-border">
  <summary class="flex w-full items-center justify-between py-4 text-sm font-medium text-on-surface cursor-pointer select-none list-none [&::-webkit-details-marker]:hidden motion-safe:active:scale-[0.97]">
    <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
      {{ filter.label | escape }}
      {% if active_count > 0 %}
        <span class="inline-flex items-center justify-center min-w-5 h-5 px-1 text-xs font-medium rounded-full bg-interactive text-interactive-text" aria-hidden="true">{{ active_count }}</span>
        <span class="sr-only">{{ 'filters.active_count' | t: count: active_count }}</span>
      {% endif %}
    </span>
    <span class="inline-flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 size-4 group-open:rotate-180 motion-safe:transition-transform motion-safe:duration-200 motion-safe:ease-ui" aria-hidden="true">{{- 'icon-chevron-down.svg' | inline_asset_content -}}</span>
  </summary>

  <div class="pb-4">
    {% if filter.type == 'price_range' %}
      {%- assign min_label = 'collections.price_min' | t -%}
      {%- assign max_label = 'collections.price_max' | t -%}
      {%- comment -%} Shopify supplies price filter bounds in subunits; the form URL expects major currency units. {%- endcomment -%}
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2 pt-2">
        <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
          <label for="{{ filter_id }}-gte" class="sr-only">{{ min_label }}</label>
          <input type="number" id="{{ filter_id }}-gte" name="{{ filter.param_name }}.gte" min="0" step="any" max="{{ filter.range_max | divided_by: 100.0 | ceil }}"{% if filter.min_value.value != blank %} value="{{ filter.min_value.value | divided_by: 100.0 }}"{% endif %} placeholder="{{ min_label | escape }}" class="w-full text-sm border border-border rounded-input px-3 py-2 bg-surface text-on-surface">
        </div>
        <span class="text-sm text-on-surface-secondary">{{ 'collections.price_to' | t }}</span>
        <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
          <label for="{{ filter_id }}-lte" class="sr-only">{{ max_label }}</label>
          <input type="number" id="{{ filter_id }}-lte" name="{{ filter.param_name }}.lte" min="0" step="any" max="{{ filter.range_max | divided_by: 100.0 | ceil }}"{% if filter.max_value.value != blank %} value="{{ filter.max_value.value | divided_by: 100.0 }}"{% endif %} placeholder="{{ max_label | escape }}" class="w-full text-sm border border-border rounded-input px-3 py-2 bg-surface text-on-surface">
        </div>
      </div>
    {% else %}
      <fieldset class="border-0 p-0 m-0">
        <legend class="sr-only">{{ filter.label | escape }}</legend>
        {%- assign values_class = 'space-y-1 pt-2' -%}
        {% if filter.presentation == 'swatch' or filter.presentation == 'image' %}{% assign values_class = 'flex flex-wrap gap-2.5 pt-2' %}{% endif %}
        <ul class="{{ values_class }}">
          {% for value in filter.values limit: show_more_limit %}
            {% render 'filter-value', filter: filter, value: value %}
          {% endfor %}
        </ul>
        {% if filter.values.size > show_more_limit %}
          <details>
            <summary class="text-sm text-accent hover:underline cursor-pointer motion-safe:active:scale-[0.97] py-2">{{ 'collections.filtering.show_more' | t }}</summary>
            <ul class="{{ values_class }}">
              {% for value in filter.values offset: show_more_limit %}
                {% render 'filter-value', filter: filter, value: value %}
              {% endfor %}
            </ul>
          </details>
        {% endif %}
      </fieldset>
    {% endif %}
  </div>
</details>

{% doc %}
  Renders a platform-generated filter checkbox as a text row or visual swatch.
  Used by both the visible and the expandable value lists in filter-group.
  The generated values are not independently authored block usages.

  @param {object} filter - Collection/search filter owning the URL parameter. @required
  @param {object} value - A platform filter value. @required

  @example
  {% render 'filter-value', filter: filter, value: value %}
{% enddoc %}

{%- assign is_disabled = false -%}
{% if value.count == 0 and value.active == false %}{% assign is_disabled = true %}{% endif %}

        {% if value.swatch.color %}style="background-color: {{ value.swatch.color | escape }}"{% elsif value.swatch.image %}style="background-image: url('{{ value.swatch.image | image_url: width: 100 | escape }}'); background-size: cover; background-position: center"{% elsif value.image %}style="background-image: url('{{ value.image | image_url: width: 100 | escape }}'); background-size: cover; background-position: center"{% endif %}>

        </span>

          <svg class="absolute inset-0 size-full text-on-surface" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" aria-hidden="true"><line x1="4" y1="4" x2="20" y2="20"/></svg>

  {% else %}
    <label class="group/filter flex items-center gap-2 py-1 text-sm text-on-surface{% if is_disabled %} opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed{% else %} cursor-pointer{% endif %}">
      <input type="checkbox" name="{{ filter.param_name | escape }}" value="{{ value.value | escape }}"{% if value.active %} checked{% endif %}{% if is_disabled %} disabled{% endif %} class="sr-only">
      <span class="flex items-center justify-center size-4 rounded-sm border border-border shrink-0 group-has-[:checked]/filter:bg-interactive group-has-[:checked]/filter:border-interactive group-has-[:focus-visible]/filter:ring-2 group-has-[:focus-visible]/filter:ring-accent group-has-[:focus-visible]/filter:ring-offset-2" aria-hidden="true">
        <svg class="opacity-0 group-has-[:checked]/filter:opacity-100 motion-safe:transition-opacity motion-safe:duration-200" width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="white" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/></svg>

      <span class="flex-1">{{ value.label | escape }}{% if is_disabled %}<span class="sr-only"> ({{ 'collections.value_unavailable' | t }})</span>{% endif %}</span>

================ FILE: snippets/filters.liquid ================

{% doc %}
  Renders the shared collection/search filter toolbar, sort select, active chips,
  persistent dialog, and their named partials. Page templates own the form and
  capture each independently editable button block before rendering this utility.
  Only the dialog's filter-list partial is replaced, so its open state survives.

  @param {string} page_type - 'collection' or 'search'. @required
  @param {object} resource - The collection or search drop. @required
  @param {string} drawer_id - Stable ID targeted by the captured command buttons. @required
  @param {string} filter_trigger - Captured button block that opens the dialog. @required
  @param {string} toolbar_submit - Captured no-JavaScript toolbar submit button. @required
  @param {string} close_button - Captured dialog close button block. @required
  @param {string} show_results_button - Captured dialog show-results button block. @required
  @param {string} drawer_submit - Captured no-JavaScript dialog submit button. @required
  @param {string} [search_terms] - Sanitized, unescaped search terms; only for search.

  @example
  {% capture filter_trigger %}
    {% block 'button', commandfor: 'collection-filter-drawer', command: 'show-modal' %}{{ 'collections.filter' | t }}{% endblock %}
  {% endcapture %}
  {% render 'filters', page_type: 'collection', resource: collection, drawer_id: 'collection-filter-drawer', filter_trigger: filter_trigger, toolbar_submit: submit_button, close_button: close_button, show_results_button: show_results_button, drawer_submit: drawer_submit %}
{% enddoc %}

{%- liquid
  assign selected_sort = resource.sort_by | default: resource.default_sort_by
  assign show_toolbar = true
  if page_type == 'search'
    assign show_toolbar = false
    if resource.performed and resource.terms != blank
      assign show_toolbar = true
    endif
    assign escaped_terms = search_terms | escape
    assign encoded_terms = search_terms | url_encode
    assign clear_url = routes.search_url | append: '?q=' | append: encoded_terms
  else
    assign clear_url = resource.url
  endif
-%}

{% capture toolbar_markup %}
  <div class="max-w-page mx-auto px-margin flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 mb-6">
    {% if resource.filters.size > 0 %}{{ filter_trigger }}{% endif %}
    {% if page_type == 'collection' %}
      {% partial 'collection-count' %}
        <span data-results-count hidden>{{ resource.products_count }}</span>
        <span class="text-sm text-on-surface-secondary">{{ 'collections.products_count' | t: count: resource.products_count }}</span>
        <span class="sr-only" data-live-announce>{{ 'collections.products_count' | t: count: resource.products_count }}</span>
      {% endpartial %}
    {% else %}
      <span class="text-sm text-on-surface-secondary">{{ 'search.results_for' | t: count: resource.results_count, terms: escaped_terms }}</span>
    {% endif %}
    {% if resource.sort_options.size > 0 %}
      <div class="ms-auto flex items-center gap-2">
        <label for="{{ page_type | escape }}-sort" class="text-sm text-on-surface-secondary whitespace-nowrap">{{ 'collections.sort_by' | t }}</label>
        <div class="relative min-w-0">
          <select id="{{ page_type | escape }}-sort" name="sort_by" class="appearance-none min-w-0 cursor-pointer font-medium border border-border rounded-input bg-surface ps-3 pe-9 py-2 text-sm text-on-surface">
            {% for option in resource.sort_options %}
              <option value="{{ option.value | escape }}"{% if option.value == selected_sort %} selected{% endif %}>{{ option.name | escape }}</option>
            {% endfor %}
          </select>
          <span class="pointer-events-none absolute inset-e-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 size-4" aria-hidden="true">{{- 'icon-chevron-down.svg' | inline_asset_content -}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    {% endif %}
    <noscript>{{ toolbar_submit }}</noscript>
  </div>
{% endcapture %}
{% if page_type == 'search' %}
  {% partial 'search-toolbar' %}
    {% if show_toolbar %}{{ toolbar_markup }}{% endif %}
  {% endpartial %}
{% else %}
  {{ toolbar_markup }}
{% endif %}

{%- assign has_active_filters = false -%}
{%- for filter in resource.filters -%}
  {%- if filter.type == 'price_range' -%}
    {%- if filter.min_value.value != blank or filter.max_value.value != blank -%}{%- assign has_active_filters = true -%}{%- endif -%}
  {%- else -%}
    {%- for value in filter.values -%}
      {%- if value.active -%}{%- assign has_active_filters = true -%}{%- break -%}{%- endif -%}
    {%- endfor -%}
  {%- endif -%}
  {%- if has_active_filters -%}{%- break -%}{%- endif -%}
{%- endfor -%}
{% capture chips_markup %}
  {% if has_active_filters %}
    <div class="max-w-page mx-auto px-margin flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 mb-6" role="region" aria-label="{{ 'collections.active_filters' | t }}">
      {% for filter in resource.filters %}
        {% if filter.type == 'price_range' %}
          {% if filter.min_value.value != blank or filter.max_value.value != blank %}
            {%- capture price_label -%}{{ filter.label | escape }}: {{ filter.min_value.value | default: filter.range_min | money }} – {{ filter.max_value.value | default: filter.range_max | money }}{%- endcapture -%}
            {%- assign remove_label = 'collections.remove_filter' | t: filter: filter.label -%}
            <a href="{{ filter.url_to_remove | escape }}" aria-label="{{ remove_label | escape }}" class="inline-flex min-h-touch-target items-center gap-2 px-3 rounded-button bg-surface-secondary text-on-surface text-sm no-underline hover:bg-border focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-accent motion-safe:transition-[color,transform] motion-safe:active:scale-[0.97]">{{ price_label }}<span class="inline-flex size-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true">{{- 'icon-x.svg' | inline_asset_content -}}</span></a>
          {% endif %}
        {% else %}
          {% for value in filter.values %}
            {% if value.active %}
              {%- assign remove_label = 'collections.remove_filter' | t: filter: value.label -%}

            {% endif %}
          {% endfor %}
        {% endif %}

  {% endif %}
{% endcapture %}

  {% endfor %}
