================ FILE: snippets/import-map.liquid ================

{% doc %}
  Declares the storefront module import map: the external `@shopify/standard-events`
  module plus versioned `@theme/*` specifiers for cross-module imports between
  assets/*.js files. Internal targets render through asset_url so every dependency
  shares Shopify's current `?v=` cache key with direct module scripts.

  Render this first in the layout <head> — before content_for_header and before any
  `<script type="module">` — because browsers ignore an import map that appears
  after the first module script. The spec audit validates the entries in this file
  against actual `@theme/*` imports in assets/*.js.

  @example
  {% render 'import-map' %}
{% enddoc %}

<script type="importmap">
{
  "imports": {
    "@shopify/standard-events": "https://cdn.shopify.com/storefront/standard-events.js",
    "@theme/cart-feedback": "{{ 'cart-feedback.js' | asset_url }}",
    "@theme/live-region": "{{ 'live-region.js' | asset_url }}",
    "@theme/page-view-event": "{{ 'page-view-event.js' | asset_url }}",
    "@theme/quantity-rules": "{{ 'quantity-rules.js' | asset_url }}",
    "@theme/s-view-event": "{{ 's-view-event.js' | asset_url }}",
    "@theme/view-transition": "{{ 'view-transition.js' | asset_url }}"
  }
}
</script>


================ FILE: snippets/lcp-preload.liquid ================

{% doc %}
  Emits a template-aware image preload link for the expected LCP image so the
  browser starts downloading it before the `<img>` element is discovered in the
  DOM. Renders nothing when the current template has no predictable
  above-the-fold image. Render from the layout <head> after the compiled
  stylesheet.

  The per-template `lcp_sizes`/`imagesrcset` parity rules are documented inline
  below and guarded by tests/suites/contracts/lcp-preload-image-parity.spec.js,
  which reads this file as its Liquid source of truth.

  @example
  {% render 'lcp-preload' %}
{% enddoc %}

{%- liquid
  # LCP preload: Eagerly fetch above-the-fold media so the browser can
  # start downloading it before the <img> element is discovered in the DOM.
  # Each lcp_sizes value must stay byte-identical to the `sizes` of the template's
  # first rendered image (and imagesrcset widths to blocks/image.liquid defaults),
  # or the browser fetches a second image instead of reusing the preload.
  # Paginated listing templates (blog, collection, list-collections, search) preload
  # only on the first page; subsequent pages have no predictable above-fold image.
  assign lcp_image = nil
  assign lcp_sizes = '100vw'
  if template == 'index'
    # Mirrors the hero source in templates/index.liquid.
    assign lcp_image = images['wyh-hero-platform.png']
  elsif template == 'article'
    assign lcp_image = article.image
    # Mirrors the hero image `sizes` in templates/article.liquid.
    assign lcp_sizes = '(min-width: 768px) 42em, 100vw'
  elsif template == 'blog'
    # Preload only on page one — blog.articles respects the paginate window.
    if current_page == 1
      assign lcp_image = blog.articles.first.image
      # Mirrors the template-owned blog image block `sizes` kwarg in templates/blog.liquid.
      assign lcp_sizes = '(min-width: 1024px) 33vw, (min-width: 768px) 50vw, 100vw'
    endif
  elsif template == 'collection'
    # Preload only on page one — collection.products respects the paginate window.
    if current_page == 1
      assign lcp_image = collection.products.first.featured_image
      # Mirrors the contained product_sizes in templates/collection.liquid.
      assign lcp_sizes = '(min-width: 1280px) 290px, (min-width: 1024px) calc((100vw - 152px) / 4), (min-width: 768px) calc((100vw - 104px) / 2), calc((100vw - 44px) / 2)'
    endif
  elsif template == 'list-collections'
    # Preload only on page one — subsequent pages would reference an off-screen collection.
    if current_page == 1
      # Mirrors templates/list-collections.liquid's default child image fallback; intentional image-picker overrides may differ.
      assign first_collection = collections.first
      assign lcp_image = first_collection.image | default: first_collection.products.first.featured_image
      # Mirrors the contained collection_sizes in templates/list-collections.liquid.
      assign lcp_sizes = '(min-width: 1280px) calc(1192px / 3), (min-width: 1024px) calc((100vw - 88px) / 3), (min-width: 768px) calc((100vw - 84px) / 2), calc(100vw - 32px)'
    endif
  elsif template == 'product'
    assign lcp_image = product.featured_media.preview_image | default: product.featured_image
    # Mirrors templates/product.liquid: the 2fr gallery is split into two columns only for 3+ media.
    if product.media.size > 2
      assign lcp_sizes = '(min-width: 1280px) 384px, (min-width: 768px) calc((100vw - 128px) / 3), 100vw'
    else
      assign lcp_sizes = '(min-width: 1280px) 768px, (min-width: 768px) calc((100vw - 128px) * 2 / 3), 100vw'
    endif
  elsif template == 'search'
    # Preload only for a nonblank query on page one — search.results respects the paginate window.
    if current_page == 1 and search.performed and search.terms != blank and search.results.first.object_type == 'product'
      assign lcp_image = search.results.first.featured_image
      # Mirrors result_sizes in templates/search.liquid, including non-product card overrides.
      assign lcp_sizes = '(min-width: 1280px) 297px, (min-width: 1024px) calc((100vw - 92px) / 4), (min-width: 768px) calc((100vw - 84px) / 2), calc(100vw - 32px)'
    endif
  endif
-%}
{%- if lcp_image -%}
  <link
    rel="preload"
    as="image"
    fetchpriority="high"
    href="{{ lcp_image | image_url: width: 1500 }}"
    imagesrcset="{{ lcp_image | image_url: width: 375 }} 375w, {{ lcp_image | image_url: width: 550 }} 550w, {{ lcp_image | image_url: width: 750 }} 750w, {{ lcp_image | image_url: width: 1100 }} 1100w, {{ lcp_image | image_url: width: 1500 }} 1500w"
    imagesizes="{{ lcp_sizes }}"
  >
{%- endif -%}

{%- doc -%}

  Country selection is used as the currency picker because Shopify associates
  storefront currency with the active market country.

  @param {boolean} [show_country] - Whether to show the country/currency selector. Default: false.
  @param {string} id - Unique ID prefix for form controls.
  @param {string} [class] - Classes for the wrapper element.
  @param {string} [presentation] - Display mode: 'dropdown' or 'accordion'. Default: 'dropdown'.
  @param {boolean} [show_labels] - Whether labels should be visible in the panel. Default: false.
  @param {string} submit_button - Caller-captured language-update button with type="submit"; rendered only when the language selector is shown. @required

  @example
  {% capture update_button %}
    {% block 'button', type: 'submit', variant: 'button-secondary', class: 'h-11 rounded-button px-3 text-xs' %}{{ 'localization.update_language' | t }}{% endblock %}
  {% endcapture %}
  {% render 'localization-form', show_country: true, id: 'header-localization', submit_button: update_button %}
{%- enddoc -%}

{%- liquid
  assign id = id | default: 'localization-form'

  assign return_to = canonical_url | default: routes.root_url

                  {%- assign country_is_current = true -%}

                    type="submit"

                    {% if country_is_current %}aria-current="true"{% endif %}

================ FILE: snippets/meta-tags.liquid ================

{% doc %}
  Renders essential meta tags for SEO, Open Graph, Twitter Cards, structured data, and the page title.
  Automatically adapts og:type based on the current page type (product, article, or website).
  Adds noindex,follow robots directives for search, cart, 404, and tag-filtered collection pages.
  Includes favicon from shop brand settings.

  @example
  {% render 'meta-tags' %}
{% enddoc %}

<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta http-equiv="X-UA-Compatible" content="IE=edge">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">

{%- if shop.brand.favicon -%}
  <link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="{{ shop.brand.favicon | image_url: width: 32, height: 32 }}">
  <link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="{{ shop.brand.favicon | image_url: width: 180, height: 180 }}">
{%- endif -%}

{%- liquid
  assign og_title = page_title | default: shop.name
  assign og_url = canonical_url | default: request.origin
  assign og_type = 'website'
  assign og_description = page_description | default: shop.description | default: shop.name

  assign og_image = page_image
  assign og_image_alt = nil

  if og_image == nil and request.page_type == 'product' and product.featured_image
    assign og_image = product.featured_image
  endif

  if og_image
    assign og_image_alt = og_image.alt | default: og_title
  endif

  if request.page_type == 'product'
    assign og_type = 'product'
  elsif request.page_type == 'article'
    assign og_type = 'article'
  elsif request.page_type == 'password'
    assign og_url = request.origin
  endif
%}

<meta
  property="og:site_name"
  content="{{ shop.name | escape }}"
>
<meta
  property="og:url"
  content="{{ og_url | escape }}"
>
<meta
  property="og:title"
  content="{{ og_title | escape }}"
>
<meta
  property="og:type"
  content="{{ og_type }}"
>
<meta
  property="og:description"
  content="{{ og_description | escape }}"
>

{%- if og_image -%}
  <meta
    property="og:image"
    content="https:{{ og_image | image_url: width: 1200 }}"
  >
  <meta
    property="og:image:secure_url"
    content="https:{{ og_image | image_url: width: 1200 }}"
  >
  {%- if og_image.width -%}
    <meta
      property="og:image:width"
      content="{{ og_image.width }}"
    >
    <meta
      property="og:image:height"
      content="{{ og_image.height }}"
    >
  {%- endif -%}

  <meta
    property="og:image:alt"
    content="{{ og_image_alt | escape }}"
  >
{%- endif -%}

{%- if request.page_type == 'product' -%}
  <script type="application/ld+json">
    {{ product | structured_data }}
  </script>

  <meta
    property="og:price:amount"
    content="{{ product.price | money_without_currency | strip_html }}"
  >
  <meta
    property="og:price:currency"
    content="{{ cart.currency.iso_code }}"
  >
{%- endif -%}

<meta
  name="twitter:card"
  content="summary_large_image"
>
<meta
  name="twitter:title"
  content="{{ og_title | escape }}"
>
<meta
  name="twitter:description"
  content="{{ og_description | escape }}"
>

{%- if og_image -%}
  <meta
    name="twitter:image"

  >
  <meta
    name="twitter:image:alt"
    content="{{ og_image_alt | escape }}"
  >
{%- endif -%}

<title>
  {%- assign title_base = page_title | default: shop.name -%}
  {{ title_base }}
  {%- assign joined_tags = current_tags | join: ', ' -%}
  {%- if current_tags %} &ndash; {{ 'general.meta.tagged' | t: tags: joined_tags }}{% endif -%}
  {%- if current_page != 1 %} &ndash; {{ 'general.meta.page' | t: number: current_page }}{% endif -%}
  {%- unless title_base contains shop.name %} &ndash; {{ shop.name }}{% endunless -%}
</title>

<link
  rel="canonical"
  href="{{ canonical_url | escape }}"
>

{%- if request.locale -%}
  {%- liquid
    # Derive the origin from canonical_url so every alternate stays on its canonical host.
    # Keep the query opaque and strip a locale root only after matching a complete leading path segment.
    assign canonical_protocol = canonical_url | split: '://' | first | append: '://'
    assign canonical_after_protocol = canonical_url | remove_first: canonical_protocol
    assign canonical_host = canonical_after_protocol | split: '/' | first | split: '?' | first
    assign canonical_origin = canonical_protocol | append: canonical_host
    assign canonical_path_and_query = canonical_url | remove_first: canonical_origin
    assign canonical_path = canonical_path_and_query | split: '?' | first
    assign canonical_query = canonical_path_and_query | remove_first: canonical_path
    assign locale_relative_path = canonical_path

    if locale_relative_path == blank
      assign locale_relative_path = '/'
    endif

    unless request.locale.root_url == '/'
      assign source_root_size = request.locale.root_url | size
      assign source_root_prefix = canonical_path | slice: 0, source_root_size
      assign source_root_boundary = canonical_path | slice: source_root_size, 1

      if canonical_path == request.locale.root_url
        assign locale_relative_path = '/'
      elsif source_root_prefix == request.locale.root_url and source_root_boundary == '/'
        assign locale_relative_path = canonical_path | remove_first: request.locale.root_url
      endif
    endunless
  -%}
  {%- for locale in shop.published_locales -%}
    {%- liquid
      if locale.root_url == '/'
        assign alternate_path = locale_relative_path
      elsif locale_relative_path == '/'
        assign alternate_path = locale.root_url
      else
        assign alternate_path = locale.root_url | append: locale_relative_path
      endif

      assign alternate_url = canonical_origin | append: alternate_path | append: canonical_query
    -%}
    <link
      rel="alternate"
      hreflang="{{ locale.iso_code }}"
      href="{{ alternate_url | escape }}"
    >
  {%- endfor -%}
  <link
    rel="alternate"
    hreflang="x-default"
    href="{{ canonical_url | escape }}"
  >
{%- endif -%}

<meta
  name="description"
  content="{{ page_description | default: shop.description | default: shop.name | escape }}"
>

{%- comment -%} Exclude transient/low-value pages from Google's index: search (infinite query permutations), cart (session-specific, no canonical), 404 (not real content), and tag-filtered collection pages (duplicate content). `follow` keeps link equity flowing through. {%- endcomment -%}
{%- if request.page_type == 'search'
    or request.page_type == 'cart'
    or request.page_type == '404'
    or current_tags -%}
  <meta name="robots" content="noindex, follow">
{%- endif -%}

{%- if request.page_type == 'index' -%}
  {%- capture url_template -%}
    {{- request.origin -}}
    {{- routes.search_url -}}
    ?q={search_term_string}
  {%- endcapture -%}

  <script type="application/ld+json">
  {
    "@context": "https://schema.org",
    "@type": "WebSite",
    "@id": {{ request.origin | append: '/#website' | json }},
    "name": {{ shop.name | json }},
    "url": {{ request.origin | append: '/' | json }},
    "potentialAction": {
      "@type": "SearchAction",
      "target": {
        "@type": "EntryPoint",
        "urlTemplate": {{ url_template | json }}
      },
      "query-input": "required name=search_term_string"
    }

================ FILE: snippets/placeholder-texture.liquid ================

{% doc %}
  Renders a deterministic, theme-colored gradient placeholder for missing images and resources.

  @param {string} [kind] - Placeholder context used to vary the gradient composition. Default: 'image'.
  @param {number} [seed] - Stable number used to vary the gradient positions. Default: 1.
  @param {string} [class] - Additional CSS classes on the wrapper. Full-bleed positioned callers should include aspect-auto.
  @param {string} [attributes] - Additional HTML attributes passed through to the wrapper.
  @param {string} [aria_label] - Accessible label for the placeholder image.
  @param {string} [alt] - Fallback accessible label when aria_label is blank.

  @category content
  @renders div

  @example
  {% render 'placeholder-texture', kind: 'product', seed: forloop.index, class: 'absolute inset-0 aspect-auto', aria_label: product.title %}
{% enddoc %}

{%- liquid
  assign kind_handle = kind | default: 'image' | handleize
  assign seed_value = seed | default: 1 | plus: 0
  if seed_value <= 0
    assign seed_value = 1
  endif

  case kind_handle
    when 'product'
      assign kind_offset = 17
    when 'collection'
      assign kind_offset = 37
    when 'article'
      assign kind_offset = 53
    when 'hero'
      assign kind_offset = 71
    else
      assign kind_offset = 11
  endcase

  assign seed_key = seed_value | times: 97 | plus: kind_offset
  assign accent_x = seed_key | times: 37 | plus: 11 | modulo: 76 | plus: 12
  assign accent_y = seed_key | times: 41 | plus: 17 | modulo: 76 | plus: 12
  assign gradient_angle = seed_key | times: 71 | plus: 47 | modulo: 360

  assign fallback_label = 'general.placeholder_image' | t
  assign label = aria_label | default: alt | default: fallback_label
-%}

{%- comment -%} The base-layer square ratio keeps unsized placeholders visible. Full-bleed positioned callers pass aspect-auto because insets alone do not override the ratio. {%- endcomment -%}
<div
  class="placeholder-texture overflow-hidden{% if class != blank %} {{ class }}{% endif %}"
  style="--placeholder-accent-x: {{ accent_x }}%; --placeholder-accent-y: {{ accent_y }}%; --placeholder-angle: {{ gradient_angle }}deg;"
  role="img"
  aria-label="{{ label | escape }}"
  {% if attributes != blank %} {{ attributes }}{% endif %}
></div>

================ FILE: snippets/standard-actions-config.liquid ================

{% doc %}
  Registers the theme's Standard Actions cart configuration. An inline classic
  script starts the standard-actions-override.js module import immediately, then
  a one-shot DOMContentLoaded listener configures `Shopify.actions.openCart` and
  `Shopify.actions.updateCart` so platform cart mutations use the theme handlers
  instead of the full-page fallback.

  The layout must render this snippet above content_for_header — the platform
  requires the configuration hooks to register first. This is one of the two
  audited bootstrap-only DOMContentLoaded exceptions documented in
  docs/component-api.md.

  @example
  {% render 'standard-actions-config' %}
{% enddoc %}

<script>
  (() => {
    const standardActionsOverride = import({{ 'standard-actions-override.js' | asset_url | json }});
    const cartEventTarget = () => document.querySelector('s-cart') ?? document;
    const productFormEventTarget = () => document.querySelector('[data-product-form][aria-busy="true"]')
      ?? document.querySelector('[data-product-form]')
      ?? cartEventTarget();

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      const actions = window.Shopify?.actions;
      if (!actions) return;

      actions.openCart.configure({
        async handler() {
          const { handleOpenCart } = await standardActionsOverride;
          return handleOpenCart();
        },
      });

      actions.updateCart.configure({
        // Product adds and cart edits emit from their owning interaction surface.
        eventTarget: (meta) => {
          if (meta?.type === 'shopify:cart:lines-update' && meta.action === 'add') {
            return productFormEventTarget();
          }

          return cartEventTarget();
        },
        async handler(defaultHandler, payload, options) {
          const { handleUpdateCart } = await standardActionsOverride;
          return handleUpdateCart(defaultHandler, payload, options);
        },
      });
    }, { once: true });
  })();
</script>

{% doc %}

  @param {string} name - Radio input name. @required

  @param {string} shape - Picker-resolved swatch shape class. @required
  @param {boolean} [selected] - Pre-select this option value. Default: false.
  @param {boolean} [disabled] - Disable the radio. Default: false.
  @param {boolean} [unavailable] - Show the unavailable strike and announcement. Default: false.
  @param {string} [data_variant_id] - Variant ID consumed by the picker component.

  @param {string} [attributes] - Developer-authored HTML attributes for the label.

  @category forms
  @renders label

  @example

================ FILE: snippets/theme-type-scale-variables.liquid ================

{% doc %}
  Emits CSS custom property declarations for merchant-configurable typography
  scale settings. Render inside a CSS rule or style attribute.

  @example
  :root {
    {% render 'theme-type-scale-variables' %}
  }

  @example
  <div style="{% render 'theme-type-scale-variables' %}">
    {{ content_for_layout }}
  </div>
{% enddoc %}

{%- liquid
  case settings.type_scale_paragraph_size
    when 'xs'
      assign paragraph_anchor = 12
    when 'sm'
      assign paragraph_anchor = 14
    when 'md'
      assign paragraph_anchor = 16
    when 'lg'
      assign paragraph_anchor = 18
    when 'xl'
      assign paragraph_anchor = 20
    else
      assign paragraph_anchor = 14
  endcase

  case settings.type_scale_heading_size
    when 'xs'
      assign heading_anchor = 28
    when 'sm'
      assign heading_anchor = 39
    when 'md'
      assign heading_anchor = 50
    when 'lg'
      assign heading_anchor = 61
    when 'xl'
      assign heading_anchor = 72
    else
      assign heading_anchor = 39
  endcase

  assign type_paragraph_lg_size = paragraph_anchor | times: 1.18 | round: 2
  assign type_paragraph_size = paragraph_anchor
  assign type_paragraph_sm_size = paragraph_anchor | times: 0.82 | round: 2
  assign type_subheading_size = paragraph_anchor | times: 0.78 | round: 2

  assign type_heading_2xl_size = heading_anchor | times: 1.25 | round: 2
  assign type_heading_xl_size = heading_anchor
  assign type_heading_lg_size = heading_anchor | times: 0.80 | round: 2
  assign type_heading_md_size = heading_anchor | times: 0.65 | round: 2

  {%- assign search_terms_raw = search.terms | strip_html -%}
  {%- assign search_terms_escaped = search_terms_raw | escape -%}

  <s-live-form

              <input

              <button

      </div>

      {% capture search_filter_trigger %}
        {% block 'button', commandfor: 'search-filter-drawer', command: 'show-modal', variant: 'button-outline', class: 'h-11 px-4 text-sm rounded-button' %}{{ 'collections.filter' | t }}{% endblock %}
      {% endcapture %}
      {% capture search_toolbar_submit %}

      {% capture search_filter_close_button %}
        {%- capture close_attrs -%}aria-label="{{ 'general.close' | t }}"{%- endcapture -%}

      {%- comment -%} The query gate prevents blank editor previews from showing the full catalog. {%- endcomment -%}
      {% partial 'search-content' %}
        <span data-results-count hidden>{{ search.results_count }}</span>

          {% if search.results_count > 0 %}
            {%- assign live_announce_text = 'search.live_results_announcement' | t: count: search.results_count, terms: search_terms_escaped -%}
          {% else %}
            {%- assign live_announce_text = 'search.live_no_results_announcement' | t: terms: search_terms_escaped -%}

          <h2 class="sr-only">{{ 'search.results_heading' | t }}</h2>

          {% if search.results_count > 0 %}
            {% paginate search.results by 20 %}
              {%- comment -%} All result types share the contained four-column slot; mirror in snippets/lcp-preload.liquid. {%- endcomment -%}
              {%- assign result_sizes = '(min-width: 1280px) 297px, (min-width: 1024px) calc((100vw - 92px) / 4), (min-width: 768px) calc((100vw - 84px) / 2), calc(100vw - 32px)' -%}
              <div class="w-full max-w-page mx-auto px-margin contain-paint">

                  {% for result in search.results %}
                    {%- comment -%} The four-slot eager threshold matches one large-screen four-column row; the slot-one image receives the LCP priority hint when present. {%- endcomment -%}
                    {%- if forloop.index <= 4 -%}{%- assign search_lazy = false -%}{%- else -%}{%- assign search_lazy = true -%}{%- endif -%}

                    {%- if search_lazy -%}{%- assign search_image_attributes = 'loading="lazy"' -%}{%- else -%}{%- assign search_image_attributes = 'loading="eager"' -%}{%- endif -%}
                    {%- assign search_image_attributes = search_image_attributes | append: ' fetchpriority="' | append: fetch_priority | append: '"' -%}
                    <li>
                      {% case result.object_type %}
                        {% when 'product' %}
                          {%- # theme-check-disable-next-line UnknownFilter %}
                          <s-view-event class="block" view-event-trigger="intersect" view-event-payload="{{ result | standard_event_data: 'view', context: 'search' | escape }}">

                            {% block 'card', block.name: 't:blocks.product_card', url: result.url, aria_label: result.title, border_radius: 'rounded-card' %}
                              <a href="{{ result.url | escape }}" class="relative block overflow-hidden rounded-[inherit]" aria-label="{{ result.title | escape }}">
                                {% block 'image', fallback_image: result.featured_image, aspect_ratio: 'aspect-square', sizes: result_sizes, attributes: search_image_attributes, alt: result.title, seed: forloop.index %}{% endblock %}
                              </a>
                              <div class="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
                                {% block 'text', variant: 'type-body-sm', tag: 'h3', class: 'font-medium text-on-surface line-clamp-2' %}{{ result.title | escape }}{% endblock %}
                                {% block 'price', price: card_variant.price, compare_at_price: card_variant.compare_at_price, price_min: result.price_min, price_max: result.price_max, class: 'text-sm font-medium self-start group-[.text-center]/card:self-center group-[.text-end]/card:self-end' %}{% endblock %}
                              </div>
                            {% endblock %}
                          </s-view-event>
                        {% when 'article' %}
                          {%- assign card_article = result -%}
                          {%- if search_lazy -%}{%- assign image_loading = 'loading="lazy"' -%}{%- else -%}{%- assign image_loading = 'loading="eager"' -%}{%- endif -%}
                          {%- assign image_attributes = image_loading | append: ' fetchpriority="' | append: fetch_priority | append: '"' -%}
                          {% block 'card', block.name: 't:blocks.article_card', url: card_article.url, aria_label: card_article.title %}
                            {%- comment -%} Reserve search result geometry even when the article has no image. {%- endcomment -%}
                            <a href="{{ card_article.url | escape }}" class="relative block overflow-hidden rounded-[inherit]" aria-label="{{ card_article.title | escape }}">
                              {% block 'image', fallback_image: card_article.image, aspect_ratio: 'aspect-square', sizes: result_sizes, alt: card_article.title, attributes: image_attributes, seed: forloop.index, placeholder_kind: 'article' %}{% endblock %}
                            </a>
                            <div class="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
                              {% block 'text', variant: 'type-body-sm', tag: 'h3', class: 'font-medium text-on-surface line-clamp-2' %}{{ card_article.title | escape }}{% endblock %}
                            </div>
                          {% endblock %}
                        {% when 'collection' %}
                          {%- assign card_collection = result -%}
                          {%- assign card_url = card_collection.url | default: routes.root_url -%}
                          {%- if card_collection -%}{%- assign card_title = card_collection.title -%}{%- else -%}{%- assign card_title = 'collections.placeholder_title' | t -%}{%- endif -%}
                          {%- assign card_image = card_collection.image | default: card_collection.products.first.featured_image -%}
                          {%- if search_lazy -%}{%- assign image_loading = 'lazy' -%}{%- else -%}{%- assign image_loading = 'eager' -%}{%- endif -%}
                          {%- capture image_attributes -%}loading="{{ image_loading }}" fetchpriority="{{ fetch_priority }}"{%- endcapture -%}
                          {% block 'card', block.name: 't:blocks.collection_card', url: card_url, aria_label: card_title, alignment: 'text-start', border_radius: 'rounded-card' %}
                            <a href="{{ card_url | escape }}" class="relative block overflow-hidden rounded-[inherit]" aria-label="{{ card_title | escape }}">
                              {% block 'image', fallback_image: card_image, aspect_ratio: 'aspect-square', sizes: result_sizes, attributes: image_attributes, alt: card_title, seed: forloop.index, placeholder_kind: 'collection' %}{% endblock %}
                            </a>
                            <div class="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
                              {% block 'text', variant: 'type-body-sm', tag: 'h3', class: 'font-medium text-on-surface line-clamp-2' %}{{ card_title | escape }}{% endblock %}
                            </div>
                          {% endblock %}
                        {% else %}
                          {% block 'card', url: result.url, aria_label: result.title %}
                            {%- comment -%} The media link is the focus/AT target; the shell's full-card link only extends pointer hit area. {%- endcomment -%}
                            <a href="{{ result.url | escape }}" class="relative block overflow-hidden rounded-[inherit]" aria-label="{{ result.title | escape }}">
                              {% block 'image', fallback_image: result.image, aspect_ratio: 'aspect-square', sizes: result_sizes, alt: result.title, attributes: search_image_attributes, seed: forloop.index, placeholder_kind: 'article' %}{% endblock %}
                            </a>
                            <div class="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
                              {% block 'text', variant: 'type-body-sm', tag: 'h3', class: 'font-medium text-on-surface line-clamp-2' %}{{ result.title | escape }}{% endblock %}
                            </div>

                    </li>
